column1: # LongYin English canonical data - generated from the complete user translation corpus
依山而建，殿宇嵯峨，气势雄伟的寺庙群，金顶与红幡白墙交相辉映，颇为肃穆庄严。传闻其僧众极擅炮制高原珍稀药材，以此制成之藏药更是具有枯骨生肌，返老还童等神奇功效。
column2: A grand mountain palace-temple complex with sacred significance.

column1: 天山之巅池泽中有玄冰一块，终年不化，阴寒刺骨，常人只需靠近便感周身冰结，血脉凝固，堪称世间至阴至寒之物。天山弟子卧于其上修炼，配合至阴至阳之心法，自是各有奇效。
column2: An extremely cold pool used for yin-based cultivation.

column1: 上倚河汉，下临江流，重檐叠翼，巍峨耸峙，传说费祎登仙尝驾黄鹤憩于此，远眺烟波江上，孤帆远影，堪称荆吴景胜之最。名士高人，青年才俊，亦多在此游历交友，切磋技艺。
column2: A famous scenic tower overlooking river landscapes.

column1: 一座气势森然的高台，其上陈列有各式刀兵数百把，大小各异，长短不一，刀光凛凛，耀眼夺目。霸刀门弟子常在此演习刀法，试用兵刃，劈金碎石之声如雷霆惊乍，不绝于耳。
column2: A platform for testing weapons and martial techniques.

column1: 一方清澈见底的水池，池中或卧或立有刀兵剑刃无数，乃是铸剑山庄历代冶炼积累之残次品及试验品。以此池水淬炼兵器，可感应池中无穷剑意，所得之锋利坚韧远非凡俗可比。
column2: A pool filled with broken swords used for tempering weapons.

column1: 历代于此石壁之上不断穿凿而成，号称洞窟千余，其中禅室林立，佛像众多，四壁多绘有壁画，极为宏伟瑰丽。更兼藏经洞窟，内有书卷典籍无数，引得众多高僧大德前来修行。
column2: A vast complex of Buddhist grottoes filled with murals and scriptures.

column1: 点苍山麓，洱海之滨，寺中有三塔峙立，金碧交辉，香火鼎盛，以五大重器闻名于世，堪称西南第一佛刹。传闻其间僧众不乏极擅医术者，慈悲为怀，济世救民，一时传为佳话。
column2: A renowned temple complex known for its towers and medicinal traditions.

column1: 于崇山峻岭间开凿而成，险要奇崛之关口，黄鹤高飞不得过，猿猱欲度愁攀援。阎罗殿弟子想正式入门，需要在此通过极为艰险严苛之考验，方能闯过鬼门关，入修罗之道。
column2: A dangerous checkpoint used as a martial trial entrance.

column1: 崆峒之山，险恶奇绝，传说有山洞七十二处，深不可测，不知所通，经历代穿凿后，更是相互勾连，回环曲折。崆峒弟子借此地势修炼奇门绝技，往往险招百出，防不胜防。
column2: A complex of interconnected caves used for secret training.

column1: 平坦辽阔的环形赛场，用于修习马术或举行赛马大会。飞龙门弟子时常居于其间细心观察，挑选筋强骨健者作为坐骑。按照门规一旦选中，则一人一马形影不离，生死相依。
column2: A large arena for horse training and racing competitions.

column1: 由星罗棋布，错综复杂的引水渠道和大小水库组成的庞大水利工程，其渠可行舟，亦可作浇灌汲饮之用，蜀中以此灌溉沃野千里，并罕有水灾泛滥，终成其“天府”之美名。
column2: An ancient irrigation system used for flood control and agriculture.

column1: 世人皆道烟花柳巷为寻乐之处，却不知此处才是世间极乐之所，其间珍馐美馔罗列星陈，朱颜粉黛婀娜逦迤，朝歌夜弦，纸醉金迷，便是王公贵族也以能在此享乐为荣。
column2: A luxurious district of indulgence and excess entertainment.

column1: 地处丹崖山峦，东临碣石，以观沧海，传说八仙过海始于此处，蓬莱弟子登临此地，观琼瑶仙境，海市蜃楼之奇景，以此融入剑法剑意之中，轻灵飘逸确不似凡间所有。
column2: A legendary seaside pavilion linked to immortals.

column1: 纯铜铸造之宝殿，通体以金箔敷盖，在旭日映射之下，灿烂辉煌，迢耀天地，恍若佛光普照。峨眉弟子多在此观览云海升腾，感悟天地灵韵，从而精进修为，提升武艺。
column2: A sacred golden temple located at a mountain peak.

column1: 历史悠久的皇家祭祀园林，其规模宏伟，由诸多祠堂，亭台，庙宇，楼阁及造景构成。历代皇帝皆会在此例行祭祀，本朝更是不断兴修亭台，扩建园林，以壮其威仪。
column2: A historic imperial ritual Garden complex.

column1: 峨眉高人走火入魔之时无意所创，需泯灭本心，断绝七情六欲，出手之时自然无牵无挂，无所顾忌，只求速杀，于敌于己皆不留丝毫余地，因其杀心过盛不可轻易使用
column2: A monkey-inspired boxing style emphasizing agility and extended striking range.

column1: 12月初8乃释迦摩尼悟道成佛之日，家家户户会以各种谷物豆类，混合红枣花生莲子枸杞桂圆核桃等干果，佐以红糖白糖熬煮成一锅香甜浓郁的腊八粥以表纪念。
column2: The eighth day of the twelfth lunar month marks the day Shakyamuni attained enlightenment and became a Buddha. Families commemorate it by simmering a rich, sweet Laba porridge made from various grains and beans, mixed with dried fruits and nuts such as red dates, peanuts, lotus seeds, goji berries, longan, and walnuts, sweetened with brown and white sugar.

column1: 瘴气密布，暗流涌动的墨绿毒池，五毒教历代炼蛊试毒之产物，江湖中人闻风丧胆的金蚕王蛊便是出自其中，功力薄弱者只需稍稍靠近，便会头晕眼花，倒地不起。
column2: A toxic pool used for refining poisons and gu techniques.

column1: 神妙非凡，玄机莫测，与凡间剑法有云泥之别，传说乃火龙真人所授仙法，吕祖有诗赞曰：庞眉斗竖恶精神，万里腾空一踊身。背上匣中三尺剑，为天且示不平人。
column2: A legendary immortal technique said to originate from Huolong Zhenren, describing transcendent sword intent that exists beyond ordinary martial forms and strikes with celestial authority.

column1: 一处平坦广阔之木台，不论三教九流，鸡鸣狗盗之徒，乃至衣衫褴褛之乞丐，皆可登台或坐而论道，或一展拳脚，丐帮择其贤者招揽，因而人才济济，冠绝东南。
column2: An open platform for martial debates and talent recruitment.

column1: 黄河裹挟泥沙而下，冲积而成一处水草丰美，沃野千里的天然牧场，不仅可作粮食生产，更是以盛产名驹战马而天下闻名，难怪俗语有云：黄河百害，唯富一套。
column2: A large horse-breeding ground known for warhorses.

column1: 此书院自本朝开科取士以来，登第者多达六十余人。远近文人学子皆心向往之，慕名求学者亦是络绎不绝，因而成为一处文人武客交流技艺，买卖藏书之胜地。
column2: A prestigious academy known for producing scholars and talents.

column1: 依山而建，重檐叠砌之宫殿，上应紫薇星宿，下合帝君方位，聚气藏风，水脉绵延，武当派弟子多在此修习道家心法和上乘内功，以求感通天地，阴阳调和。
column2: A Taoist palace aligned with celestial energy for inner cultivation.

column1: 蓬莱派第三代掌门凌霄子在海边练剑时，曾目睹海市蜃楼间仙女舞剑，便默记下招式，最终创出这套碧海飞仙剑，其招飘逸绝伦，使人如见飞仙之丰神绰约。
column2: The “Blue Sea Flying Immortal Sword,” created by the third-generation Penglai leader after witnessing a celestial maiden’s sword dance in a mirage; its style is elegant and transcendent.

column1: 蜿蜒地势之间一处幽静深谷，其间水草丰茂，灵气汇集，因而生长有奇花异草，灵药仙芝无数，在此处种植药材也是事半功倍，乃是世人修习医术之圣地。
column2: A fertile valley rich in rare herbs and spiritual plants.

column1: 名字颇为喜庆，却是丐帮一门精妙非常的棍法。此棍招防守森严，密不透风，更藏有一式自上向下，如同拜年一般的杀招，若闪避不及便有头颅崩碎之危
column2: The name sounds festive, yet this is an exquisitely refined Beggars Sect staff art; its defense is airtight and impenetrable, and concealed within is a killing move that strikes downward like a New Year bow — those who fail to dodge risk having their skull shattered

column1: 配置各式暗器毒药的工坊，四周以帘布遮挡，重重叠叠密不透光。盖因唐门武学讲求出奇制胜，在暗室中修习可防止泄密，同时锻炼黑暗中视物之能力。
column2: A hidden chamber used for special training and research.

column1: 刻于天山绝顶玄冰内部来历不明的超绝内功，传说有永葆青春乃至起死回生之神妙功效，然江湖中罕有一睹真容者，故大多认为此功不过乡野传说罢了
column2: A supreme internal technique carved within the glacier at the summit of Tianshan, of unknown origin. Legends claim it can preserve youth or even revive the dead, though few in the martial world have ever seen it, so most consider it a mere rumor.

column1: 此步法以易经为基础，修习者需根据当时时间和所处方位，经周密计算后踏对应卦象而行，传说此术可卜算吉凶，预知敌意，从而闪避刀兵，化险为夷
column2: A footwork system based on the I Ching. Practitioners calculate time and position to step according to hexagrams, allowing them to predict danger and evade attacks.

column1: 一步一幻影，一步一化身，以玄妙步法和高超修为感应诸天众神的玄奇功法，挪步之间能飞渡虚空，跨越山海，清净光明，变化自在，常享胜妙快乐
column2: An advanced Emei inner method focused on harmony with natural law and bodily renewal.

column1: 丐帮前任帮主嗜酒如命，尝饮百杯不醉，并在随性挥舞间，创出这套以醉拳为基础的精妙拳法，其形散神不散，四面出击，潇洒快意，不负酒仙之名
column2: The previous Beggars Sect leader was addicted to wine, reportedly drinking a hundred cups without getting drunk; he created this refined fist art based on drunken fist through spontaneous movement — its form is scattered but its spirit is not, striking in all directions with free-spirited flair, worthy of the name Wine Immortal

column1: 丐帮最强掌法，动作简单无奇但却威力无穷，盖因此掌法将人体之力道与内劲之运用发挥到了极致，因此每击均有排山倒海之力，可以不变应万变矣
column2: The Beggars Sect's strongest palm art; the moves are simple and unremarkable yet of limitless power, because this art pushes the body's force and inner force application to their absolute limit — every strike has the force of moving mountains and overturning seas, able to meet any situation with one unchanging response

column1: 令经脉穴位皆偏移逆转的崆峒奇功，修习后周身力道反转，出招方式与内息运行皆异于常人，更能借此反转之力将来袭刀剑偏移方向，甚至反伤敌身
column2: A Kongtong inner art that reverses the flow of meridians, altering force direction and even reflecting incoming attacks.

column1: 传说天山祖师修行之时，曾目睹九天玄女自空中俯身而下，采撷梅花一枝，从而领悟出此飘忽若仙的绝世轻功，妙至巅毫，神出鬼入，不似人间所有
column2: It is said the Tianshan founder once saw the Nine Heavens Mysterious Maiden descend from the sky and pluck a plum blossom, thereby realizing this ethereal and immortal Movement Art—so refined it seems beyond the human world.

column1: 武绝义融合了飞龙门帝王封禅功和崆峒派斗转星移，所创独门绝技，出招方式与内息运行完全逆常理而行，诡异莫测，修习者稍有不慎便会走火入魔
column2: A unique technique created by Wu Jueyi, combining the Flying Dragon Sect’s imperial consecration skill with the Kongtong Sect’s “Shifting Stars” method. Its movements and internal circulation defy normal logic; extremely strange and dangerous, with a risk of qi deviation.

column1: 紫微斗数推命之术演化而来，将经脉穴位与天空星辰对应，根据每日天象与命盘转化来推算对应的内力运行路径，此后修为自然突飞猛进，如有神助
column2: A method derived from Ziwei astrology that maps meridians to celestial stars, allowing practitioners to align Inner Force flow with cosmic patterns for accelerated cultivation.

column1: 习武者最珍视苦修而来的内功功力，而此法却专攻任督二脉，损伤主脉消减功力，治疗不及便有伤残之虞，江湖中人不仅恨之入骨，更是畏之如虎
column2: A method that targets the Ren and Du meridians, damaging the main energy channels and reducing a practitioner’s internal power. If not treated in time, it may cause permanent injury; it is widely feared and hated in the martial world.

column1: 霹雳祖师遭人暗算武功尽废后，潜心研制而成的终极火器，有毁天灭地之能。其配方失传后霹雳堂历代不断尝试复原，才得此最接近成功的复刻品
column2: The ultimate weapon created by the Thunderclap Hall founder after his martial arts were destroyed by sabotage. It was developed in pursuit of catastrophic destructive power. The original formula has been lost, and later generations have only managed partial reconstructions.

column1: 传说海水汇集处有无底深谷名曰归墟，此心法将丹田炼化为归墟，经脉炼化为河流，与他人内劲相交时，可将其内力沿河流吸纳入海，化为己用
column2: A mental cultivation method derived from the idea of the abyssal “Ruins Return” oceanic chasm. It transforms the dantian into a sea and meridians into rivers, allowing absorption of others’ Inner Force like flowing water into the ocean.

column1: 天山内功多属性阴寒，常年修炼难免寒气入体伤肌冻骨，必须运此功法化解，盖因其内息纯阳炽热，可令周身寒意顿消，附近积雪亦被热浪融化
column2: A fire-and-ice dual internal technique: its pure yang heat neutralizes the sect’s cold energy, even melting surrounding snow when circulated.

column1: 达摩于嵩山面壁九年后，在少林留下这本融佛学和武学无上精要的宝典，通周身经络，系五脏精神，其内息澎湃无垠，可谓取之不尽，用之不竭
column2: A classical text from the Southern Dynasties by Liu Xie, covering the principles of writing and expression. Mastery of it allows understanding of the deeper logic behind martial manuals.

column1: 大隐阁不传之绝技，运功者每遭重击，便借力将气血内息于体内轮回一次，直至行将落败，此前轮回之力同时爆发，便能凤凰涅槃，浴火重生
column2: A forbidden technique of the Hidden Pavilion. Each time the practitioner suffers a heavy blow, Inner Force is cycled within the body; when near defeat, all accumulated power erupts, resulting in rebirth-like recovery.

column1: 相传是跛脚僧于睡梦中传授丐帮前辈的神妙拳法，出招时双眼微闭做昏昏欲睡状，招式空幻奇绝令人如坠梦中而不自知，待惊醒已身中数拳矣
column2: Said to have been taught by a lame monk to a Beggars Sect ancestor in a dream; when executing the moves, the eyes are half-closed in a drowsy manner — the techniques are phantasmal and strange, leaving the enemy feeling as if in a dream without realizing it, until they wake to find themselves struck by several blows

column1: 计心狂所夺得的龙胤归藏功一部分，最为完整但也最为艰深。计心狂苦心参悟并融入五毒心法，最终成为一门阴狠毒辣，怪异莫测的恐怖功法
column2: A more complete but extremely profound fragment of the Dragon Origin Hidden Scripture obtained by Ji Xin Kuang. After integrating it with the Five Poisons inner method, it became a sinister, vicious, and terrifying technique.

column1: 五毒教至高掌法，需采五毒反复淬炼双掌，中掌者体内五毒流窜，相互攻伐，周身肌肤因而呈现赤黄青紫黑五种颜色，足见其毒性诡谲狂乱
column2: The Five Poisons Sect's supreme palm art; requires repeatedly tempering both palms with five poisons — those struck find five poisons surging through their body and fighting each other; the skin takes on five colors — red, yellow, blue, purple, and black — showing the bizarre and chaotic nature of its toxicity

column1: 天蚕丝线珍贵无比，坚韧异常，刀砍火烧皆不能破，平时隐藏在手腕间，使用时以内劲吐出，可捆绑缠绕敌人武器四肢，一旦被缚再难脱身
column2: Heavenly Silkworm thread is precious beyond measure and abnormally tough — immune to blade and fire; normally concealed around the wrist, when deployed with inner force it can bind and wrap around the enemy's weapons and limbs — once bound, escape is nearly impossible

column1: 峨眉禅修之法，以浩然正气和纯净无匹的内息充盈百会、玉枕、印堂等头部要穴，便能产生形似佛顶宝光的七色光环，智慧灿然，元气殊胜
column2: A tiger-style walking technique used to build stable, powerful lower-body strength and awareness.

column1: 飞龙门登峰造极之枪法，其发力时机只在瞬息之间，如惊鸿于水面一点，却是数十年心魂体魄修炼之结晶，即便高手对战也能一招分出胜负
column2: The Flying Dragon Sect's supreme spear art; the moment to release force exists only in an instant, like a startled swan touching the water's surface — yet it is the crystallization of decades of body and soul cultivation; even in a duel between masters, one move can decide the outcome

column1: 驱使斑斓花蛛吸食自身血液，同时将蛛毒缓缓引入体内的奇功，出手时毒素聚集指尖，皮肤也会变得五彩斑斓，诡异莫名，触之者立中奇毒
column2: A strange art of letting a colorful flower spider drink one's own blood while slowly drawing the spider's venom into the body; when striking, the poison concentrates at the fingertips and the skin becomes multicolored and bizarre — those touched are immediately struck with exotic poison

column1: 吕洞宾所创长诗，字字蕴含道家修真之无上法门，玄通天地，神游虚空，大成者如得吕祖亲传，正是：附耳低言玄妙旨，提上蓬莱第一峰
column2: A long poem by Lu Dongbin containing Taoist cultivation principles. Its meanings span heaven and earth, and mastery of it is akin to receiving direct immortal guidance.

column1: 天山派独门心法，需在寒冷之处以经脉吸纳寒气，借以苦修阴性内功，意志不坚者多难以维持，真可谓不经一番寒彻骨,怎得梅花扑鼻香
column2: The sect’s unique inner cultivation method requires absorbing cold qi through the meridians in freezing environments; those lacking willpower struggle to persist, truly “no pain, no gain.”

column1: 少林硬功之首，运功时周身肌肤隐隐有金黄之色，功力越高者颜色越深，直至金芒四射之时，便能抵御一切外力侵袭，成就金刚不坏之身
column2: A chess-based martial strike targeting the center (“tianyuan”). Instead of avoiding the center, it directly attacks central meridians for a sudden decisive hit.

column1: 峨眉金顶东面有一悬崖名舍身崖，雄险奇伟，修习者需以舍身勇气一跃而下，于悬崖上攀援横渡直至谷底，功力稍浅者恐有粉骨碎身之虞
column2: A vast cultivation system representing interconnected “paths of heaven and earth,” spanning twelve Inner Force routes.

column1: 崆峒奇门高手所使的圆环形兵刃，可持于手中挥砍格挡，也可掷于空中回环飞舞，招式纷繁复杂变化无穷，功浅者使用反而容易划伤自己
column2: A circular weapon technique using ring-shaped blades that can be wielded or thrown; complex and dangerous, even for the user.

column1: 暹罗国王所赠之秘宝，乃天竺僧人以贝多罗叶为纸以泥金为墨所写之经书，内含极为精深的佛法和内家修行法门，非智慧非凡者难以参悟
column2: A Mount Emei sword style containing Taoist principles; calmness is required, otherwise progress stagnates.

column1: 丐帮祖师对战群邪时所创棍法，以“打狗”称之颇有几分戏谑粗俗之意，却是举重若轻，返璞归真，实用至极，无丝毫多余动作之招式
column2: A staff art created by the Beggars Sect founder while battling a horde of villains; calling it "dog beating" carries a certain humorous roughness, yet it is effortlessly powerful, returning to fundamental simplicity — extremely practical with not a single wasted movement

column1: 于天山瑶池上漫步之法，看似闲庭信步，优雅惬意，实则每一脚都踩在薄如蝉翼的薄冰之上，其中巧劲之把控可谓精妙绝伦，分毫不差
column2: A walking technique practiced on the Jade Pool of Tianshan. It looks leisurely and elegant, but each step is placed on ice as thin as a cicada’s wing, requiring perfect control and precision.

column1: 威力惊人内力消耗也极大的掌法，将阴阳两股精纯真气凝聚掌心，借劈掌之力将其剧烈融合，所到之处雷鸣震天，无坚不摧，无物不毁
column2: A soft internal fist style that uses spiraling force to neutralize joint strength.

column1: 将鞭收于脑后引而不发，全神贯注，将生死悬于身后一线之超绝鞭法，此鞭挥出力道时机方位均是精妙非凡，可谓高下立判，胜负立分
column2: A whip technique held behind the head and released at a critical moment, where timing and angle determine victory or defeat.

column1: 由外及内，先练体后练气的少林基础内功，修习时全身肌肉配合呼吸运劲，持之日久便感气血充盈，丹田膨胀，能意领气走，气随劲发
column2: A foundational Shaolin internal cultivation method that develops from the external to the internal. Through coordinated muscular tension and breathing, long practice leads to abundant qi and blood, expanded dantian, and the ability to guide qi with intent so that it follows force.

column1: 由天山独特天文异象演化而来，将至阳内劲于掌心倾吐而出，形成一道炽热耀目的白虹，所过之处，冰消雪融，与日月争辉，势不可挡
column2: Derived from unique celestial phenomena of Tianshan, it releases pure yang Inner Force from the palm, forming a blazing white rainbow. Wherever it passes, ice and snow melt; its power rivals the sun and moon.

column1: 一卷平平无奇之蚕丝绫布，在深厚内力和独特手法挥舞之下，迎风招展，遮天蔽日，可缠卷兵刃，绑缚敌身，其曲折回环间如有灵性
column2: A seemingly ordinary silk cloth weapon that, when infused with profound Inner Force, can expand to block the sky, bind enemies, and restrain weapons with flexible intelligence.

column1: 丐帮中人大多遵纪守法，但情急时仍需干些偷鸡摸狗的勾当，因此留有一式探囊取物的偷盗手法，但贸然以此作奸犯科者也难逃重罚
column2: Most Beggars Sect members are law-abiding, but in urgent situations they still need to pick a pocket or two; this technique exists for that purpose — though those who abuse it for crime will not escape punishment

column1: 传说湿婆皈依后所创护法神功，运转时遍体肌肤深沉暗淡，修为精深者更得黑气缭绕，此乃大黑天护持之法相，森然恐怖，不怒自威
column2: A protective martial art derived from the worship of Shiva after his conversion, manifesting a darkened aura over the body. Advanced practitioners are surrounded by a black energy known as the “Great Black Deity form,” exuding overwhelming intimidation.

column1: 位于门派深处一处幽僻隐秘的建筑，设有修习内功，轻功以及绝技的各类器械秘籍、机关装置，以及突破武学境界所需的闭关房。
column2: A hidden facility deep within the sect used for inner cultivation, Movement Art skills, and breakthrough training with manuals and mechanisms.

column1: 天山山脚水草丰茂，时常有仙鹤驻留，此擒拿绝技擅长攻其不备，快速捕捉而不伤分毫，若力道和内功修为稍有不足，便难以得手
column2: A grappling technique practiced near the mountain base, used to capture cranes swiftly and precisely without harming them, requiring great control of force and Inner Force.

column1: 蓬莱派秘传修真之法，仙人抚我顶，结发受长生，习此功法时自有一股真气自百会穴而下，若能一路破关抵达丹田，便可大增功力
column2: A secret Penglai cultivation method where “an immortal touches the head and grants longevity.” A stream of qi descends from the crown point and, if guided successfully to the dantian, greatly increases cultivation power.

column1: 西凉死士所创，但求同归于尽的悲壮招式，虽毫无防御且不留后手，其一往无前之势却能摧毁敌人意志，颇有置之死地而后生之意
column2: A suicidal Western Liang technique that abandons defense entirely, relying on overwhelming forward momentum to break the enemy’s Willpower.

column1: 门派中藏经，阅经，以及文案抄写研究之所，从粗浅入门功夫到秘传独门武学，皆分门别类储藏其中，非本门弟子自是严禁入内。
column2: A place for storing, reading, and copying martial arts texts, from basic manuals to secret techniques, strictly forbidden to outsiders.

column1: 传说乃佛陀护法帝释天所创，需有大力量与大智慧之人方能使出，一击之下金光四射闪电轰鸣，可击碎一切愚痴妄想与外道魔障
column2: A legendary technique attributed to Indra, protector of the Buddha. It requires immense strength and wisdom, releasing a strike of golden lightning capable of shattering ignorance, delusion, and demonic obstacles.

column1: 传说苗疆毒沼中有背生翅膀之异蛇，五毒高人有幸得见而创此功，其身形缥缈诡谲，去势叵测，上天入地，浮游深潜皆易如反掌
column2: Legend says there is a strange serpent with wings on its back in the Miao borderland poison swamps; a Five Poisons master was fortunate enough to witness it and created this art — the body moves in a phantasmal and unpredictable manner, going up and down, floating and diving, all with ease

column1: 内装黑火药和钢珠之球形暗器，投掷爆炸后，其中上千枚钢珠四散激射，中者周身肌肤尽碎，如遭凌迟，如此惨状令人闻之色变
column2: A spherical explosive hidden weapon containing gunpowder and steel pellets. Upon detonation, thousands of pellets scatter outward, shredding the victim’s body and causing devastating injuries.

column1: 剑势优美繁复，至阴至柔，嫦娥起舞，清影缭绕，令人如坠广寒宫中，有彻骨透心之意，唯有天山派资质最高之女弟子方能修习
column2: An elegant and complex sword style of extreme yin and softness, resembling Chang’e dancing under the moon. It evokes the sensation of falling into the Moon Palace; only the most talented female disciples of Tianshan can learn it.

column1: 剑势简雅古朴，至阳至刚，内劲炙热，烈火烁金，其气直贯九霄云外，有冲天动地之能，唯有天山派资质最高之男弟子方能修习
column2: A simple and ancient sword style of extreme yang and hardness, with blazing Inner Force like molten fire. Its qi pierces the heavens, capable of shaking the world; only the most talented male disciples of Tianshan can learn it.

column1: 唐门至高暗器，平平无奇的黑色钢针，却是以九种剧毒淬炼而成，见血封喉，无比凶险，江湖中人闻之无不两股战战，望风逃遁
column2: The Tang Sect's supreme hidden weapon; an ordinary-looking black steel needle, yet refined with nine virulent poisons — lethal the moment it draws blood, it is so feared in the jianghu that people flee at its mere mention

column1: 太极者天地混沌未开之相，此功法集天地灵气，纳四海于经脉，含八荒于丹田，故太极真气得以生生不息，取之无尽，用之不竭
column2: A philosophical Taiji cultivation method representing primordial chaos, drawing universal energy into the meridians to achieve endless internal circulation.

column1: 如痴如狂，如癫如嗔之棍法，棍势攻出四面八方，形无定势，动无虚招，以疯助其快，以魔增其威，令敌人望而生畏又无处遁逃
column2: A chaotic and frenzied staff technique that attacks from all directions without fixed form. It uses madness to enhance speed and ferocity, leaving opponents both intimidated and unable to escape.

column1: 形似佛祖拈花之指法，将全身真气凝于三指指尖，或钳制兵刃，或隔空制穴，貌似轻柔实则内劲澎湃，飞花落叶也足以掷出伤人
column2: A calligraphy-based martial art blending hardness and softness. Iron strokes strike with forceful vigor, while silver hooks defend with elegant softness; failure to master even one aspect ruins the overall harmony.

column1: 武当内家剑精髓，催周身真气于剑上，锋刃灵气氤氲，瑞光乍现，出招时乘九狮之仙驭，散百宝之祥光，堪有太乙天尊三分神通
column2: A Wudang internal sword essence technique that concentrates qi into the blade, producing auspicious radiance and overwhelming spiritual pressure.

column1: 蓄势凝神收而不发之棍法，起手将棍举过头顶，随敌人移动不断变换出手角度方位与力道，至一棍击出，时机精妙，无失手之理
column2: A staff technique focused on gathering strength without immediate release. The staff is raised overhead and its angle and timing constantly adjusted; when finally struck, it is executed with perfect precision and inevitability.

column1: 衙门升堂之时，左右衙役高呼威武之动作中领悟出的棍法，其路数威风凛凛，屏开八面，不时敲击地面发出巨响，震慑敌人心神
column2: A staff art inspired by the bailiffs' powerful shout of "Weiwu!" as a magistrate enters court; its manner is imposing and grand, periodically striking the ground with a great crash to shake the enemy's spirit

column1: 铸剑祖师欧治子感应剑池中万柄废弃刀剑之意，终苦思而成一没有剑招只有剑意的神妙剑法，剑未动，意已发，剑有尽，意无穷
column2: The Sword Forging founder Ou Yezi, sensing the will of thousands of discarded blades lying in the Sword Pool, finally devised through bitter contemplation a wondrous sword art with no moves — only sword intent; before the sword moves, the intent has already gone out; the sword has its limit, but the intent has none

column1: 阎罗王自蒙古摔跤术中悟出，以怪力攻敌下盘使其失去重心的拳法，高手相争之时若一方跌倒在地，无异于落入任人鱼肉之境地
column2: A fist technique inspired by Yama, realized from Mongolian wrestling, which uses overwhelming force to strike the opponent’s lower body and destabilize their stance. In high-level duels, once one side falls, they are essentially at the mercy of the other.

column1: 世间轻功大多为腿脚窜纵之术，而此轻功玄妙则可腾空以内息推进而行，凌空时全身静止不动，唯有衣袂飘飘，宛如驭气飞行
column2: A rare Movement Art where the body moves not by stepping but by Inner Force propulsion. In motion, the body appears still while clothing floats like it is carried by the wind.

column1: 五毒教至高内功心法，将五种剧毒融入经脉运行中，真气因而呈现出赤黄青紫黑五色，其周身肌肤与举手投足间无不暗含剧毒
column2: The Five Poisons Sect's supreme inner art; five virulent poisons are fused into the circulation of the meridians, causing the true qi to take on five colors — red, yellow, blue, purple, and black — and every inch of skin and every movement carries deadly poison

column1: 以嵇康失传曲谱为形，深厚玄奥内劲为意所创奇功，演奏时劲风四射，周身数丈内惊蓬振振，杀气森森，飞沙走石，天地变色
column2: A powerful inner art based on the lost musical score of Ji Kang. When performed, it unleashes strong winds within a radius, shaking vegetation and filling the area with killing intent and chaos.

column1: 以苗家请神之法使先祖蚩尤降神附体，所过之处皆黑雾缭绕，功力稍浅者甫一接触，或疯癫乱舞，或丧神失魄，如见蚩尤真身
column2: Using the Miao ritual of inviting spirits, the ancestor Chiyou descends and possesses the practitioner; wherever they pass, black mist swirls — those of shallower cultivation who make contact may go raving mad, or lose their soul entirely, as if facing Chiyou in the flesh

column1: 传说太上老君在峨眉山授于轩辕黄帝之天书，其中万法糅杂，儒道佛兼备，清音霄畅，万真降庭，被奉为道法之宗，群经之首
column2: A chaotic sword technique with no fixed form, mirroring monkey-like unpredictability.

column1: 太极圆转，无止无息，以柔劲不断卸去来袭力道为己用，再将此前所蓄一击返还，乃以静制动，以柔克刚之道家拳法不二法门
column2: A Taiji-style technique that constantly neutralizes incoming force using softness, then returns it in a counterstrike—using stillness to overcome motion.

column1: 将剑速舞至极致，整柄剑在手中只剩些微反光和残影，仿若无形无影无声无息之剑，此后或攻或守，自然诡谲莫测，招法难辨
column2: The sword is spun to the absolute limit of speed until the entire blade shows only faint reflections and afterimages — as if the sword has become invisible, inaudible, and traceless; thereafter whether attacking or defending, the moves become naturally deceptive and impossible to read

column1: 将阴阳两股内力碰撞研磨之法，每旋转一周内劲便增加一分，敌人内力也磨损一分，若修为不精强行使用，自身经脉也会受损
column2: A method of driving two streams of yin and yang inner force into collision and grinding; with each rotation the inner force increases by a degree while the enemy's inner force is worn down by a degree — if used forcibly without sufficient mastery, the practitioner's own meridians will be damaged

column1: 根据上古流传之河图洛书所创功法，博采阴阳五行，星象术数之长，若能参悟此功法，便可一通百通，获得超绝之功力与智慧
column2: A cultivation method derived from the ancient River Chart and Luo Book. It integrates yin-yang, the five elements, and celestial numerology. Those who comprehend it fully can unify all principles and greatly enhance both power and wisdom.

column1: 老僧入定，正襟危坐，运神凝思，喜怒不行于色，是为坐隐功，其打穴顺序和落点方位演化自呕血谱，纵横精妙令人叹为观止
column2: A secluded-in-thought technique practiced in still meditation. Its acupoint striking patterns are derived from the “Blood Spattering Manual,” forming intricate and profound vertical-horizontal sequences.

column1: 需于日出之时修炼，吸收清晨阳气来温养自身剑气的道家剑法，一经施展，则剑光滚滚，辉耀湛然，如旭日东升，令群邪辟易
column2: A solar cultivation Sword practiced at sunrise, absorbing yang energy. When unleashed, the sword radiance is brilliant and purifying, driving away evil.

column1: 需于月升之时修炼，吸收午夜阴气来滋养自身剑气的道家剑法，一经施展，则剑光闪闪，寒气逼人，如皎月西沉，令朔风四起
column2: A lunar cultivation Sword practiced at moonrise, absorbing cold yin energy. When released, the sword light is chilling and oppressive like a winter storm.

column1: 霸刀门主虽资质愚钝但天生神力，因此刀招极为简朴，却能将人体力道发挥至极限，一刀之下，便有轰天裂地，劈山断海之威
column2: A domineering blade technique of the Ba Dao Sect where overwhelming natural talent and brute strength combine to produce a single strike with earth-shattering force.

column1: 鬼谷子所传养精蓄锐，克己藏锋之术，其中七法皆仿效不同灵兽形态，可令修习者心神合一，物我两忘，脏腑清明，经脉通畅
column2: A seven-method internal cultivation technique attributed to Guiguzi, modeled after various mythical beasts; it unifies mind and body, purifies organs, and harmonizes meridians.

column1: 两枚金刚铁圈挥砍批砸，旋转翻飞，更兼套索捆缚只用，能将敌人绑回寺中以佛法教化，因此邪魔外道一闻此功便心胆俱裂
column2: A Movement Art that allows prolonged suspension after a leap, using Inner Force rebound to slow descent. To the uninformed, it appears like immortals descending from heaven.

column1: 传佛祖初诞时曾作狮子吼，云天上地下唯吾独尊，修习者亦发此吼声，响彻云霄，纯澈嘹亮，声闻数里，堪令群魔肝胆俱裂
column2: A wind-blade technique where yin and yang inner energies are infused into sound waves from guqin strings. The “Spring” variant burns like fire, while the “White Snow” variant is piercingly cold; together they create a difficult-to-defend ice-fire assault.

column1: 传说真武大帝于武当修行四十二年，功成飞升，遗此剑法于世，其剑势矫若惊龙，翩若游鸿，正气浩然长存，妖魔触之即溃
column2: A legendary sword art attributed to the True Martial Emperor during his forty-two years of cultivation on Wudang Mountain, said to eradicate evil with overwhelming righteous force.

column1: 含有五毒教奇门热毒的掌法，命中后会留下鲜红色掌印，此热毒入体会使人血脉膨胀，五内俱焚，功力孱弱者更是自燃当场
column2: A palm art containing the Five Poisons Sect's exotic heat poison; the strike leaves a vivid red palm print — this heat poison entering the body causes blood vessels to expand and organs to burn; those with weak cultivation may spontaneously combust on the spot

column1: 含有五毒教奇门热毒的暗器，命中后会留下鲜红色针印，此热毒入体会使人血脉膨胀，五内俱焚，功力孱弱者更是自燃当场
column2: A hidden weapon containing the Five Poisons Sect's exotic heat poison; it leaves a vivid red needle mark — the heat poison entering the body causes blood vessels to expand and organs to burn; those with weak cultivation may spontaneously combust on the spot

column1: 微言大义堪比春秋之武功，每笔招式皆看似简单，实则曲折之间隐藏无数攻守态势和精妙变化，若非智虑超群之人难解其意
column2: A martial philosophy where subtle expressions carry deep meaning. Each strike appears simple but contains complex offensive and defensive possibilities hidden within.

column1: 源于敦煌飞天壁画中的奇绝剑法，其招式需纵跃而上后凌空直下，剑光自天上而来，真如银瓶乍破水光泄，九天星河落凡间
column2: A Sword inspired by the Dunhuang flying apsaras murals. It requires leaping high into the air and striking downward, with sword light descending like a shattered silver bottle or falling stars.

column1: 赵胤宗所创，玄妙无比，威力无穷，可将修习者的体魄经脉发挥至天人境界，从而获得经天纬地之能，号称当世第一内功。
column2: Created by Zhao Yinzong, this is an immensely profound and powerful inner technique capable of pushing the practitioner’s body and meridians to a transcendent level, granting world-shaking abilities and reputed as the strongest internal art of its time.

column1: 长乐帮主乐无疾成名绝技，刀势玲珑剔透，乍看之下一览无余，实则蕴含无数精妙无比的刀意，再严密之防御也如透明一般
column2: The signature technique of Changle Gang leader Le Wuji; the blade intent appears open and transparent at first glance, yet conceals countless exquisite subtleties — even the tightest defense becomes like glass before it

column1: 颇为艰深的罗汉堂秘传内功，其内劲浑厚，吐息澎湃，真气游走全身，以精炼体魄兼得硬功修习之效，可谓一举两得之奇功
column2: A footwork technique of sudden takeoff and rapid lateral movement, whose explosive power allows the practitioner to evade most common attacks.

column1: 3月上旬清明节既是节气，又是节日。正值春季气清景明，万物萌发，生机勃勃，也是民众扫墓祭祖，追怀先人的节日。
column2: The Qingming Festival falls in early March. It is both a solar term and a traditional festival. As spring brings clear skies and bright scenery, all things begin to sprout and thrive. It is also a time for people to tend to ancestral graves, make offerings to their ancestors, and commemorate those who came before them.

column1: 一支极为精巧的机关假手，可藏于袖袍之中，其手中握有兵刀，挥砍突刺与真手相差无几，猝然伸出攻敌，常人难以防备
column2: A highly refined mechanical prosthetic hand that can be concealed within a sleeve. It holds blades inside its palm, allowing slashing and stabbing almost indistinguishable from a real hand, making sudden attacks extremely difficult to defend against.

column1: 为行动不便之人特制的战车，其轮轴可高速进退平移，且装备刀枪剑盾等多种攻防兵刃，堪称神机门机巧器械之至高杰作
column2: A mobile war chariot designed for those with limited mobility. Its wheels allow rapid forward, backward, and lateral movement, and it is equipped with various weapons such as blades, spears, swords, and shields—representing a pinnacle of Mechanist craftsmanship.

column1: 五毒教至毒暗器银针，细如牛毛，遍体漆黑，中者周身溃烂且不断流出黑色脓血，形状凄惨恐怖，江湖中人见之无不胆寒
column2: The Five Poisons Sect's most poisonous hidden weapon needle; fine as ox hair and jet black all over — those struck suffer rotting flesh throughout the body with continuous black pus and blood seeping out; the sight is so horrifying that jianghu people tremble at the mere sight of it

column1: 从叫花子替人哭丧之动作中演化而出，以棍点地，然后快速出击，棍势诡谲凶猛，更兼使用者狂呼乱嚎，真如丧考妣一般
column2: Evolved from the motions of beggars hired to wail at funerals; the staff taps the ground then strikes swiftly — the moves are deceptive and fierce, and the user's wild howling truly sounds like one mourning a deceased parent

column1: 双掌急速挥舞化作残影无数，便如千掌同出一般，功力稍弱之人根本无从判断实掌从何方向而来，往往左支右绌难以抵挡
column2: A brushwork technique that appears casual but is in fact full of subtle transformations. Sweeps, dots, and strokes create mist and storm-like effects, painting power with flowing ink-like momentum.

column1: 发菩提之心，以大智慧教化他人的佛门杵法，中此杵者若邪念不深或能脱离苦海，若冥顽不灵则如遭当头棒喝，瘫倒当场
column2: All kinds of worldly troubles arise from the words “desire” and “emotion.” Those who practice this mental method must abandon both. When free of sorrow and joy, Inner Force flows smoothly, and effort yields twice the result with half the work.

column1: 古朴易学，力道奇大之少林爪法，拳掌坚硬逾钢，手指开砖如泥，致敌伤残于瞬息间，也因威力过大，戒律规定不得滥用
column2: A simple but powerful claw technique. The hands become as hard as steel, capable of breaking stone, and can severely injure opponents instantly. Due to its destructive power, its use is restricted by monastic rules.

column1: 在枪头安装诸多火药和发烟装置的霹雳堂独门枪术，待出枪之时激发，火光冲天，浓烟滚滚，其声势令人胆寒，不敢靠近
column2: A spear technique equipped with multiple fire and smoke-triggering mechanisms along the shaft. When activated during thrusting, it produces blinding flames and thick smoke, instilling fear and preventing close approach.

column1: 少林菩提院秘传棍法，取文殊菩萨之智慧，招式变化无穷，所含佛法禅机亦极为精深，由大智慧之人使出，方显精妙非凡
column2: A sword technique where the blade is shaken rapidly, producing high- and low-pitched metallic vibrations that disrupt the opponent’s thoughts and disturb their focus.

column1: 庄者四通八达之大道也，此功法共天地之心、龙鹤风云、大小幽明道路十二条，条条皆是修持气脉，元养筋骨之精妙法门
column2: This technique represents a great, all-connected path: it contains the “heart of heaven and earth,” “dragon, crane, wind and cloud,” and twelve great routes of light and shadow. Every path is a profound method of cultivating qi channels and strengthening bones and tendons.

column1: 救治走火入魔者时，需以掌力化去其体内淤积乱行之内息。对敌时，此掌法也可化去其丹田所蕴含之内息，使其虚弱无比
column2: When treating someone afflicted by qi deviation, palm force is used to dissolve the stagnant and chaotic inner breath in their body; in combat, this palm method can dissolve the inner force stored in the enemy's dantian, leaving them weakened

column1: 此掌法擅长以绵密内力入侵敌人体内，注入数股极寒真气沿经脉乱窜逆行，中者便是日常行动亦力不从心，自然无法再战
column2: This palm technique infiltrates the opponent’s body with dense Inner Force, injecting multiple strands of extreme cold qi that travel chaotically through the meridians. The victim loses control of movement and can no longer fight.

column1: 此步法气势威猛，一往无前，如阎罗王大开鬼门关，其内力携劲风呼号，化作妖魔鬼怪奔涌而出，常人见之无不恐惧惊慌
column2: This footwork's momentum is fierce and unstoppable — like the King of Hell opening the gates of the underworld, the inner force howls like wind, surging out in the form of demons and monsters; ordinary people who see it are overwhelmed with fear and panic

column1: 武绝义所夺得的龙胤归藏功一部分，融入了飞龙门心法后，变为一门可大大提升修为者力道和体魄，颇为霸道强悍的功法
column2: A fragment of the “Dragon Origin Hidden Scripture” obtained by Wu Jueyi. After merging it with Flying Dragon Sect inner techniques, it became a domineering method that greatly enhances strength and physical power.

column1: 相传此魔功竟是一名走火入魔之高僧所创，其劲道凶狠狂暴，逆势而行，能伤人经脉，损人修为，江湖人士无不畏惧三分
column2: Said to have been created by a monk who had suffered qi deviation; its force is fierce and violent, running contrary to natural flow — it can damage the enemy's meridians and deplete their cultivation; the entire jianghu fears it

column1: 纯净无比之真气灌注百脉，如潮汐涨落填满周身，可将五脏六腑，四肢百胲中的污秽一一洗净，使人脱胎换骨，形同再造
column2: A guqin composition attributed to Bo Ya of the Spring and Autumn period. Its melody is exquisite and emotionally overwhelming; each performance ends with a broken string, symbolizing the rarity of true understanding.

column1: 能生成若有似无罡气之玄妙心法，调息时至阴至柔，对敌时至阳至刚，大成后周身三寸范围如有无形障壁，常人不能近之
column2: A subtle qi-manifesting cultivation method that creates an almost invisible protective barrier around the body; in its perfected form, nothing can approach within a few inches.

column1: 自霓裳羽衣舞姿中演化而来，其身形与力道时而飘然转旋回雪轻，时而嫣然纵送游龙惊，再平凡之招式也能生出无穷变化
column2: A martial form derived from the dance of celestial garments (neon feather robe dance), with movements that shift between drifting elegance and dragon-like power, producing endless variation even in simple techniques.

column1: 身形拔地而起，扶摇直上可至数丈之高的超绝轻功，功力深厚者更能以真气幻化九道身影，同进同退，见者无不惊异莫名
column2: A supreme Movement Art allowing the body to rise several meters into the air. Masters can even create nine afterimages that move in perfect synchronization, astonishing all who witness it.

column1: 世外高人于泰山之巅观日出，见云雾翻涌如海，腾涌而上所领悟的步法。功成者可踏云而上，步步高升直至凌空数十丈
column2: A footwork technique inspired by a sage observing sunrise from Mount Tai, allowing the practitioner to step upward through clouds and even reach dozens of meters into the air.

column1: 于心中观想日月，同时掷出两枚转轮之法，其形貌轨迹皆同日月，一阳一阴，一起一落，日月同辉之时，便能照澈万物
column2: A dual-wheel technique in which two discs are thrown while visualizing the sun and moon. Their trajectories mirror yin and yang, and when synchronized, they illuminate and reveal all things.

column1: 以红矾炼制而成的剧毒红色粉末，中毒者上吐下泻，随后很快肌肉麻痹，全身痉挛，若不及时救治，少顷便会窒息而亡
column2: A virulent red powder refined from red alum; those poisoned suffer vomiting and diarrhea, followed rapidly by muscle paralysis and full-body convulsions — without prompt treatment, death by suffocation follows shortly

column1: 传说乃是西王母于昆仑山所授，极尽锋锐之剑招，发挥十成威力时，风云际会，天地变色，心怀邪念之散仙亦当场伏诛
column2: Said to have been transmitted by the Queen Mother of the West on Kunlun Mountain; a supremely sharp sword art — at full power, clouds gather and the world changes color, and even errant immortals with wicked hearts are immediately struck down

column1: 传说祝融乃南方火神，此功法可催逼丹田热度至极限，使气血滚沸，内息如岩浆流淌，其劲道喷吐之时有烧融万物之威
column2: A legendary method inspired by the Fire God Zhurong. It forces Inner Force to reach extreme heat, causing blood and qi to surge like molten lava, with strikes capable of melting and destroying all things.

column1: 劲道威猛，招式亦不失精妙之少林正宗掌法，出手时需讲求了无杂念，心怀智慧与慈悲，方能发挥制敌奇功，伏魔定邪
column2: A Shaolin palm technique that combines powerful Inner Force with precision and discipline. It requires a mind free of distractions, guided by wisdom and compassion, to fully realize its demon-subduing potential.

column1: 多名顶尖工匠耗时数年方能打造而成的龙形机关兽，此物一出，地动山摇，群邪辟易，妖魔俯首，已得真龙三分之威矣
column2: A dragon-shaped mechanized beast built by master craftsmen over several years. When deployed, it shakes the earth and scatters evil forces, possessing a fraction of true dragon-like might that forces demons and monsters to submit.

column1: 天元位于棋盘中央，罕有起手落于此处，然此功反其道而行，出手即射击身体中央各经脉要道，攻其不备以求一击得手
column2: A technique derived from positioning on the central point of a chessboard (the “tianyuan”). Though such a move is rare in Go, this method instead strikes directly at the opponent’s central meridian points for a surprise decisive hit.

column1: 威力惊人内力消耗也极大的指法，以强大劲道专攻要害薄弱处，即便硬功卓绝之人，一旦罩门被击中，也难免为之洞穿
column2: A meditation method for observing internal organ energy states until all perception dissolves into unity.

column1: 少林闻名江湖之硬功绝技，其气劲化为金钟遮罩全身，任刀枪棍棒袭来，只听一声钟声巨响，或震颤弹开，或摧折当场
column2: A famous Shaolin defensive art that condenses Inner Force into a “Golden Bell” barrier around the body. Incoming attacks may be deflected or shattered upon impact.

column1: 德源长老仿猿猴姿态所创拳法，效猿之长臂为形，仿猿之灵快为意，发劲自背、肩、肘贯通一气，放长击远，攻守灵活
column2: A monkey-style boxing method created by Elder Deyuan. It imitates the monkey’s long reach and agility, with force flowing through back, shoulders, and elbows for extended and flexible strikes.

column1: 战国奇人支离益为斩杀梦中蛟龙所创，然终其一生未得使用，铸剑后人将之改成了绝妙的刀法，每招每式均属世间罕见
column2: Created by the Warring States eccentric Zhi Liyi to slay a flood dragon in a dream — yet he never got to use it in his lifetime; Sword Forging descendants later transformed it into an exquisite blade art where every move and form is a rarity in this world

column1: 抑扬顿挫，刚柔并济的书法功夫，以铁画出击时苍劲有力，以银钩防御时柔转秀丽，若其中一式修炼不精便会失其神韵
column2: A calligraphy-based martial art combining strength and softness. Iron brush strokes are powerful and forceful, while silver-hook defenses are supple and elegant; a single flaw in training causes loss of harmony and style.

column1: 此剑已然超脱常法，登大道境界，手中无剑亦能挥手以剑气伤人，招式不着形貌，不留痕迹，可谓大音希声，大道无形
column2: A transcendent sword realm where the practitioner no longer needs a physical sword; sword qi alone can strike invisibly and without form.

column1: 此功法能在丹田之中生成一股混沌无匹的横练真气，左奔右突，狂轰乱撞，若不能驾驭此力道，便会走火入魔狂舞而亡
column2: This art generates a chaotic and unmatched horizontal-training true qi in the dantian that rampages left and right — if one cannot control this force, qi deviation follows and the practitioner dances wildly to their death

column1: 此歌诀壮怀激烈，豪气干云，需以手指一边弹击剑刃，一边吟咏历代侠客风姿，其隐意颇深，只有深谙剑道者方能领会
column2: A sword song technique requiring the practitioner to strike the sword while reciting heroic verses. Its hidden meaning is deep, understood only by those who truly comprehend sword intent.

column1: 相传乃孔明所创巨型连发弩，现已失传。此为神机门尚在试验中的复刻品，其威力已是惊人，破砖石之墙如摧枯拉朽尔
column2: A reconstructed version of a legendary multi-shot crossbow allegedly created by Zhuge Liang. Though incomplete, the Mechanist Sect’s experimental replica already possesses devastating power, easily shattering stone walls.

column1: 相传是纯阳祖师吕洞宾所创之剑术，招式沉雄古逸，力道绵绵，使此术者当翦除邪恶，斩杀凶顽，消除浮世不平之事。
column2: A sword technique attributed to Lu Dongbin, powerful yet ancient in tone, focused on eliminating evil and restoring justice through righteous force.

column1: 至阳至刚之内功心法，其劲力汹涌澎湃，霸道无匹，无法无天，横冲直撞之时甚至会伤及己身，非功力雄厚者难以掌控
column2: A supremely yang and hard inner art; its force surges and dominates without restraint — when fully unleashed it can even harm the user, and only those with deep cultivation can control it

column1: 食指中指并拢伸直，如剑指向敌方之手势，可借此测算敌我距离和行动方位，从而于高手相争之时攻敌必取，料敌机先
column2: A sword-hand gesture technique using the index and middle finger together like a blade. It helps measure distance and predict enemy movement for precise preemptive strikes.

column1: 三清者，玉清上清太清三胜景也，此剑法一招三剑，看似从三个方位刺向敌人，实则最终攻击同一点，可谓精妙非凡
column2: A “Three Pure Ones” Sword where a single move splits into three apparent strikes, yet all converge on one point—highly refined and deceptive.

column1: 九天玄女通晓兵法数术，因此剑法虽只有九式，却蕴含机巧变化万千，九剑尽出便能组成剑阵，被笼罩者插翅亦难飞
column2: The Nine Heavens Mystic Maiden’s Sword: only nine forms, yet containing endless variations. When fully unleashed, it forms a lethal sword formation.

column1: 以虚招为主，颇具观赏性之棍法，其招式棍击两头，四面开花，舞得水泼不入，除少林弟子外也深得杂耍卖艺者喜爱
column2: A visually elaborate staff technique based on feints. Its movements strike both ends of the staff, creating wide-ranging motion that forms an impenetrable defense; it is also favored in performances.

column1: 传说茅山祖师抱朴子曾因泄露天机遭五雷轰顶，以深厚修为方才保全性命，并领悟了这一以内息引动天雷的无上法门
column2: Legend says the Maoshan ancestor Baopuzi was once struck by five thunderbolts for revealing heaven's secrets; only his deep cultivation saved his life, and he used the experience to realize this supreme art of drawing heavenly thunder through inner breath

column1: 传说阴间鬼差黑白无常使一对杀威棍，专行赏善罚恶、勾人魂魄之事，阴狠诡谲，险招频出，稍有不慎便会命丧棍下
column2: Legend says the underworld runners Black and White Impermanence wield a pair of punishing staffs, dispensing rewards and punishments and claiming souls — sinister and deceptive with dangerous moves at every turn; a moment's carelessness means death beneath the staff

column1: 依北斗七星方位所行步法，初时款款而来，此后愈急愈促，直至身形缓缓飘升，于空中回转不落，颇有羽化登仙之意
column2: A footwork method based on the Big Dipper constellation. Movements begin slowly, then accelerate until the body seems to rise and circle mid-air like ascending immortals.

column1: 修习者需用手掌快速拍打灼热铁砂，直至难以忍受，功成后则掌心血红，掌力附带灼热真气，所中之处立时皮焦肉烂
column2: The practitioner must rapidly slap burning hot iron sand with the palms until it becomes unbearable; once mastered the palms turn blood red and palm force carries scorching true qi — wherever it strikes the flesh immediately chars and burns

column1: 修炼强大劲道和深厚内力的少林正宗心法，功成者即便一袈裟掷出，也有铺天盖地之威势，足以惩凶除恶，守护众生
column2: A core Shaolin internal cultivation method that builds strong energy and deep internal power. A master of this art can throw even a robe with overwhelming force capable of subduing evil and protecting all beings.

column1: 八仙之首铁拐李所传奇门，有劈金碎石之威能，其中更有将铁拐一击掷出，直捣黄龙，再以内劲吸回手中的神奇招式
column2: A miraculous chi technique attributed to Tieguai Li. It includes throwing a staff to strike and then recalling it with Inner Force, as if guided by invisible control.

column1: 吴道子所绘钟馗像之机锋演化而成，粗看下招式狂野鄙陋，却大有删繁就简，杀气凛然之意，奸邪群小见之无不胆寒
column2: Evolved from the technique depicted in Wu Daozi's painting of Zhong Kui; at first glance the moves seem wild and crude, yet they are refined to eliminate all excess — fierce with killing intent, causing all villains to tremble at the sight

column1: 在天山峰顶极寒之地修炼而成的内功心法，被此内劲击中者，冰肌蚀骨，血脉凝固，可谓一只脚已踏入黄泉幽冥之中
column2: An internal cultivation method trained in the extreme cold atop the Tianshan peak. Those struck by its force suffer frostbitten flesh and bone erosion, blood vessels freezing—already half a step into the underworld.

column1: 大气挥洒，笔若游龙之功法，在大量华丽虚招间，隐藏着几式点睛之笔专攻敌人周身要穴，此招一出，无有不中之理
column2: A sweeping, grand brush-style martial method. Amid elaborate feints lie decisive strikes aimed at vital acupoints; once unleashed, it is nearly impossible to avoid.

column1: 天山派阴寒招法，凌厉一指之下，寒风激射而出，如刮骨钢刀袭来，即便奋力挡下此招者，其周身衣饰亦难免被撕碎
column2: A cold, vicious technique of the Tianshan sect. A single sharp finger strike releases freezing wind like a bone-cutting blade; even if blocked, the opponent’s clothing is often shredded.

column1: 少林外门弟子常用，以齐眉长棍使出之棍法，要求身棍合一，力透棍尖，出棍时风声呼啸，圆转有力，颇有几分威势
column2: A long staff technique used by outer disciples, requiring unity between body and weapon. It produces strong wind sounds and circular, forceful movements, carrying considerable momentum.

column1: 峨眉派进阶内功心法，强调灵感领悟，以道法自然为宗旨，令身心均回归混沌自然之境，自可以祛病强身，充盈经脉
column2: An advanced Mount Emei internal cultivation method emphasizing insight and natural understanding, allowing body and mind to return to primal harmony and strengthen meridians.

column1: 崆峒派绝学，将阴阳两股内息彻底分离，再行融合，离合间可产生强悍的真气，偏折来袭攻势，裂石开山，无坚不摧
column2: A Kongtong secret art that separates yin and yang Inner Force and recombines it to produce powerful force capable of deflecting attacks and shattering stone.

column1: 崆峒派轻功绝学，可凌空虚渡，踏雁而行，崆峒祖师更是曾足踏七雁，在各山峰间穿行如履平地，世人见之无不叹服
column2: A legendary Movement Art allowing aerial movement by stepping across flying geese; the founder was said to traverse mountains by treading on seven geese.

column1: 此掌法招势直上直下，看似平平无奇，却擅长不以手掌本身，而以掌中所含凌厉气劲伤人，故其距离亦远于寻常掌法
column2: This palm technique strikes straight up and down. It appears ordinary, but it does not injure through the palm itself—rather through the fierce internal qi contained within the palm. Therefore its effective range is greater than ordinary palm techniques.

column1: 盘腿打坐内观，可视自身脏腑气脉五色盛衰之相，直至影相发白融为一体，自感遍体舒爽，烦恼去尽，入清净之境矣
column2: A seated meditation method of inner observation, allowing one to perceive the five-colored states of internal organs and qi flow. Eventually all images merge into white unity, bringing complete calm and clarity.

column1: 相传邪道围攻少林时，有一后厨头陀持烧火棍迎战，力败数十高手后失踪。众僧皆称为紧那罗王法相显身，故得此名
column2: A mental cultivation method inspired by Zhuangzi’s “Butterfly Dream,” requiring deep sleep meditation and the forgetting of self. In this state of unity, Inner Force naturally arises.

column1: 相传阎罗王曾学尽天下刀法，并以此创出这一无所不用其极的最强杀戮法门，因其凶险异常，稍有不慎便会走火入魔
column2: It is said that Yama mastered all forms of sabre techniques and created this ultimate killing art that uses every possible method without restraint. Due to its extreme danger, even slight mistakes can lead to qi deviation and loss of control.

column1: 结合道家理念将一阴一阳两股内力调和成混元气劲的功法。此劲奔流无匹，更兼延绵不绝，便是内家高手也忌惮三分
column2: A cultivation technique that harmonizes yin and yang energies into a unified force. The resulting energy flow is continuous and overwhelming, even to experienced internal martial artists.

column1: 茅山独门轻功，需双腿肌肉放松，完全以内劲驱动腿脚。因而不损耗体力，内息越深厚者其奔行速度越快，耐力越久
column2: A unique Maoshan Movement Art; the leg muscles must be completely relaxed with the legs driven entirely by inner force — thus it does not consume stamina, and the deeper the inner breath, the faster and longer-lasting the running speed

column1: 茅山道剑最高境界，可化虚为实，化气为剑，在剑锋形成三尺白芒，吹毛立断，削铁如泥，江湖中罕有人敢撄其锋芒
column2: The highest realm of Maoshan Dao sword; can transform void into substance, qi into sword — forming a three-chi white blade edge that can cut hair and slice iron like mud; few in the jianghu dare to face its edge

column1: 融汇儒道易三家之神妙经典：太玄经上卷，需于正午时分汲取皓日之精华，日积月累方能修得此至阳至刚之磅礴内息
column2: A profound scripture integrating Confucian, Daoist, and Yijing traditions. The upper volume requires absorbing the essence of the midday sun to cultivate extreme yang energy over time.

column1: 融汇儒道易三家之神妙经典：太玄经下卷，需于午夜时分汲取皎月之精华，日积月累方能修得此至阴至柔之浩渺内息
column2: A complementary lower volume requiring absorption of moonlight at midnight, cultivating extreme yin energy. Long-term practice yields vast, refined Inner Force.

column1: 霸刀门专攻盔甲防护薄弱位置之绝技，一旦连接处被砍断，敌人周身铠甲便轰然落地，此后自然破绽百出，不堪一击
column2: A targeted armor-breaking technique that strikes weak structural points; once joints are severed, armor collapses, exposing the opponent completely.

column1: 一次发出七枚透骨钢钉之手法，可同时攻击七个不同部位，其中暗含星宿阵法之理，唯有聪慧过人者方能完全掌握
column2: A technique that fires seven bone-piercing steel nails at once, targeting seven different locations simultaneously; embedded within it are the principles of star formation arrays — only those of exceptional intelligence can fully master it

column1: 五指张开如蒲扇挥舞的掌法，刚猛霸气，力道惊人，击出劲风刮到脸上都会隐隐作痛，若着之难免被击退数尺之远
column2: A palm art with five fingers spread wide like a cattail fan; fierce and domineering with stunning force — even the wind generated on impact is painful to the face, and those struck are sent flying several chi

column1: 令周身血脉逆行之奇功，可将他人血液吸入自身体内恢复元气，因异种血液排斥反应，时常也会让使用者陷入癫狂
column2: A mystical technique that reverses the flow of blood throughout the body and can absorb others’ blood to restore one’s vitality. Due to rejection reactions from foreign blood, it often causes the user to descend into madness.

column1: 以真气驱动手中剑招，可将宝剑脱手数寸再以内劲吸回，因此招法飘逸绝尘，变幻莫测，旁人观之如仙人御剑一般
column2: Drives the sword technique in hand with true qi; the sword can be released several cun from the hand and drawn back with inner force — the moves are thus ethereal and unpredictable, appearing to onlookers like an immortal commanding a flying sword

column1: 传说乃目盲高人所创，以内力催发极为尖细之声响，再根据声响反射进行定位的神奇绝技，能令周遭敌人无所遁形
column2: A technique said to be created by a blind master, using extremely subtle Inner Force to produce sound-based detection and locate enemies.

column1: 保持纯阳童子身越久，功力修为就越深厚强大的内功心法，其护身罡气可御劲卸力，折铁分金，令运功者免受伤痛
column2: A internal cultivation method that rewards long-term preservation of pure yang chastity; its protective aura can deflect force, break metal, and shield the practitioner from injury.

column1: 公输班所创，同时凝结了神机门历代高人无数智慧心血，机关术之核心法门，只有长老以上地位者方能一睹其全貌
column2: The core doctrine of mechanical engineering attributed to Gongshu Ban, refined through generations of Mechanist masters. Its full content is only accessible to elders of the sect or higher ranks.

column1: 内外兼修，威力无穷之少林无上正宗掌法，出掌时金光四溢，声威震天，所到之处无论砖石金铁，皆会被碾作齑粉
column2: A method based on the chessboard with its 19x19 grid. Two opponents engage in silent combat through strategic placement; though resembling Go, it is in fact a martial system of battlefield reasoning.

column1: 可迅速麻痹心脉大脑之五毒教特制迷药，中者如饮孟婆汤般，迷离惝恍，神情恍惚，乃至当场昏迷不醒，丧失记忆
column2: A special Five Poisons Sect narcotic that quickly paralyzes the heart meridian and brain; those affected become dazed and confused as if having drunk Mengpo soup — falling into a stupor and losing consciousness on the spot, with memory loss

column1: 唐门暗器种类纷繁复杂，大小重量，使用方法不尽相同，此手法却能一次发出数十种暗器，颇有花雨漫天飘零之意
column2: The Tang Sect's hidden weapons are numerous and varied in size, weight, and method; yet this technique fires dozens of different weapons at once — like a shower of flowers drifting through the sky

column1: 天师道隐匿于冲虚真经中的精妙内功法门，遵循天地含精，万物化生等自然之理，可令修习者祛病延年，功力大增
column2: A refined inner art hidden within the Chongxu Sutra of the Tianshi Dao school; following the natural principles of heaven and earth containing essence and all things transforming — it can cure illness, extend life, and greatly increase the practitioner's power

column1: 天竺佛门掌法，出招前需摒除杂念，屏息凝神，随后一掌击出，金光迸射，邪魔崩摧，但若心有杂念威力亦会大减
column2: A Buddhist palm technique requiring absolute mental clarity before striking. When executed, it emits golden light that destroys evil, but loses power if the mind is disturbed.

column1: 将尾部绑有火药的箭支装入竹筒，以引线相连而成的机关装置，可瞬间发射大量火箭，一时间火光冲天，声势惊人
column2: A bamboo rocket system that fires fire-tipped arrows using fuse ignition, producing massive explosions and intense shock effects.

column1: 少林传统倒立功夫，初时以十指撑地，逐步递减，直至能以一指维持不倒即为功成，此后自是筋骨勇壮，力道惊人
column2: A traditional Shaolin inversion training method. Practitioners begin with ten fingers supporting the body, gradually reducing support until they can balance on a single finger, resulting in exceptional strength.

column1: 尾部绑有绳索的球形炸弹，快速甩动后掷出，可飞行数丈之远引发爆炸，由于操控手法复杂，霹雳堂高手方能使用
column2: A spherical bomb tied with a rope at its tail. When swung and thrown, it can travel several zhang before detonating. Due to its complex handling, only skilled practitioners can use it safely.

column1: 此七式刀法每招名称中皆有一“杀”字，一刀比一刀更为邪气逼人，杀意旺盛，若七刀尽出则再无退路，不死不休
column2: A blade art of seven forms, each with the character "kill" in its name — each move more sinister and saturated with killing intent than the last; if all seven are unleashed there is no turning back — it ends only in death

column1: 此刀法孤傲诡谲，去势如同天边一轮残月，以弧线向下勾连，寒冷皎洁之刀光亦四下照射，能够穿透世间一切壁障
column2: A crescent-moon-like blade technique whose arc-shaped strikes emit cold, penetrating light capable of cutting through barriers.

column1: 相传乃无名女冠所创之剑法，轻巧灵动，曼妙翩跹，如蝴蝶飞舞，花瓣飘散，颇具观赏性，于剑法修为亦大有裨益
column2: A graceful sword style created by an unnamed Daoist nun. It is light, fluid, and butterfly-like, resembling petals drifting in the air, with strong aesthetic refinement.

column1: 相传药王祖师孙思邈从黄帝内经中所悟隐秘之法，并凭此享寿元一百四十有余，乃调经养元，延年益寿之至高法门
column2: Said to have been derived by the Medicine King ancestor Sun Simiao from the Huangdi Neijing; with this method he reportedly lived to over one hundred and forty years — the supreme art for regulating meridians, nourishing yuan, and extending life

column1: 茅山派以意念引导腹部吐纳的进阶心法，传说修得胎息者可自服内气，握固守一，如孕胎中婴儿不以口鼻便能呼吸
column2: An advanced Maoshan heart method for guiding abdominal breathing through mental intent; legend says those who achieve fetal breathing can sustain themselves on inner qi alone, sealing the body and guarding the one — breathing like an unborn infant without mouth or nose

column1: 药王谷虽治病救人之所，其用毒亦是一绝。此手法将毒物暗藏掌心随招式拍出，所中之处立时腐化溃烂，痛苦难忍
column2: Although Yaowang Valley is a place of healing, its poison arts are equally formidable; this technique hides poison in the palm and releases it with each strike — wherever it lands, the flesh immediately rots and festers in unbearable agony

column1: 菩提心乃大乘佛法一切功德修行之基，少林弟子需先发菩提之心，生正信之力，此后方能循大道指引，入圆满境界
column2: The Bodhi mind is the foundation of Mahayana Buddhist cultivation. Shaolin disciples must first develop this enlightened intent and faith in righteousness before progressing toward full realization.

column1: 虎落平阳，蛟入浅海，乃是作困兽之斗，集中全身力量博最后一击的丐帮绝学，在生死关头能够发挥出超常的威力
column2: Tiger on flat ground, dragon in shallow water — this is the Beggars Sect's supreme technique of a cornered beast making its last stand, concentrating all force into one final blow; at the moment of life and death it produces extraordinary power

column1: 西汉名将李广所传之步法，初看沉稳持重，虎步而行，而后逐渐加快，直至大步流星，气势惊人，宛如飞将军再世
column2: A footwork method passed down by the Western Han general Li Guang; at first steady and imposing like a tiger's stride, then gradually accelerating until striding like a meteor — as if the Flying General himself has returned

column1: 达摩祖师真传杖法，出神入化，精妙绝伦，更兼暗含禅机，能使人明心见性，幡然顿悟，堪称禅武合一之无上功法
column2: A martial method derived from Yan Zhenqing’s calligraphy style. Bold and forceful strokes resemble a general wielding a sword, striking with overwhelming authority.

column1: 逐渐加热内息之法，其真气形同炉火，先黑浊，后黄白，再青白，最终化为纯青，乃是功法纯熟，至阳至热之象征
column2: A method of gradually heating inner breath; the true qi is like furnace fire — first dark and turbid, then yellow-white, then blue-white, and finally pure blue — the ultimate symbol of mastery, supremely yang and supremely hot

column1: 遵循阴阳相生相克之理的奇特剑法，其招式一正一反，一攻一守，不断交错转换，每一剑都符合情理却又出人意料
column2: A sword style based on the principles of mutual generation and restraint of yin and yang. Its attacks alternate between offense and defense, constantly shifting in ways that remain logical yet unpredictable.

column1: 金刚宗至高内修秘法，修成者如蒙佛祖加持，运功时遍体佛光照耀万物，获不可思议之力量与智慧，可谓功德圆满
column2: The supreme internal cultivation method of the Vajra Sect. When mastered, the practitioner is bathed in Buddha-light, gaining immense power and wisdom akin to enlightenment.

column1: 镔铁打造的朱雀形机关兽，展翅腾飞时，其下方数个机关口可喷射火油，因而其所过之处无不烈焰冲天，火海燎原
column2: A vermilion bird–shaped mechanized beast forged from hardened iron. When it spreads its wings to fly, multiple vents beneath it spew fire oil, leaving a trail of roaring flames and a sea of fire wherever it passes.

column1: 需亲手打造，与自身身形相仿的人形傀儡，可在丝线牵引下做出各种诡异惊人的攻防姿势，常人见之如见妖法一般
column2: A humanoid puppet crafted to match the builder’s own physique. Controlled by silk threads, it can execute strange and unpredictable offensive and defensive movements, often appearing like sorcery to ordinary observers.

column1: 上应天命,下从人心之刀法，出手时引动全身霸道无比之劲道，去势威猛，勇往直前，可谓天命所归，所向披靡
column2: A blade art guided by “Heaven above, human will below,” channeling overwhelming force forward with unstoppable momentum.

column1: 丐帮进阶棍法，其招式粗中有细，乱中有序，若丐帮弟子围成圆阵使出，则棍影如荷花叶瓣迎风起伏，颇具声势
column2: An advanced Beggars Sect staff art; its moves are rough yet precise, chaotic yet ordered — when Beggars Sect members form a circular formation and use it together, the staff shadows rise and fall like lotus petals in the wind, creating an imposing sight

column1: 五指弯曲宛若龙爪，爪势缠着敌人手臂逆经脉而上，甫一接触便挣脱不得，寻常高手大多撑到第五缠便败下阵来
column2: Five fingers curl like a dragon's claw; the claw force wraps around the enemy's arm against the meridians — once contact is made it cannot be shaken off; most skilled fighters fall by the fifth coil

column1: 五毒教自先祖以来不断搜集而成，记载了无数虫蛇花草之毒理毒性及相生相克关系，故习此宝典，可知天下毒矣
column2: Compiled by the Five Poisons Sect from its ancestors onward, this text records the toxicology, properties, and mutual restraint relationships of countless insects, snakes, flowers, and plants; mastering this compendium means knowing all the poisons in the world

column1: 以硬功见长的刚猛掌法，每掌击出皆隐隐有金玉破空之声，砖石着之即碎，钢铁亦能击打弯折，足见其威力不凡
column2: A fierce hard-force palm art; each strike produces a faint sound like gold or jade splitting the air — bricks shatter on contact and even steel can be bent, showing its extraordinary power

column1: 以防御见长的掌法，运转舒展绵长，能用柔劲卸去来袭力道，无论对方如何使劲，皆如打在棉花上一般无从着力
column2: A defensive palm technique with long, flowing force that neutralizes incoming attacks, making all strength feel like striking cotton.

column1: 传承自天竺诸位高僧大德，密宗无上之佛法心髓，以简明诀要总摄见、修、行、果，佛门中人得之可谓如虎添翼
column2: A condensed essence of esoteric Buddhist teachings transmitted by great Indian monks. It summarizes view, practice, conduct, and result, greatly enhancing any practitioner who comprehends it.

column1: 传说达摩祖师曾借一芦苇漂渡长江，此功法虽已失传大半，但修习者仍可脚踩整捆芦苇漂行于水面数个时辰不沉
column2: A legendary technique inspired by Bodhidharma’s journey across the Yangtze River on a single reed. Though largely lost, it allows practitioners to traverse water surfaces on reeds for hours without sinking.

column1: 使体内真气沿十二经脉自动循环运行之心法，每循环一周内息便略微增强一分，因而更讲求细水长流，厚积薄发
column2: A meditative cultivation method where one enters stillness through Zen, forming the foundation of all Shaolin internal arts and spiritual practice.

column1: 供市井小民和武林人士宴饮作乐之所，陈设华丽，人声嘈杂，更有庄家在此开设赌局，吸引往来人士一试手气。
column2: A lively place for drinking, eating, and gambling entertainment.

column1: 修习者需先破除烦恼妄想，令身心进入绝对静止之境界，然后方能使出这消除世间苦难，令万物寂灭的玄妙刀法
column2: A Blade that requires the practitioner to eliminate all delusions and enter absolute stillness before execution, unleashing a profound strike that eradicates suffering and dissolves existence into silence.

column1: 南朝刘勰阐述文章笔法义理之巨著，其中包罗万象，开源发流，通晓此书后，各式秘籍中艰深之处自然迎刃而解
column2: A classic treatise on literary style from the Southern Dynasties, which encompasses a vast range of principles. Mastery of it allows one to understand the deeper structure of other martial manuals with ease.

column1: 天山乃雪岭苦寒之地，故而有此冰面行走之法，脚步轻巧灵动，审慎小心，稍有差池便会坠入寒冷刺骨的湖水中
column2: A movement method for walking on frozen surfaces in the mountains; careful footwork is required, or one risks falling into icy waters.

column1: 如同五虎狩猎群羊一般，从五个方位攻击敌人的棍法，挥舞起来势势相连，环环相扣，讲求围而不击，势在必得
column2: A five-direction encircling staff technique resembling tigers hunting sheep. Its strikes are continuous and interlinked, emphasizing encirclement and inevitable capture.

column1: 如蛤蟆一般蹲伏于地，姿势颇为不雅，实则是以静制动，蓄势待发之高深法门，一经发动，则排山倒海势不可挡
column2: Crouching low like a toad — an undignified posture, yet it is a profound method of stillness overcoming motion, waiting and gathering force; once unleashed, it moves mountains and overturns seas

column1: 对于防御严密之敌，如庖丁解牛般从薄弱处下手，攻击盔甲接缝处和守招死角处的刀招，对手法精准度要求很高
column2: A blade art that, like Pao Ding carving an ox, strikes at weak points against a heavily defended enemy — targeting gaps in armor and blind spots in defensive moves; requires very high precision of technique

column1: 将周身之无上力道凝聚于杵尖，以平常招式击出，便有石破天惊，鬼哭神嚎之威势，世间甲盾罕有能撄其锋芒者
column2: A technique that concentrates immense bodily force into the tip of a vajra staff, producing explosive power capable of shattering armor and steel.

column1: 将周身内力汇聚丹田反复催动炼化，如龙虎相争，直至阴阳调和水火相济，便是金丹练成之时，功力亦突飞猛进
column2: A method of gathering the whole body's inner force at the dantian and repeatedly driving and refining it — like the struggle of dragon and tiger — until yin and yang are harmonized and water and fire are in balance; at that moment the golden elixir is formed and cultivation leaps forward dramatically

column1: 将精气神混合为一，并凝聚于头顶玄关一窍的道家绝妙法门，功成者可革故鼎新，脱胎换骨，心神进入圣明境界
column2: A wondrous Daoist method of mixing essence, qi, and spirit into one and concentrating them at the crown acupoint; once achieved, the practitioner undergoes a complete renewal — reborn in body and spirit, the mind enters a state of sage-like clarity

column1: 少林至高身法，需破除执念，心静止水，目中空无一物，其身形如梦幻泡影，如露亦如电，稍纵即逝，无可捉摸
column2: A painting-inspired martial method that studies the opponent’s force, precision of strikes, and mental cultivation. The Hidden Pavilion uses painting as a means of training both body and mind.

column1: 峨眉派佛道融合之内功心法，以佛门莲花部密法为根，结合道家修炼与五行玄术，有流通经脉，运转周天之功效
column2: A Buddhist–Daoist fusion internal cultivation method. It combines lotus esoteric teachings with Daoist Five-Element theory to circulate qi through the meridians.

column1: 攻敌要害，倾力出击，是罕见的不留丝毫退路之杀招，难怪江湖皆称长乐帮刀法繁多，以恩断义绝一式最为伤人
column2: An attack on vital points with full commitment and no retreat whatsoever; it is no wonder the jianghu says that among Changle Gang's many blade arts, Severed Bond is the most devastating

column1: 春秋时伯牙所作，曲调高妙，余音绕梁，气劲飞射如流水自高山上倾泻而落，每奏一曲便断一弦，以示知音难觅
column2: A composition by Bo Ya from the Spring and Autumn period, known for its exquisite melody that lingers in the air. Its energy projectiles flow like water cascading from a mountain, and he famously breaks a string after each performance to signify the rarity of true understanding.

column1: 此剑法气劲冰寒无比，竟真能将空气中之水雾凝成霜雪，围绕剑身飘飞，挥舞之时便如漫天风雪侵袭，威力不俗
column2: A Sword with extremely cold Inner Force that can condense moisture in the air into frost and snow around the blade. When swung, it resembles a storm of snow and wind, with considerable power.

column1: 此拳法擅以内息催动拳劲，往往拳未发出，内劲已至。因内劲变化远胜拳掌，其招法犹如惊鸿之照影，瞬息万变
column2: This fist art skillfully uses inner breath to drive fist force — often the inner force arrives before the fist is thrown; because inner force changes far surpass those of Fist, its techniques flash like a fleeting reflection, changing in an instant

column1: 武当上乘内功心法，全篇十二关颇为艰涩，取天地阳气至丹田熔炉中反复精炼，修成后内息炽热无比，纯净清澈
column2: A high-level internal cultivation method of Wudang with twelve difficult stages. It refines yang energy within a “dantian furnace,” producing intensely pure and powerful Inner Force upon mastery.

column1: 武当山路之上，有百节陡峭阶梯连成竖直一线，以此步法纵跃而上如穿梭云间，一步十阶，倏忽间便可上下一轮
column2: A Movement Art practiced on the mountain steps of Wudang, where steep stairways are traversed in rapid bounds—appearing as if moving through clouds.

column1: 用于惩戒凶恶的恐怖刀法，刀刀攻人要害，却竟又刀刀不致人死地，中刀者如坠无间地狱，痛苦万分，嚎哭求饶
column2: A terrifying Blade used to punish evil. Each strike targets vital points yet avoids immediate death, causing extreme suffering akin to falling into an infernal realm.

column1: 看似东倒西歪，跌撞摇摆，实则形醉意不醉，处处暗含闪转腾挪，虚实混杂之法，应对者稍有疏忽便见阎王去也
column2: Appears to stumble and sway in all directions, yet the mind is clear while the body feigns intoxication; every movement conceals evasion and misdirection — a careless opponent will find themselves meeting the King of Hell

column1: 精巧绝伦的点穴手法，手指似兰花翘起，招式优雅，气度闲逸，看似柔弱无骨，却能于不动声色间制人多处要穴
column2: An exquisite acupoint-striking method. Fingers form an orchid shape; the movements are graceful yet can silently seal multiple pressure points.

column1: 达摩祖师授予普通僧众的强身健体拳法，招式严谨庄重，劲道有力，且贵在简洁明了，资质平庸者亦能快速掌握
column2: A basic strengthening fist technique taught by Bodhidharma to ordinary monks. It is structured, powerful, and easy to learn, making it accessible even to those of average talent.

column1: 一阴一阳，一柔一刚两种剑法融合而成，要求配合无间，切换迅速，若运用者思路稍有混乱，便难免错漏百出
column2: A sword style that fuses yin and yang, softness and hardness. The two aspects must be perfectly coordinated and switched rapidly; any confusion in intent leads to critical mistakes.

column1: 专攻筋骨关节处的掌法，中掌者初觉无甚大碍，待出手时才发觉自身筋骨已断裂受损，可见其内劲之阴柔歹毒
column2: A palm art specifically targeting joints and sinews; those struck initially feel little wrong, but when they try to act they find their sinews and bones already broken — showing the yin and sinister nature of its inner force

column1: 世人诸多烦恼皆因欲情二字而起，习此心法则需摒弃二者，无悲无喜之时，内息运行自然畅通无阻，事半功倍
column2: Worldly worries and troubles all arise from desire and emotion. This mental technique requires the practitioner to abandon both. When free of sorrow and joy, Inner Force flows smoothly without obstruction, making cultivation far more efficient.

column1: 丹青绘画对手劲之发力，指点之精准，心神之修养皆有极高要求，因而大隐阁有此假借绘画进行身心修炼之法
column2: A painting-based martial method that refines the strength of strikes, precision of pointing, and cultivation of the mind. The Hidden Great Pavilion uses this approach to train both body and spirit through the act of painting.

column1: 以女子心血和奇花饲养而成，中此毒者欲出手伤人之时，便感周身绵软，心如刀绞，好像要杀害至爱之人一般
column2: Cultivated by feeding a special flower with a woman's heart blood; when those struck by this poison attempt to harm someone, they feel their whole body go limp and their heart in agony — as if they were about to kill someone they love deeply

column1: 以深湛内力为基，催动一股炽热纯阳真气攻敌的指法武功，中招之处立时皮开肉绽，焦黑如炭，威力颇为骇人
column2: A finger technique that channels pure yang energy through profound Inner Force. Strikes leave the target burned and charred, with severe destructive power.

column1: 以珍珠打磨而成的水滴形暗器，在剧毒中泡制百日方能使用。中此者血脉爆裂，惨不忍睹，观音视之亦会落泪
column2: A teardrop-shaped hidden weapon polished from pearls, soaked in virulent poison for a hundred days before use; those struck suffer rupturing blood vessels in an agonizing sight — even Guanyin would weep at the sight

column1: 以连绵不断之手法发射钢针，其攻势密如骤雨，急如暴风，功力不足者，也只能如娇弱梨花般被雨打风吹而去
column2: Steel needles are fired in a continuous unbroken stream; the assault is dense as sudden rain and swift as a storm — those with insufficient power can only be battered like delicate pear blossoms in wind and rain

column1: 以黄铜浇铸成铜人，用手足胸背各部位拍打撞击，苦练而成的少林硬功，功成后周身刚硬，寻常拳脚触之立折
column2: A bronze-man training method in which the body is forged by striking a cast bronze figure with limbs and torso. Once mastered, the body becomes extremely rigid and resistant to ordinary physical attacks.

column1: 传说乃公输班遗作，匣中装有零件机巧万千，针对对敌之人所使武功兵刃进行临时组装，号称可破尽天下兵器
column2: A legendary mechanism attributed to Gongshu Ban, consisting of a box filled with countless modular components. It can be rapidly assembled in response to an opponent’s weapons or techniques, claiming to counter all forms of armament.

column1: 传说乃汉高祖刘邦斩白蛇之剑法，势若长虹，锋锐无匹，其剑气化为一道赤练激射而出，可斩尽天下不祥之物
column2: Said to be the sword art used by Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang when he slew the white serpent; surging like a rainbow and sharp beyond all others — the sword qi transforms into a crimson streak that can cleave all inauspicious things under heaven

column1: 传说是孔明所发明的机关锁，经神机门改造后，可钳制并锁住敌人的兵刃或四肢，只有智慧超群之人才能破解
column2: A legendary mechanism lock attributed to Zhuge Liang, later refined by the Shenji Sect; it can bind weapons or limbs and is extremely difficult to break.

column1: 传说虬龙需经九次蜕变，此矛亦有九重境界。每一重威力增进一筹，直到第九重使出便是惊天动地，神鬼难挡
column2: A spear technique said to have nine transformation stages, mirroring the nine metamorphoses of a mythical horned dragon. Each stage increases in power, with the ninth being so overwhelming that even ghosts and gods cannot withstand it.

column1: 使内息在丹田和经脉中不断翻滚沸腾的至阳心法，沸腾程度每增加一分，修习者的毅力和内功修为便更进一层
column2: A purely yang-aligned internal cultivation method that causes inner energy to boil and surge within the dantian and meridians. The more intense the boiling becomes, the stronger the practitioner’s willpower and internal cultivation grow.

column1: 供奉祭祀门派历代掌门先贤之所，同时设有陈列珍宝之展厅，以及研习技艺，鉴定珍宝所需的各类工具书籍。
column2: A place for worshiping past sect leaders, also serving as a hall for treasures and study of relics and appraisal texts.

column1: 假托神农之名的古代药学典籍，其中方剂分门别类，包罗万千，更兼君臣佐使，触类旁通之高深经脉运行法门
column2: An ancient pharmacological text claiming the name of Shennong; its formulas are categorized and all-encompassing, and also includes profound meridian circulation methods based on the principles of principal, minister, assistant, and guide herbs

column1: 共分五十四种打坐姿势，每种均可静坐十二个时辰，乃是少林僧人修禅所用，以静制动，修生养性的下盘功法
column2: A meditation system consisting of fifty-four seated postures, each capable of being held for twelve hours. It is used for cultivating stability and patience through stillness.

column1: 取上古名剑之名，以雌雄双剑所使出的剑法，一攻一守，一进一退，双剑配合完美，亲密无间，如生灵性一般
column2: Named after an ancient legendary sword; a sword art using a matched male and female pair — one attacks, one defends, one advances, one retreats — the two swords work in perfect harmony, as if possessed by a living spirit

column1: 唐门专练阴柔手劲之法，以此发出暗器，如丝线牵引一般，忽快忽慢，随心而动，或凌空停滞不落，极为精妙
column2: A Tang Sect method for training soft and yielding hand force; hidden weapons fired with this inner force move like thread on a string — alternately fast and slow, responsive to the will, even hovering in mid-air without falling — supremely refined

column1: 外劲威猛霸道，内劲怒涛汹涌的掌法，高手见之犹需避其锋芒，而贸然硬接此掌者，难免魂飞魄散，九死一生
column2: A palm technique combining violently powerful external force with surging Inner Force like raging waves. Even skilled fighters must avoid its edge; anyone who tries to block it head-on risks utter destruction and near-certain death.

column1: 大巧不工，大道无名，此剑法仅有图谱却无固定招式，讲求随机应变，自然妙悟，对使用者剑法造诣要求极高
column2: Great skill lies in the artless; the great way has no name — this sword art has diagrams but no fixed moves, relying on improvisation and natural insight; requires extremely high sword mastery

column1: 将体内七处要穴以真气相连的绝学，可形成一快速强劲的小周天循环，从而大大增加自身发力和经脉运行速度
column2: A technique linking seven major acupoints into a rapid internal circulation cycle, greatly increasing energy flow and power output.

column1: 将内息运于金针之上的独特心法，刺中穴位后，内劲如涓流渗入经脉，治病救人还是扰乱内息，全在一念之间
column2: A unique heart method that channels inner breath into golden needles; once a needle strikes an acupoint, inner force seeps in like a trickle into the meridians — whether to heal or disrupt is entirely a matter of intent

column1: 少林新晋弟子需每日下山打杂挑水，实为修行腿脚功夫，直至能山路上健步如飞，桶中水一滴不漏，方为大成
column2: Beginner Shaolin disciples must perform daily chores such as carrying water down the mountain, which in truth trains footwork and balance until they can move swiftly on mountain paths without spilling a single drop.

column1: 少林高僧扫地时所创，扫帚般贴地挥舞专攻下盘之棍法，其扫荡之势迅捷威猛，对手稍有不慎便会被掀翻在地
column2: A staff technique created by Shaolin masters while sweeping the monastery grounds. It uses a broom-like sweeping motion focused on attacking the lower body, capable of quickly toppling opponents.

column1: 崆峒派以奇门功夫闻名天下，此心法是专为此所创，其真气灵活多变，诡谲难测，配合各式奇门武功皆有妙效
column2: A specialized Inner Force method designed for Kongtong’s diverse martial arts. Its qi is flexible and unpredictable, supporting many strange techniques effectively.

column1: 息心静虑，蓄精养神，然后调动五脏真气导入丹田的道家上乘心法，可辟谷轻身，却老延年，大增练习者功力
column2: A Daoist internal cultivation method that refines essence and spirit, promotes longevity, lightness, and increased Inner Force.

column1: 本是园艺嫁接手法，经药王谷改进成一门复位关节，接骨正畸之绝技，对使用者手眼功夫和心智神识均有裨益
column2: Originally a horticultural grafting technique; refined by Yaowang Valley into a supreme skill for resetting joints and setting bones, benefiting the practitioner's hand-eye coordination and mental clarity

column1: 横冲直撞，一往无前之步法，其声威地动山摇，其去势所向披靡，试图阻挡之人轻则歪倒撞飞，重则伤筋断骨
column2: A footwork that charges forward without restraint — its momentum shakes the earth and its advance is irresistible; those who try to block it are at best sent stumbling and flying, at worst suffer broken sinews and bones

column1: 此针中空，内敷有阻止伤口闭合的毒药，若能命中要害，则立时血如泉涌，如不及时医治，难免气血流尽而亡
column2: This needle is hollow and coated with a poison that prevents wounds from closing; if it strikes a vital area, blood immediately gushes like a spring — without prompt medical treatment, the victim will inevitably bleed out

column1: 此鞭法看似狂舞乱挥，不成章法，却能在周身形成密不透风的鞭网，贸然近身者会立刻遭受狂风骤雨般的攻击
column2: A whip technique that appears chaotic but forms an impenetrable whip-net around the body, punishing anyone who approaches.

column1: 相传黄忠斩夏侯渊时所使，居高临下突袭刺击之枪法，其招式勇往无前，以威势取胜，一枪既出足以平定三军
column2: Said to have been used by Huang Zhong when he slew Xiahou Yuan; a downward surprise-thrust spear art — its moves advance without hesitation, winning through momentum — a single spear strike is enough to settle three armies

column1: 看似出手随意，实则妙化万千之笔法，或挥或扫，或点或刷，晕染云雾，绘制风雨，可谓水墨淋漓，气势潇洒
column2: A fluid and expressive brush technique that appears casual but is in fact highly refined. Movements such as sweeping, dotting, and smearing create mist-like illusions and storm-like imagery, producing a vivid ink-wash effect.

column1: 自老子道德经中解密而来，乃阐述宇宙运行规律，效天地之法指导修行，提纲挈领，正本清源之无上道家典籍
column2: A Taoist classic derived from Laozi’s Dao De Jing, used to guide cultivation according to the laws of nature and cosmic order.

column1: 蓬莱修真者大多追求长生，此法抱神以静，心如止水，直至目无所见，耳无所闻，入无穷之门，则内息自生矣
column2: A Penglai cultivation method aimed at longevity. It requires absolute stillness of spirit and a mind like still water; when sight and hearing fade into emptiness, Inner Force arises naturally.

column1: 蓬莱派独特运劲法门，可令剑尖高速颤动，舞出幻影剑花，使任何剑招都带有迷惑性，令敌人难以判断其走势
column2: A special energy manipulation method that causes the sword tip to vibrate at high frequency, producing illusion-like sword blossoms that confuse opponents’ perception.

column1: 试图以奇门数术之法，解释上天意志的墨家法门，若以此法掌控内力运行，统领周身经脉，修为便能获得精进
column2: A Mohist method that interprets heavenly Willpower through numerological and strategic computation; when applied internally, it is said to improve meridian circulation and cultivation efficiency.

column1: 铸剑山庄甲胄硬功之首，配合庄内锻造之重甲，反震之力极大，寻常兵刃触之立折，可谓一夫当关，万夫莫开
column2: The foremost armor hard qigong of Sword Forging Villa; combined with the heavy armor forged in the villa, its rebound force is immense — ordinary weapons shatter on contact; one man holds the pass against ten thousand

column1: 长乐帮顶级内功，将内息流转蕴含于喜怒哀乐情绪收放间，心随意动，劲由心生，无形无影，伤人于瞬息之间
column2: The Changle Gang's top inner art; inner breath flows through the expression of joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness — the force arises from the heart, invisible and intangible, injuring enemies in an instant

column1: 霹雳堂成名暗器，遍体漆黑的金属小球，以大力掷出撞击目标之时便会发生猛烈爆炸，不少武林高手命丧于此
column2: A famous hidden weapon of the Thunderclap Hall: a pitch-black metal sphere that detonates violently upon impact. Many martial experts have fallen victim to it.

column1: 专攻气脉要穴之阴狠刀法，可引异种真气侵入敌方丹田，消融内息，阻滞经脉，使其如销魂蚀骨般无力再战
column2: A cruel blade technique focused on vital energy channels and acupoints. It allows foreign true qi to invade the opponent’s dantian, dissolving Inner Force and blocking meridians, leaving the target weak and unable to continue fighting as if their very essence were being eroded.

column1: 专攻血脉要害之凶邪刀法，在伤敌之时可吸取气血充盈自身，而使用者也常因异种气血难以消化而陷入癫狂
column2: A vicious and sinister sabre technique that specifically targets vital blood vessels. While injuring the enemy, it can absorb their vital essence and blood to replenish the user, but the incompatible foreign blood often drives the practitioner into madness.

column1: 五指柔韧灵活，如百足蜈蚣在敌人周身攀爬游移，所过之处皆留黑紫印记，不多时便会溃烂化脓，颇为狠毒
column2: Five fingers nimble and flexible like a hundred-legged centipede crawling and moving around the enemy's body; wherever they pass, dark purple marks are left that soon fester and suppurate — quite vicious

column1: 从口中喷吐能迷惑人心神的毒雾之绝技，中者丧魂失魄，精神萎靡，苗疆女子有时会用此法对付中意之男子
column2: A supreme technique of spitting a poisonous fog from the mouth that bewilders the mind; those struck lose their soul and grow listless — Miao women sometimes use this on men who have caught their fancy

column1: 传说乃李太白所创，其精要在于剑意而非招式。得其神髓者剑势变化雄奇，奔逸绝伦，颇得太白诗歌之神韵
column2: Said to have been created by Li Taibai; its essence lies in sword intent rather than technique — those who grasp its spirit display a sword force of extraordinary, unrestrained brilliance, carrying the spirit of Taibai's poetry

column1: 传说乃重阳真人所传绝学，蕴含颇多道法心得和修真妙理，对于修习道家典籍和武功之人有提纲挈领之妙用
column2: A supreme technique said to have been passed down by Master Chongyang. It contains profound Taoist insights and cultivation wisdom, offering guidance to those who study Taoist classics and martial arts alike.

column1: 传闻乃达摩祖师所创之高妙剑法，因少林僧众罕有习剑者，自藏经阁流出后散落江湖，鲜有人能一睹其全貌
column2: A highly refined Sword said to originate from Bodhidharma; after leaving the Shaolin scripture vault, it spread through the martial world in fragments, rarely seen in full.

column1: 修习者模仿女娲神姿，身形挺立手举过顶，作托天撼地之姿，上身飘逸，下盘稳固，有锻炼全身筋骨之功效
column2: The practitioner imitates the divine posture of Nuwa — standing tall with hands raised overhead as if holding up the sky — upper body light and flowing, lower body stable and firm; beneficial for conditioning the whole body's sinews and bones

column1: 出手运劲之姿似醉似醒，如梦如幻，招招皆出人意料，又在情理之中，只有智慧超绝者方能掌握的绝技法门
column2: Strikes and exerts force in a half-drunk, half-dreaming manner; every move is unexpected yet logical — only those of extraordinary wisdom can truly master this supreme technique

column1: 刀枪不入乃硬功之祖，需日夜苦练配合秘药外敷内服，待大功告成，刀砍枪戳之，亦只能留下几道白印而已
column2: The ancestor of all hard qigong; requires day-and-night practice and secret medicine applied inside and out — once mastered, blade and spear leave only white marks

column1: 取庄周梦蝶虚实相济，生死物化之意，修习者需酣然入梦，物我两忘，入太虚幻境，则内息自生，功法自成
column2: A cultivation method inspired by Zhuangzi’s “butterfly dream,” requiring deep sleep and self-forgetfulness. In a state where self and world are indistinguishable, Inner Force naturally arises.

column1: 在修习者四周架起火堆炙烤，从而增强内息中炎阳之气的功法，只需盏茶功夫便能让人汗流浃背，叫苦不迭
column2: A cultivation method in which fire pits are set around the practitioner, intensifying the fire-yang energy within their Inner Force. In a short time, it causes intense sweating and physical strain.

column1: 在琴弦发射的风刃中融入阴阳两种真气，其中阳春者炽热流火，白雪者冰寒刺骨，冰火交加而下，颇难应付
column2: A technique that blends yin and yang Inner Force into sword-like wind blades emitted through zither strings. The “spring” energy burns like fire, while the “snow” energy is bone-chillingly cold, making the combined assault extremely difficult to withstand.

column1: 天山派独门轻功，以此步法行于积雪上，可踏雪而行如履平地，雪面亦几乎不留踪迹，其轻巧高绝可见一斑
column2: A Movement Art allowing practitioners to walk on snow without leaving visible traces, demonstrating extremely refined agility.

column1: 将炎热内息注入他人体内之咒术，可令其气血烧灼，五内俱焚，甚至周身衣物也会起火，观者无不惊惧万分
column2: An incantation that injects burning inner breath into another person's body, causing their qi and blood to scorch, their organs to feel on fire — even their clothing may ignite, leaving all witnesses in shock and terror

column1: 崆峒派独门藏锋蓄力之法，将全身力道汇聚于核心一点，择合适时机瞬间爆发，往往能起到一击制敌的奇效
column2: A secret Kongtong method of concentrating all power into a single core point and releasing it explosively for decisive strikes.

column1: 市井流氓所用之下三滥手段，以油纸包裹石灰，向近身之敌猝然拍出，眼睛一旦被迷，痛痒难耐，泪流不止
column2: A lowlife street method; a paper bag of lime is suddenly slapped at the face of a closing enemy — once the eyes are hit, burning and tearing make it impossible to fight

column1: 愤怒至极，狂放莫名的刀法，每一刀挥出，皆是竭尽全力，奋不顾身，颇有玉石俱焚，置之死地而后生之意
column2: A furious, desperate blade style where every strike is fully committed, embodying a “fight to the death” mentality with no retreat.

column1: 棋盘纵横各十九道，对弈双方默不作声，以手上功夫对谈，此功夫貌似围棋之法，实则也是习武对敌之理也
column2: A martial method modeled after a chessboard with nineteen lines in each direction. Opponents communicate through their hand techniques in silence; although it resembles Go, it is in essence a form of combat strategy.

column1: 模仿山间大鹏将双臂大开，可在空中长时间滑翔的轻功法门，崆峒派弟子时常需用此身法在山头间快速移动
column2: A Movement Art imitating a great mountain roc spreading its wings, allowing long aerial gliding between peaks.

column1: 此剑法应和天意，实则暗含经脉运转之法。施展时催动全身内息随剑招奔流而出，便能克敌机先，伤敌无形
column2: This sword art responds to heaven's will, yet secretly embodies meridian circulation methods; when deployed, the whole body's inner breath surges out with the sword moves, striking the enemy before they are aware

column1: 此剑法身形不定，左右纵跳，同时随意出手，招无定形，心无定意，其路数亦如猿猴般灵活善变，难以捉摸
column2: A Sword with unstable form: the practitioner jumps left and right while striking freely, with no fixed pattern or intent, making it unpredictable like a monkey.

column1: 此功一步跨出看似只动分毫，实则已越过数丈，对敌者往往产生明明近在咫尺，却又永远难以触及之绝望感
column2: A technique where a single step appears minimal but actually covers several zhang, creating the illusion of an unreachable opponent even at close range.

column1: 此毒功劲道细如蚕丝，绵绵不绝，能在不知不觉间将毒素侵入敌人经脉，待其惊觉之时，往往已无药可医也
column2: This poison art's force is as fine as silkworm thread, continuous and unbroken; it can imperceptibly seep poison into the enemy's meridians — by the time they notice, it is often already beyond cure

column1: 源出颜真卿书法之功夫，行楷混杂，大气磅礴，以铁笔舞出，杀伐果断，一掣万钧，真有裴将军舞剑之声威
