column2: A martial art inspired by Yan Zhenqing’s calligraphy style, blending running and regular script. It is grand and powerful, executed with iron-like strokes, possessing the force of a battlefield general wielding a sword.

column1: 用金鎞刮去眼球表面的薄膜，使盲人复明之法。施此术者，眼力手劲均须极巧极稳，稍有差池便会伤人眼球
column2: A procedure for scraping away the membrane on the surface of the eyeball to restore sight to the blind; the practitioner's eyesight and hand steadiness must be extremely precise — the slightest error will damage the patient's eye

column1: 细密的粹毒铁砂，射程较短但范围较大，随手一挥便能形成一片黑色烟雾，不甚沾染或吸入者立感痛痒难当
column2: Fine poison-laced iron sand with short range but wide coverage; a casual sweep of the hand forms a black cloud of sand — even slight contact or inhalation causes immediate burning and itching

column1: 药王谷独门针灸手法，在数步距离上射出金针，替人远程渡穴疗伤，因有一定风险，需精习医术者方能使用
column2: A signature acupuncture method of Yaowang Valley; fires golden needles from several steps away to remotely treat acupoints and heal injuries — as it carries some risk, only those well-versed in medicine may use it

column1: 观元宵舞鱼龙彩灯的游行人群而悟，步法纷繁复杂，影影绰绰，身形虚幻难寻，待蓦然回首已在灯火阑珊处
column2: Inspired by watching crowds viewing fish and dragon lantern floats at the Lantern Festival; the footwork is complex and shadowy, the body elusive — and when you suddenly look back, the practitioner is already standing in the dim lantern light

column1: 运用者需先心神凝滞，视敌我如无物，出手时恍若遗世独立，神游太虚之中，招式自是超然物外，玄奥难测
column2: A mental state technique requiring absolute calm and detachment. The practitioner views friend and foe alike as illusions, achieving an otherworldly clarity in combat.

column1: 连发五箭之机关筒，此五箭近乎首尾相连，射速极快，射程极远且不失准度，是神机门箭矢器械的代表之作
column2: A rapid-fire arrow tube that releases five arrows in near-seamless succession. The shots are extremely fast, long-ranged, and highly accurate, representing one of the signature ranged devices of the Mechanist Sect.

column1: 针对出手架势的修炼法门，花哨繁复，奇崛多变，看上去颇具表演性质，其后手反击招式也令敌人难以预料
column2: A training method focused on refining attack posture. Though flashy and seemingly performative, its counterattacks are highly unpredictable.

column1: 魔道奇功，可无声无息侵入对方经脉，制造极乐幻觉与巨大痛苦，中者大多面容扭曲，似笑似哭，惨不忍睹
column2: A demonic technique that silently invades the meridians, inducing both ecstatic illusion and extreme pain, leaving victims with distorted expressions of laughter and agony.

column1: <i><color=#696969>♦门派贡献积累满后，便可在正厅-弟子职位中提升门派地位。
column2: <i><color=#696969>♦ Once sect contribution is fully accumulated, you can advance your sect rank via Main Hall → Disciple Positions.

column1: 专攻敌人腹部和胯下的阴狠手法，一旦命中便能令其疼痛钻心，无力再战，重伤者甚至可能失去生育能力
column2: A vicious technique targeting the enemy's abdomen and groin; a hit causes unbearable agony and inability to fight — those severely injured may even lose their ability to reproduce

column1: 以四象代表四个方位移动之法，其中循环变化纷繁往复，每一步皆顺应卦象，不通易经之人难免疑惑万分
column2: A method of movement where the Four Symbols represent the four directions. The cycle changes continuously in complex patterns; each step follows the hexagrams, leaving those unfamiliar with the I Ching deeply puzzled.

column1: 以狂猛之劲道，向前快速多次突刺的使矛之法，体质强壮之人甚至可连刺百下，纵使铜墙铁壁也为之洞穿
column2: A rapid multi-thrust spear technique, capable of dozens or even hundreds of consecutive strikes, piercing even heavy defenses.

column1: 以玉石装饰的铜制麒麟，奔跑纵跃颇为华丽好看，绕敌人移动时口中会不时喷出箭矢暗器，令人防不胜防
column2: A jade-adorned bronze qilin mechanism that moves gracefully while circling enemies, occasionally launching hidden arrows from its mouth.

column1: 传闻武成王黄飞虎所使，一式极为轻灵翔动的枪法，时而如芦花纷飞四散而落，时而如猛虎下山势不可挡
column2: A spear technique attributed to the legendary general Huang Feihu; light and agile at times like drifting reeds, yet at others as fierce as a descending tiger.

column1: 催动阳刚内力流转全身的咒法，使血脉喷张，肌肉紧绷，遍体坚硬如铁壁铜墙，从而大大增加抗击打能力
column2: An incantation that drives yang inner force through the whole body, causing blood vessels to surge, muscles to tense, and the entire body to harden like iron walls and bronze ramparts — greatly increasing resistance to strikes

column1: 催动阴阳两种内息摩擦碰撞产生微弱雷电之法，茅山新晋弟子需不断练习，直至能连发十八次，方为功成
column2: A method of generating weak lightning by driving yin and yang inner breath into friction and collision; newly initiated Maoshan disciples must practice continuously until they can produce eighteen consecutive strikes before the art is considered complete

column1: 可能源于某位丐帮弟子的悲惨经历，将修习者置于布袋之中，摸爬滚翻，并承受棍棒殴打的强身锻体之法
column2: Possibly derived from a tragic experience of a Beggars Sect disciple; a body-toughening method where the practitioner is placed inside a cloth bag and must crawl and roll while enduring beatings with sticks

column1: 向水上跳跃并以足尖轻触水面，再将身形拔高返回岸边的轻功法门，需强大内劲和腰腹力道配合方能成功
column2: A Movement Art involving jumping onto water and briefly touching the surface with the toes before rebounding back to shore. It requires strong Inner Force and core strength.

column1: 在枪头绑有火药筒的奇特枪法，出枪刺击之时，拉动引线令火筒爆炸，可攻其不备，命中更为远处的敌人
column2: A spear technique in which a firework tube is attached to the spearhead. When thrusting, the fuse is triggered, causing an explosion that catches enemies off guard and extends attack range.

column1: 套路狂放，以力道取胜的拳法，由膂力过人者使出，劲风飒飒，声响刺耳，不明就里者只以为是冤鬼夜哭
column2: A wild fist art that wins through force; when used by someone with exceptional arm strength, the wind of the punches whistles and the sound is ear-piercing — unknowing bystanders think they hear the crying of wronged ghosts in the night

column1: 将刀停于腋下身后藏起，看似谦恭礼让，实则周身皆在刀意笼罩之中，甫一出手，四面八方之敌非死即伤
column2: The blade is hidden under the arm behind the back, looking humble and yielding — yet the entire surroundings are within the blade's intent; once the move is made, enemies in all directions are either dead or wounded

column1: 将唐密和藏密修行之法大胆引入道家修真法门的峨眉秘籍，只有悟性高超者方可翻阅，否则极易坠入邪道
column2: A Mount Emei secret manual incorporating Tantric Buddhist and Tibetan practices into Daoist cultivation. Only those of great comprehension may study it; otherwise it risks deviation into corruption.

column1: 招式精妙，专攻头颈部位的少林指法，若不施加内劲可指点他人使其醒悟，若施加内劲则能令其昏厥当场
column2: A finger technique targeting the head and neck. When used without Inner Force, it can instruct and enlighten others; when infused with energy, it can render a target unconscious instantly.

column1: 晃动手腕使剑刃高速颤抖的奇特剑法，挥剑之时发出或尖锐或低沉的金属鸣音，能够打断思绪，扰乱心神
column2: A Sword involving rapid wrist vibrations that cause the blade to tremble at high frequency. The resulting metallic sounds—sharp or low—can disrupt focus and disturb the opponent’s mind.

column1: 此指法精妙非凡，饱含悲苦之意，内息运行低沉婉转，如怨如慕，如泣如诉，被命中之人血脉亦为之阻滞
column2: This finger art is exquisitely refined and full of sorrow; inner breath flows low and winding, mournful and plaintive — those struck find their blood flow blocked

column1: 此掌法需在丹田凝集混元之气，不属五行，不归阴阳，浑然天成，可以混沌初开之力将对手内息化作无形
column2: A palm technique that condenses “mixed primordial qi” in the dantian, belonging to no element or duality, capable of dissolving an opponent’s Inner Force into formless chaos.

column1: 此蛊之幼虫以宿主血肉为食，并在其体内不断孵化繁衍，可在一定程度上影响乃至操控宿主的心智和行为
column2: The larvae of this gu feed on the host's flesh and blood, continuously hatching and multiplying inside them; to some degree they can influence and even control the host's mind and behavior

column1: 此鞭法之力量与速度均霸道至极，一鞭挥出如龙吟九天，声闻数十里，旁人皆以为是真龙现世，故而得名
column2: A whip technique of extreme dominance in both power and speed; a single strike resonates like a dragon’s roar across the heavens for dozens of miles, often mistaken for a real dragon’s descent.

column1: 武当基础内修法门，取顶天立地之势站桩直立，引阴阳之气上下贯通经脉，最终归于丹田融成混元之内息
column2: “Seated Hidden Skill”: a meditation state of absolute calm, from which the strike order and pressure points derive from ancient medical charts, creating intricate precision attacks.

column1: 活棋之子要求上下左右有气存在，此功法以棋子射击敌人上下左右四个方位，若四气皆失，则已入死地矣
column2: A technique using chess pieces as projectiles, attacking in four directions—up, down, left, and right. If all four “qi positions” are lost, the target is considered trapped in a dead end.

column1: 源于乞丐在新春时节拜年乞讨之法，以木棍持续敲击地面，节奏杂乱令人烦躁不堪，然后突然出击之棍法
column2: Derived from the New Year begging custom of continuously tapping a wooden staff on the ground in an irritating rhythm; then suddenly striking — a staff method that unnerves and overwhelms

column1: 穿一双特制重型铁鞋，不断蹬踏地面的苦修之法，能锻炼腿部劲道与下盘之稳固，直至铁鞋碎裂方为功成
column2: A grueling discipline of wearing specially made heavy iron shoes and continuously stamping the ground; trains leg force and the stability of the lower body — the art is complete when the iron shoes shatter

column1: 脱胎自道家典籍庄子之轻功，乘天地之正，而御六气之辩，以游无穷，颇为符合丐帮弟子云游天下之意趣
column2: A Movement Art derived from the Daoist classic Zhuangzi; riding the true force of heaven and earth and commanding the six qi to roam without limit — fitting the Beggars Sect members' spirit of wandering the world

column1: 自孔明八阵图中演化而来的步法，需结合兵法和周易之理，决定下一步行走方位，若一步算错则步步皆错
column2: A footwork method derived from Zhuge Liang’s “Eight Formations,” requiring coordination of strategy and cosmology; a single wrong step can lead to complete failure.

column1: 茅山派不传之秘，能预测吉凶，卜算未来，中者十有八九。但因泄露天机，传说滥用此术者大多死于非命
column2: A secret that Maoshan does not pass on; it can predict fortune and divine the future, accurate eight or nine times out of ten — but for revealing heaven's secrets, legend says most who overuse it die an unnatural death

column1: 茅山派动静结合，凝练心神的基础内功，修习者需盘膝端坐，咬牙合口，掌按耳门，腹内鼓气以修炼内息
column2: A foundational Maoshan inner art that balances stillness and motion to concentrate the spirit; the practitioner must sit cross-legged, clench the teeth, press palms over the ears, and inflate the abdomen to cultivate inner breath

column1: 药王孙思邈所撰医书，有药方数千，博采众长，堪称医药研习之基本，武林中人习之亦有调元养身之功效
column2: A medical text written by the Medicine King Sun Simiao, containing thousands of prescriptions compiled from all schools of thought; the basic study text for medicine, and also beneficial for jianghu practitioners in regulating and nourishing the body

column1: 药王谷医术最高手法，需将五指功夫练至化境，劲道妙至毫巅，或悬丝诊脉，或摘叶飞花，皆若探囊取物
column2: The highest medical technique of Yaowang Valley; requires the five-finger skill to reach a state of perfection — force refined to the most exquisite degree — whether diagnosing by silk thread or plucking leaves and flowers, all as easy as reaching into a pocket

column1: 药王谷独门的开方配药，辨证施治之法，采百家之长，集历代精粹，乃当世从医者皆梦寐以求的神妙典籍
column2: A diagnostic and treatment method of Yaowang Valley combining the best of all schools and the essence of generations; a wondrous text that every physician in the world dreams of obtaining

column1: 讲求藏锋守拙，蓄势待发之内功心法，其息如龙潜深渊，厚积薄发，一旦出手，便如蛟龙出海，势不可挡
column2: An inner art that emphasizes concealing one's edge, biding one's time, and gathering force; the breath is like a dragon lurking in the deep — once unleashed, it surges out like a dragon from the sea, unstoppable

column1: 霸刀门主眺望西北戈壁山脉走势时所创，其枪势随山脊蜿蜒起伏，层峦叠嶂，心容山海之人方能得其真意
column2: A spear technique created by observing Western desert mountain ranges, with its force flowing like ridges and peaks—its true meaning understood only by those with vast, encompassing perception.

column1: 霸刀门地处西北蛮荒，向来重视硬功锤炼而轻视内家修为，此心法正是专练经脉之强劲，而非内息之积累
column2: A Western Wasteland “Ba Dao” sect method focused on strengthening meridians and physical toughness rather than cultivating Inner Force accumulation.

column1: 须弥纳芥子，芥子纳须弥，此功将庞大内力压缩于丹田中，看似平平无奇，爆发时却如山洪倾泻势不可挡
column2: A mystical skill of compressing vast Inner Force into the dantian, seemingly ordinary, but erupting like a torrential mountain flood when released.

column1: 飞龙门至高硬功绝学，运功者遍体坚如磐石，身形稳如泰山，如黄帝金身，江山永固，万夫不能撼其分毫
column2: The Flying Dragon Sect's supreme hard qigong; the practitioner's entire body becomes solid as bedrock and stable as Taishan — like the Emperor's golden body, permanent as the kingdom — ten thousand men cannot shake them by a fraction

column1: 专攻敌人胸腹部位，以凶狠内劲阻截其血脉流通的掌法，因会在命中处留下手印形状的鲜红淤血而闻名
column2: A palm art targeting the enemy's chest and abdomen; famous for the vivid red bloody bruises in the shape of a handprint it leaves at the point of impact — blocking blood flow with fierce inner force

column1: 为修习者凭添护法之力，平常一拳挥出也具龙象之威，更兼偏转刀枪之不败金身，堪称金刚宗至高硬功
column2: A body-strengthening technique granting protective force comparable to dragon and elephant power. It also provides an almost unbreakable defensive “diamond body” capable of deflecting blades and weapons.

column1: 以玉箫模仿海潮之声，曲意飘忽，婉转缠绵，声调起伏间暗藏致命内息，于无形间扰人心智，乱人经脉
column2: Mimics the sound of ocean tides with a jade flute; the melody is drifting and winding, with lethal inner breath hidden in the rising and falling notes — invisibly disturbing the mind and disrupting meridians

column1: 以阴损内力攻击敌方经脉的掌法，中者全身劲道散失，如被抽筋吸髓一般，内息亦空虚损耗，无力再战
column2: A palm art that attacks the enemy's meridians with sinister inner force; those struck lose all their body's force as if their sinews have been extracted and marrow sucked out — inner breath becomes hollow and depleted, unable to fight

column1: 以雷霆之势轰击前方的枪法，即便敌人勉强挡下攻势，也会被其刚猛劲道击退数尺，从而保护后排队友
column2: A spear technique that strikes forward with thunder-like force. Even if the enemy blocks it, the impact pushes them back several steps, protecting allies behind the user.

column1: 传说峨眉祖师曾于赏月之时，见一灵狐望月而拜，其神情诚恳虔敬，身形灵动优雅，不似凡间应有之意
column2: Legend says the Emei Patriarch once saw a fox worshipping the moon during moon viewing. Its posture was sincere, reverent, and gracefully agile.

column1: 供民众寻医问药，疗伤调养之所，除常驻医师之外，也有医术精湛的江湖人士在此替人治病赚取银两。
column2: A medical facility for treating illnesses and injuries, also used by traveling doctors.

column1: 修此轻功者却需先修心，内心若清明洁净，纤尘不染，其脚步自然轻盈愉快，一步一莲，常人追之莫及
column2: A Movement Art requiring prior mental cultivation. When the mind is pure and unstained, movement becomes naturally Movement Art and effortless, like stepping on lotus flowers.

column1: 八大明王首座，具扫除障碍毫不动摇之意，修习者运功时遍体金刚，不动如山，邪魔外道不能撼其分毫
column2: One of the Eight Great Vajra Kings’ core methods, symbolizing unwavering force. Practitioners become as immovable as mountains, impervious to evil influences.

column1: 压低身形，以雷车滚地之势快速移动，施展同时向四周抛洒烟火，声势惊人，意志薄弱者难免被其震慑
column2: A low stance movement technique that advances like a thunderous rolling chariot across the ground. While moving, the user scatters fireworks in all directions, creating a shocking spectacle that can intimidate the faint-hearted.

column1: 古国摩揭陀流传而来的瑜伽法，以苦修冥想，体位调息之法增进修为，最终达到心神合一之三摩地境界
column2: A yogic discipline originating from the ancient Indian kingdom of Magadha. Through ascetic practice, meditation, and bodily postures combined with breath control, it enhances cultivation and ultimately leads to the state of Samadhi, where mind and spirit become one.

column1: 只需稍加触碰，便能以阴冷气劲封人穴道之指法，由于穴道会被极寒内息阻塞，比寻常点穴更难以破解
column2: A finger strike technique that seals acupoints with freezing Inner Force, making it harder to break than ordinary pressure-point techniques.

column1: 叫花子行乞时，紧跟目标、不断纠缠之身法。一旦缠住目标，便如同牛皮糖一般，撕扯不下，甩脱不开
column2: A body technique used by beggars when persistently following a target; once latched on, the practitioner clings like sticky toffee — impossible to shake off or peel away

column1: 在刀上蕴含一阴一阳两股劲道，忽刚忽柔，随时变化，其招法看似散乱无章，实则配合无间，杀机四伏
column2: The blade carries one yin and one yang force — alternately hard and soft, changing at any moment; the moves appear scattered and disorderly yet work in perfect coordination, with killing intent lurking at every turn

column1: 在悬挂半空的刀阵中练习武功的霸刀门绝技，修成后可敏捷闪战，无惧刀兵，对于刀法理解亦更为深刻
column2: A Ba Dao Sect technique practiced within suspended blade arrays; it refines agility, fearlessness against blades, and deepens understanding of swordsmanship.

column1: 在行乞时配合快板所唱之小曲，由丐帮高手改编后，其路数暗合丐帮基础内功心法，新晋弟子必须熟记
column2: A short song sung to clapper accompaniment while begging; adapted by a Beggars Sect master, its rhythms secretly align with the sect's basic inner art — new disciples must memorize it

column1: 天山之上常年雪积如冬，故弟子需修习此驱寒抗冻之法门，功成者不惧霜雪，在严寒之下亦能活动自如
column2: Because the Tianshan region is snow-covered year-round, disciples must practice cold resistance techniques; mastery allows movement freely even in extreme cold.

column1: 戏子出身的用刀高手从武生套路中悟出，其招式龙飞凤舞，绵绵不绝，煞是好看，亦是擅长久战之刀法
column2: Devised by a blade master of theatrical background from stage combat routines; the moves flow like a dancing dragon and phoenix — beautiful and well-suited to prolonged combat

column1: 攻人脑门以及心脉的阴险招式，一旦得手，便能用阴寒真气扰乱人心智，使其体温急速降低并出现幻觉
column2: A sinister technique aimed at the forehead and heart meridians. Once it succeeds, its cold yin qi can disrupt the mind, rapidly lower body temperature, and induce hallucinations.

column1: 朝廷势弱，盗匪横行，大多城镇中皆设有武馆，供民众习武强身，也有不少江湖中人会在此任教演习。
column2: A place where civilians and disciples train martial arts and strengthen their bodies.

column1: 梅岭花初发，天山雪未开，于苦寒积雪之中搜寻三枝两朵腊梅，无疑是对气力，耐心和眼光的多重考验
column2: A survival trial in snowy terrain where practitioners search for plum blossoms in harsh cold—testing strength, patience, and perception.

column1: 此八招在空中画一“永”字，取“永”字中侧勒努趯策掠啄磔八种运笔方式，作为书法功夫的入门修习
column2: Eight foundational techniques drawn from writing the character “eternal” (永), based on its eight brushstroke styles, used as introductory training in calligraphy-based martial arts.

column1: 此刀法善以大量虚招掩盖锋芒，静待时机。一旦察觉破绽，则如飞龙探云，潜蛟出海，毙敌于瞬息之间
column2: This blade art uses vast quantities of feints to conceal its true edge, biding its time; once an opening is spotted, it strikes like a flying dragon emerging from clouds — killing in an instant

column1: 此指法以慈悲为名，本是助人化解内伤之法，若是反其道而行之，便能吸收敌人内力，助自己调息养伤
column2: This finger method is named for compassion; originally a method for dissolving internal injuries, if used in reverse it can absorb the enemy's inner force to aid one's own recovery

column1: 此蛊虫使人神智癫狂，喜怒无常，出现身边之人正密谋加害自己的幻觉，因而时常敌我不分，乱砍一气
column2: This gu creature causes mental madness and extreme mood swings, and produces hallucinations that the people around them are secretly plotting to harm them — causing frequent confusion between friend and foe and wild striking

column1: 汲取日月之精华，以纯阳纯阴内力混元击出的掌法，其气劲破空激射，如日月当空，光芒万丈刺目耀眼
column2: A palm technique that draws upon the essence of sun and moon, releasing blinding, radiant energy like celestial bodies colliding.

column1: 用于治病救人之极细银针，以独特手法发出，无声无息，无踪无影，可于无形之间伤人要穴，断人经脉
column2: An extremely fine silver needle used for healing; fired with a unique technique — silent, traceless, and invisible — it can strike vital acupoints and sever meridians without warning

column1: 用细竹芦苇编成的乌鸦形火器，内填火药，可借助下绑火箭之推力飞出数十丈距离，随后引发猛烈爆炸
column2: A crow-shaped fire device made from thin bamboo and reeds. Packed with gunpowder, it can be launched dozens of zhang using rocket propulsion before exploding violently.

column1: 纵身跳跃后长久滞空的轻功，实为借助真气反冲减缓下坠速度，不明诀窍者只道是仙人降世，惊骇莫名
column2: A Movement Art that allows prolonged mid-air movement after a leap, achieved by using Inner Force to counteract descent. To the uninitiated, it appears as though the practitioner is an immortal descending from the heavens.

column1: 至阳至刚之防御咒法，功力催至顶峰时周身金光外泄，好似天兵天将神力加持，寻常兵刃不能伤其分毫
column2: A supremely yang defensive incantation; at peak power, golden light radiates from the entire body as if blessed by heavenly soldiers and generals — ordinary weapons cannot harm a single hair

column1: 至阳至烈之功法，使内息在体内极速流转，血脉几近沸腾，在熬过初时的五内俱焚后，便能大增其修为
column2: A supremely yang and fierce art; inner breath circulates at extreme speed and the blood nearly boils — after enduring the initial burning agony, cultivation greatly increases

column1: 药王谷少有的狠辣武功，将猛烈内劲拍入敌方心脉，内力不足以相抗者，便会落得心脏爆裂而亡的下场
column2: A rare and vicious technique from Yaowang Valley; a fierce burst of inner force is struck into the enemy's heart meridian — those unable to resist with sufficient inner force will have their heart explode

column1: 铸剑山庄新晋弟子皆需从事最苦最累的打铁工作，不仅可吓退意志薄弱者，也能锻炼外力与内劲之根基
column2: All newly initiated disciples of Sword Forging Villa must do the hardest and most exhausting ironwork; this not only weeds out those with weak willpower but also tempers the foundations of external force and inner force

column1: 铸剑弟子常需遍访名山，寻找可用木材矿藏，此步法轻盈若风，行山路如履平地，可大大加快搜寻效率
column2: Sword Forging disciples often must visit famous mountains to search for usable timber and mineral deposits; this footwork is light as the wind, treating mountain paths as flat ground, greatly accelerating the search

column1: 一白一黑两种飞镖，分一善一恶。善镖专打人穴脉，旨在制敌机先，恶镖专攻人要害，旨在取人性命
column2: Two darts — one white, one black — one good, one evil; the good dart targets acupoints to disable the enemy first, the evil dart targets vital areas to take their life

column1: 下手毒辣，时刻以性命相搏的掌法，出手时劲力凝聚于掌心，使手掌乌黑发紫，形容恐怖，因而得名
column2: A palm art that strikes with lethal force at all times; when deployed, the force concentrates in the palm, turning it black and purple — a terrifying sight, which is how it earned its name

column1: 专练全身各部位柔劲，大成者一力有九转，任对手攻势再猛，力道再强，也只如陷入泥淖中无法自拔
column2: A soft-energy training method that develops flexibility throughout the body. At mastery, force is transformed and redirected multiple times, trapping even strong attacks in helpless stagnation.

column1: 专门锻炼手指臂膀的灵巧功夫，乃神机门正式弟子必修科目，若修习不精，打造机关时难免错漏百出
column2: A Agility training method for hands and arms, essential for Shenji Sect disciples; insufficient skill leads to errors in crafting mechanisms.

column1: 五毒教秘宝，其状若蚕虫，肤质金黄，毒性猛烈无比，顷刻间便能令中毒者五脏溃烂，七窍流血而亡
column2: A Five Poisons Sect secret treasure; shaped like a silkworm, golden in hue, with a virulence so fierce that in a matter of moments the victim's organs rot and all seven orifices bleed — death follows

column1: 以丹田汲取天地元始之精气，化为己用。施展此功法如炉中点火，持续运转越久，其内息越磅礴澎湃
column2: Draws the primordial essence of heaven and earth into the dantian and converts it for one's own use; like lighting a fire in a furnace — the longer it runs, the more surging the inner breath becomes

column1: 以机关控制开合的镔铁伞，关合时可挥舞突刺，撑开时可阻挡攻击，堪称神机门技巧器械的代表之作
column2: A mechanized iron umbrella with hidden mechanisms: it can be closed for stabbing attacks or opened for defense, representing a signature Shenji Sect device.

column1: 以炼狱般炎热内息充盈四肢，使周身力道暴增之绝技，功力不足者若强行催动，则有血脉爆裂之危险
column2: A secret technique that fills the limbs with hellishly hot Inner Force, causing a dramatic surge in physical strength. If one lacks sufficient cultivation and forcibly activates it, there is a risk of the blood vessels bursting.

column1: 仿照钟馗姿态所创之剑法，需以浑厚内劲驱动，其招式刚猛，劲道四射，足以令神鬼惊诧，群邪辟易
column2: A sword art created in the image of Zhong Kui's posture; requires robust inner force to drive — the moves are fierce with force radiating outward, enough to startle gods and demons and dispel all evil

column1: 传说乃大罗金仙所授功法，有大小周天共二十四诀，固本培元，炼神还虚，对学习者之修为大有裨益
column2: Said to have been transmitted by a great golden immortal; it contains twenty-four formulas of lesser and greater heavenly cycles — consolidating the foundation, refining the spirit back to void — greatly benefiting the learner's cultivation

column1: 使长鞭如巨蟒游移回转，不知不觉间鞭势缠绕敌人周身，一旦全力收紧，便可令被缚者周身骨骼尽碎
column2: A whip technique like a coiling giant python. It silently wraps around the opponent; once tightened, it can crush bones completely.

column1: 初学者需饮酒辅助修炼的奇特棍法，功成后自然似醉非醉，似醒非醒，棍路狂放诡谲，令人无法捉摸
column2: An unusual staff art where beginners need wine to assist training; once mastered, the practitioner naturally seems half-drunk, half-sober — moves are wild and baffling

column1: 剑光铺天盖地笼罩敌人周身，看似颇具威力之剑法，然而并不求杀伤目标，而是以限制其行动为目的
column2: A Sword that covers the enemy in overwhelming sword light, not primarily intended to kill, but to restrict and immobilize the opponent’s movements.

column1: 势大力沉，威力刚猛之拳法，双拳翻动挥舞，虎虎生风，撞击时会发出巨大声响，真如铜锤敲击一般
column2: A powerful and fierce fist art; both fists churn and swing with tiger-like force, producing a tremendous crash on impact — like a copper hammer striking

column1: 唐门机巧工艺之结晶，刀刃可伸缩、弯折、展开、飞射，因其结构复杂难以维护，长老以上方可使用
column2: The crystallization of Tang Sect mechanical craftsmanship; the blade can extend, bend, unfold, and shoot out — its structure is so complex to maintain that only elders and above may use it

column1: 在下盘蓄有奇力的跳跃功法，运用者即便置身空中，无依无凭之时，仍可以发力转向三次，故而闻名
column2: A jumping technique with powerful lower-body force, allowing mid-air direction changes up to three times.

column1: 外表平平之钢刀，实则由数十枚叶片叠成，触动机关弹开叶片，如孔雀开屏，刀光鳞鳞颇为奇异华丽
column2: An outwardly ordinary steel blade actually composed of dozens of stacked leaves; trigger the mechanism to fan the leaves open like a peacock's tail — a dazzling and unusual display of blade-light

column1: 将数十斤的石锁折腕上举，或向旁平提，进而练习翻接盘腰等法，可以大大增加修习者的力道与体质
column2: Lifts stone locks of several dozen jin by bending the wrist, or holds them out to the side; greatly increases strength and constitution

column1: 将特制火油灌入瓦罐中，以布条堵塞罐口，点燃后掷出，可令命中者遍体火焚，水泼不熄，滚翻不灭
column2: A method of filling clay jars with fire oil, sealing them with cloth, and throwing them after ignition. Upon impact, they burn the target intensely, and the flames cannot be extinguished by water.

column1: 将至阳内力灌注剑身使出的武当内家剑法，破空之声清冽，如凤凰啼鸣，劲风奔涌炽热，如朝阳初生
column2: A Wudang internal Sword infused with extreme yang energy. Its strikes are sharp and resonant like a phoenix’s cry, radiating burning, rising force.

column1: 将金属镖头系于长绳末端而成的独特暗器，既可抛掷远击，又可缩短挥击，还可捆缚敌人并将其拉近
column2: A unique hidden weapon with a metal dart head tied to a long rope; can be thrown at range, swung at close range, or used to bind and pull enemies

column1: 将长枪自口中刺入，吞至腹中的杂耍功夫，不仅需要巧劲，还得是身强体壮之人，否则难免伤及内脏
column2: A street performance skill of swallowing a long spear from the mouth into the abdomen; requires not just clever technique but a powerful physique — otherwise internal organs will be injured

column1: 小手寸劲，短促突击的贴身近战拳法，讲求闻风而动，穷追猛击，攻势越急促，敌人越容易露出破绽
column2: A close-range fist art of short explosive bursts; it responds instantly and presses relentlessly — the faster the attack, the more openings the enemy exposes

column1: 少林所夺得的龙胤归藏功一部分，融入佛法后对修习者身形气力增益更甚，足见少林兼容并蓄之神髓
column2: A technique derived from a portion of the “Dragon Essence Hidden Collection,” which, when integrated with Buddhist cultivation, significantly enhances physical strength and vitality, demonstrating Shaolin’s inclusive mastery.

column1: 少林棍法之基，只有最简单的扫拨捣劈等招式，但真要修炼至棍随意走，虎虎生风，却颇废几分功夫
column2: The foundation of Shaolin staff techniques, consisting only of basic movements such as sweeping, deflecting, striking, and chopping. However, mastering it to the level where the staff moves freely like an extension of the body requires considerable effort.

column1: 少林武功向来重视下盘之稳固，因而有此以砖石棍棒反复击打腿脚胯部，锻炼下盘抗击打能力之硬功
column2: Shaolin martial arts have always emphasized stability of the lower body. Therefore, there exists a hard conditioning method in which bricks, stones, and staffs are repeatedly used to strike the legs and hips, training resistance and durability in the lower stance.

column1: 峨眉所夺得的龙胤归藏功一部分，因内容较少而融入了大量峨眉心法，可以提升修习者的行动之灵巧
column2: A portion of the “Dragon Seal Return Treasury Skill” acquired by Mount Emei. Because the content is limited, it has been merged with Emei internal teachings, greatly enhancing agility and movement.

column1: 扁鹊所传针灸之法，其手法独到，不拘一格，所取穴位无不精奇巧妙，能令腐骨生肌，假死之人复生
column2: An acupuncture method passed down by Bianque; its technique is unorthodox and the acupoints chosen are always wonderfully precise — capable of regrowing flesh on dead bone and reviving those in false death

column1: 本地商贩云集，民众交易买卖之所，所售商品大多杂而不精，门派中人也可在此进行大宗资源买卖。
column2: A bustling trade area where goods are bought and sold, often mixed and unrefined.

column1: 本是民间起土所用农具，少林僧人在耕种之余也拿来习武练功，其招式朴实无华，只以几分蛮力取胜
column2: Originally a farming implement used for digging soil, later adopted by Shaolin monks for martial training during agricultural work. Its techniques are plain and rely mainly on brute force.

column1: 极尽霸道之刀法，每一刀均有劈石裂地之能，故激战过后，常在地面留下千沟万壑，其威势可见一斑
column2: An utterly domineering blade art; every strike can split stone and crack the earth — after fierce combat, the ground is often left full of deep gashes, showing the art's awesome power

column1: 此剑法柔软灵动，如风中之摆柳，劲道不绝，后招不断，在回环往复之间，不断尝试攻敌死角以制胜
column2: A flexible sword style like a willow in the wind, with continuous follow-up strikes that probe for weaknesses and openings.

column1: 此轻功可在深厚积雪中快速移动，在雪面所留足印形似鸿雁落下之爪印，足见其轻巧迅捷，故而得名
column2: A Movement Art-foot technique allowing rapid movement through deep snow, leaving footprints resembling the claws of a flying wild goose.

column1: 此针专攻心脉和头脑，使人心智紊乱，经脉逆行。中此针者，如丧魂失魄一般，百邪癫狂，敌我不分
column2: This needle targets the heart meridian and the brain, causing mental chaos and reverse meridian flow; those struck lose their soul and fall into madness, unable to tell friend from foe

column1: 火药原材料之一硝石的制备之法，需采掘含硝的矿石土块，水浸过滤，熬煮晒干，便可得纯净之结晶
column2: A method for producing saltpeter, one of the key ingredients of gunpowder. It involves extracting nitrate-rich earth, soaking, filtering, boiling, and drying to obtain crystalline saltpeter.

column1: 白云天所创奇特剑招，需跃至半空居高临下使出，借助坠落之势锋芒锐不可当，但也会消耗巨量内力
column2: A sword technique created by Bai Yuntian that must be executed from midair; it gains its sharpest edge from the force of descent, but consumes an enormous amount of Inner Force.

column1: 紫燕超跃，骨腾神骏，气詟三川，威凌八阵，其先祖曾为救唐太宗于重围之中而殒命，可谓忠勇过人
column2: Swift as a purple swallow, divine in bone and spirit, its presence stills three rivers and its power commands eight battle formations; its ancestor died saving Emperor Taizong from encirclement — a paragon of loyalty and valor.

column1: 自广州传入的西洋黑火药配置之法，改进后燃烧极为猛烈，爆炸威力也大大增强，乃霹雳堂不传之秘
column2: A Western gunpowder formula introduced via Guangzhou and later improved. Its combustion is extremely fierce, greatly enhancing explosive power, and is kept as a secret of Thunderclap Hall.

column1: 苗疆秘术，取各种毒虫置于一器内，任其自相啖食，待独存一物者谓之为蛊，能幻化变形，为人患祸
column2: A Miao borderland secret art; various poisonous creatures are placed together in one vessel, left to devour each other, and the last surviving creature is called the gu — it can transform and shape-shift, bringing harm to people

column1: 西北刀客搏命时所使，招招凶猛，拼急斗狠的赌徒式刀法，此刀法一出，意味着不是你死，就是我亡
column2: A gambler's blade art used by northwestern swordsmen in life-or-death struggles — every move is fierce and reckless; when this blade art comes out, it means either you die or I die

column1: 败军之将所创，悲愤凶狠，志在复仇的全力挥戈之法，刺入人体后，鲜血自戈身滴落，宛若泣血呜咽
column2: Created by a defeated general — grief-stricken, fierce, and bent on revenge — a full-force ge strike; after piercing the body, blood drips from the ge shaft as if weeping

column1: 起手时仙气飘飘，而后愈发愈快，越攻越险，最后三招乃致命之势，一剑封喉，二剑夺命，三剑追魂
column2: It begins with an ethereal, immortal-like grace, then gradually accelerates, becoming increasingly dangerous. The final three moves are lethal: the first seals the throat, the second takes the life, the third claims the soul.

column1: 通过牵制重心使敌人跌倒的肉搏招式，进攻威力较弱，但防守反击时常能让疏忽大意者摔个人仰马翻
column2: A grappling technique that trips the opponent by disrupting their center of gravity; weak in offensive power, but in defensive counterattack it often sends careless opponents tumbling head over heels

column1: 马姓道人修习拂尘功时，意外创出的一套飘忽若闪电的鞭法，以虚招为主，因此精妙有余而威力不足
column2: Accidentally created by a Daoist surnamed Ma while practicing a dust whisk method; the whip moves flash like lightning but rely mainly on feints, more ingenious than powerful

column1: 以内力灌注软鞭，狂舞之时其残影亦化为五条巨蟒，绞杀突进，配合无间，真如活物一般难以防备
column2: Inner force is channeled into the soft whip; when swung wildly, the afterimages form five giant pythons that twist and strangle in coordination — like living creatures, nearly impossible to defend against

column1: 以变幻莫测闻名的轻功，游走转向极为迅速，瞬息之间便可更换九个方位，如云中之龙见首不见尾
column2: An elusive Movement Art allowing rapid directional shifts across nine positions in an instant, like a dragon in clouds that appears and disappears unpredictably.

column1: 以少林独有斧铲形奇门兵刃使出，其招式威猛，攻势猛烈，铲铲皆攻敌薄弱，颇有斩妖伏魔之决断
column2: A weapon technique using a special axe-shovel-shaped Shaolin implement. Its attacks are fierce and focused on weak points, reflecting a decisive intent to subdue evil.

column1: 以肢端内劲画圆，控制力道循环之法门，一旦敌人陷入此乱环劲道之中，便会被力牵引，左右难支
column2: Draws circles with inner force at the limb tips, controlling force in cycles; once an enemy falls into this chaotic force loop, they are pulled left and right and cannot hold their ground

column1: 以铁笔描绘九州山河化作的奇门武学，修习者需胸怀天下方能使出真意，否则徒具其形，不得其神
column2: A martial technique using an iron brush to depict the mountains and rivers of the nine provinces; only those with a vast, world-embracing mindset can unleash its true meaning, otherwise only its form remains.

column1: 修习者周身紫气满布，氤氲不绝。每循环一周天，紫气亦加深一分，相传乃是内息在皮下流转所致
column2: The practitioner is suffused with purple qi that deepens with each heavenly cycle; said to be inner breath flowing beneath the skin

column1: 假托周公姬旦之名，剑招四平八稳，不疾不徐，暗含礼乐之道，因此有修心养性，强身健体之功效
column2: Named after the Duke of Zhou; the moves are steady and unhurried, embodying the principles of ritual and music — good for calming the mind and strengthening the body

column1: 兵行险锋，枪出奇招，此枪法招招角度诡谲，出奇制胜，传说熟习之人，必能建功立业，傲视群雄
column2: Each move strikes from an unexpected angle; this spear art strikes with calculated strangeness — legend says those who master it will build great achievements and stand above the crowd

column1: 南山以寿闻名，这套刀法也恰巧稳重持正，以防守闻名。如由内功高强者使出，其威力亦不可小视
column2: South Mountain is famed for longevity; this blade art is equally steady and defensive. Wielded by someone with deep inner art, its power should not be underestimated

column1: 印章形状的铁制兵刃，挥舞起来势大力沉，专攻头部，对敌时稍有不慎便会落得个脑浆迸裂的下场
column2: A seal-shaped iron weapon technique with heavy strikes aimed at the head; a single misstep can result in catastrophic injury.

column1: 古代名将所传之刀法，凝练其从军以来一百余战之经验，乃是以鲜血浇灌而成，极尽实用之杀人术
column2: A blade art passed down by a famous ancient general, refined through over a hundred battles since enlistment — forged in blood, the ultimate practical killing art

column1: 同时操纵五枚转轮的功法，出招时上下翻飞，左右狂舞，令人眼花缭乱，以一敌多时亦能不落下风
column2: A multi-weapon manipulation technique allowing the control of five spinning discs simultaneously, creating overwhelming offensive pressure in group combat.

column1: 天山派祖师于瑶池边领悟之心法，运行此功时，周身水雾缭绕，气蒸云梦，盖因深厚内息运转所致
column2: A foundational insight of the Tianshan founder gained at a jade pool; when activated, mist surrounds the body due to powerful Inner Force circulation.

column1: 将丈许木桩埋入地下，每日用三指紧扣并尽力上提。功成者手腕饱含阴柔之劲，可伤敌于毫厘之间
column2: Buries a wooden post in the ground and grips it daily with three fingers, pulling upward; the adept's wrist carries a soft yet penetrating force that can injure at the slightest touch

column1: 将双刀尾部相抵，然后像蟹钳般剪动的奇特招式，专攻敌之四肢，一旦夹住便伤筋挫骨，再难挣脱
column2: Presses the tails of two blades together, then snips like crab claws; targets the limbs exclusively — once caught, sinews and bones are damaged and the victim cannot break free

column1: 将大枚铜钱边缘打磨锋利而成，易于制造且便于隐藏，挂在腰间与铜钱无异，专攻敌之咽喉等部位
column2: Large copper coins with sharpened edges; easy to make and conceal, indistinguishable from regular coins when hung on the waist — targets the throat and other vital areas

column1: 将毒素融入体内真气的五仙秘术，运功后内息带有些许毒性，与五仙教毒功结合使用可谓事半功倍
column2: A Five Immortals secret art of fusing poison into inner true qi; after circulating, the inner breath carries mild toxicity — combined with Five Immortals poison arts, it produces twice the effect with half the effort

column1: 引天地浩然正气，拳拳击出，罡风四射，暴喝有声，威势惊人，凭此拳法足以降妖伏魔，以武证道
column2: A righteous boxing method that channels vast heavenly energy. Each strike is accompanied by powerful wind pressure and loud shouts, capable of subduing demons and establishing martial authority.

column1: 据传修习此刀法时，面部表情会不自觉变得狰狞恐怖，如同鬼怪，乃刀招中的邪气杀意具象化所致
column2: Said to cause the practitioner's facial expression to involuntarily become ferocious and terrifying like a demon while training — a manifestation of the sinister killing intent within the blade moves

column1: 攻击范围和威力都不俗的剑法，其所过之处，草木催折，兵甲披靡，堪称可于万军丛中取上将首级
column2: A sword art of considerable range and power; wherever it passes, trees snap and armor crumbles — capable of taking a commander's head from among ten thousand troops

column1: 攻势凌厉，出手迅猛之剑法，一招既出，全身内劲随剑身追风赶月而去，轻功高绝之人亦难以逃避
column2: A highly aggressive Sword characterized by extreme speed. Once executed, Inner Force follows the blade like chasing wind and moon, making it extremely difficult to evade.

column1: 暗藏在民间戏曲莲花落中的进阶内功心法，若能演唱此贯口，证明此人已步入丐帮正式弟子之行列
column2: An advanced inner art hidden within the folk performance art of Lotus Fall; those who can sing the full verse have proven themselves worthy of becoming formal Beggars Sect disciples

column1: 来历不明的诡异刀法，每练成一式便会失去一分人性，待功力大成之时便会无欲无情，入无我之境
column2: A mysterious and sinister sword style; with each form mastered, the user loses a portion of their humanity. Upon completion, they become emotionless and reach a state of “no-self.”

column1: 极为罕见之兵刃，银制锁链末端悬一黄金小球，回环灵活，射速如电，用于封脉打穴，无往而不利
column2: An extremely rare weapon; a small golden ball suspended from a silver chain — nimble and circular, shooting like lightning, used to seal meridians and strike acupoints with unerring accuracy

column1: 模仿老虎神态之步法，亦步亦趋，不疾不徐，耽耽虎视，顾盼生威，对于腰腿部劳损亦有保健功效
column2: A walking technique imitating the posture of a tiger: moving steadily, neither fast nor slow, with a watchful and imposing presence. It also benefits the waist and legs.

column1: 此剑法善走倾斜剑势，出剑方位变幻莫测，攻势如同疾风骤雨，对敌者之防御亦如飞花般脆弱易逝
column2: Skilled at oblique sword angles; the direction of each thrust is unpredictable — attacks rush like storm and rain, while the opponent's defense crumbles like blossoms in the wind

column1: 此拳法融合月相之阴晴圆缺，月圆时拳劲至刚至阳，月缺时拳劲至阴至柔，收放之间令人难以招架
column2: A boxing method that incorporates the waxing and waning of the moon; when full, its force is rigid and yang; when waning, it becomes soft and yin, alternating unpredictably.

column1: 此棍法共分三大式，一式敬天，一式敬地，一式敬人，其中招式变换和内劲运用暗合奇门遁甲之法
column2: A staff art divided into three great forms — one honoring heaven, one honoring earth, one honoring man; the transitions and inner force application secretly align with the principles of Qimen Dunjia

column1: 此棍法共有八式，分别对应佛教八部护法。八式齐出时，棍影化作八部天龙，可镇压一切邪魔外道
column2: A staff technique consisting of eight forms corresponding to the Buddhist Eight Protectors; when all are unleashed, the staff shadows transform into the Eight Divinities that suppress all evil.

column1: 此转轮功法共分六层，每层对应佛教六道其一，施展时轮影旋转不休，使对手如坠轮回，永难脱身
column2: A rotating wheel technique with six layers corresponding to the Six Realms of Buddhism; its endless spinning traps opponents in a cycle of reincarnation from which they cannot escape.

column1: 武当所夺得的龙胤归藏功一部分，虽说只得其总纲，融入道法后却已能大大提升修习者的经脉潜力
column2: Newly recruited Shaolin disciples must descend the mountain daily to perform chores and carry water, training their legs and endurance as a foundational martial exercise.

column1: 武林门派大多地处偏远，于城镇内设立分舵便于弟子驻防管理，从而获取城内税金以及各式资源。
column2: A sect outpost within a city used for management, taxation, and local control.

column1: 泰山刀客以十八盘山路为形制所创刀法，刀势曲折错落，旋转回盘，敌人往往应接不暇，疲于应付
column2: A blade art created by a Taishan swordsman using the eighteen bends of the mountain path as a model; its moves twist and loop unpredictably, leaving enemies scrambling to keep up

column1: 海边多风，因而蓬莱派有此借助风力移动之法，只需清风一起，便可乘风而行，姿态颇为潇洒飘逸
column2: A wind-assisted movement technique used by Penglai practitioners. With a single gust, the user can ride the wind and travel with elegant, drifting grace.

column1: 炼丹之人意外间发明，将硫磺、硝石与木炭混合制备火药的法门，也是霹雳堂火器制造的必修之法
column2: A method of firework refinement accidentally discovered by alchemists, combining sulfur, saltpeter, and charcoal to produce gunpowder. It later became a core requirement for manufacturing Thunderclap Hall weaponry.

column1: 相传乃女皇武则天所创，敬神祭天时所走之步法，亦步亦趋，端庄大气，举手投足间颇具帝王声威
column2: Said to have been created by Empress Wu Zetian; a ceremonial procession footwork used when paying respects to deities and heaven — dignified and commanding, with imperial bearing in every movement

column1: 穷尽千变万化，而返璞归真于一指。修习者需先通晓天下拳掌，然后忘尽所学，方能领悟此招真谛
column2: A technique that reaches countless variations and ultimately returns to simplicity in a single finger strike. The practitioner must first master all world martial arts, then forget everything learned to grasp its true essence.

column1: 结合毒烟迷雾，传音催眠和邪门真气等法，使心智不坚定者困惑迷狂，坠入幻境的五毒教奇门秘法
column2: A Five Poisons Sect exotic secret method combining poison smoke and mist, voice-transmitted hypnosis, and sinister true qi to confuse and madden those with weak minds, sending them into hallucinations

column1: 药王谷峭壁上盛产名贵补品：燕窝，采摘者需悬绳垂于崖面之上移行采撷，稍作不慎便会粉骨碎身
column2: The steep cliffs of Yaowang Valley abound in precious supplements — swallows' nests; harvesters must descend along ropes on the cliff face to gather them, with a moment's carelessness meaning certain death

column1: 西楚霸王项羽所传，一式极尽霸道之戟法，扫八荒，清六合，荡平群魔，铲除奸邪，只在举手之间
column2: Passed down by Xiang Yu, the Hegemon-King of Western Chu — a supremely domineering halberd strike; sweeping the eight wastes, clearing the six directions, leveling all demons and villains — all in the raising of a hand

column1: 西楚霸王项羽所传，一式极尽霸道之枪法，扫八荒，清六合，荡平群魔，铲除奸邪，只在举手之间
column2: A single, overwhelmingly powerful spear strike passed down from Xiang Yu, capable of sweeping across all directions and suppressing all opposition in one motion.

column1: 门派正中之厅堂，亦是一门之中最为重要之建筑，掌门往往在此安排事务，举办会议，会见宾客。
column2: The central hall of the sect and its most important building, where the sect leader handles affairs, holds meetings, and receives guests.

column1: 阎罗殿独门绝技，运功之时全身颤抖，手脚不受控制般狂乱舞动，实则为经脉和气血剧烈运行所致
column2: A unique technique of the Yama Hall; when activated the whole body trembles and the hands and feet flail about uncontrollably — in truth this is caused by the violent circulation of meridians and blood

column1: 霹雳堂独门轻功，在鞋底安装特制滑轮，在鞋跟安装火药推进装置，可短时间内极大提升行进速度
column2: A unique Thunderclap Hall Movement Art using special wheel mechanisms built into the soles of shoes, along with firework-like propulsion at the heels, enabling extremely fast short-term movement.

column1: 黄衣老者从仙人指路姿势中悟出，空灵奇绝，一招一式间似在指点迷津，实则往往令敌人误入歧途
column2: Understood by an old man in yellow robes from the gesture of an immortal pointing the way; ethereal and strange — each move seems to offer guidance yet leads enemies astray

column1: ♦提升门派地位可在藏经阁阅读更高级秘籍，并解锁更多门派功能。
column2: ♦ Raising your sect rank allows you to read higher-level manuals in the Scripture Pavilion and unlocks more sect features.

column1: 专以内息攻敌心神的茅山咒术，意志柔弱者一旦中招，或丧魂失魄，或狂舞乱癫，久久不能清醒
column2: A Maoshan incantation that specifically attacks the enemy's spirit with inner breath; those with weak willpower who are struck may lose their soul, dance wildly in madness, or remain unable to clear their mind for a long time

column1: 东瀛武士之刀法，招法看似简单，实则强调对人体力道之极致运用，无需内力修为便能发挥威力
column2: An Eastern warrior's blade art; the moves seem simple but emphasize the ultimate application of the body's force — effective even without inner art cultivation

column1: 习此功法者，出拳掌如虎啸，舞刀兵似龙吟，即便是再寻常的武功招式，也能发挥出惊人之威能
column2: Those who train this art strike with a tiger's roar and wield weapons with a dragon's chant; even the most ordinary martial technique produces astonishing power

column1: 五毒教制蛊入门之法，以泥鳅和五毒泡制而成，被咬中者体内如泥鳅乱窜，百爪挠心，坐卧难安
column2: An entry-level Five Poisons Sect gu-refinement method; made by soaking loaches and five poisons together — those bitten feel as if loaches are wriggling inside them, a hundred claws scratching the heart, impossible to rest

column1: 京城守卫禁军所习之基础内功心法，与武林中人的内功相比，忽视了内力修为，更注重实战操练
column2: The intermediate inner art practiced by the Imperial Guard defending the capital; compared to jianghu inner arts, it neglects inner force cultivation and focuses more on practical combat training

column1: 从硬功中演化而来，讲求内外兼修的霸刀门心法，以丹田内息支撑肢体之强健，提升力道之威猛
column2: A Ba Dao sect internal cultivation method evolved from hard-body training, combining external strength with Inner Force to enhance physical power and force output.

column1: 以内力逼弯剑刃，将长剑变为柔韧软鞭，轻柔扭转，飘忽不定，剑招亦颇为回环曲折，常人难测
column2: A sword technique in which Inner Force bends the blade into a flexible whip. The sword moves in fluid, unpredictable arcs, making its trajectory difficult to read.

column1: 以手指计算双方招式和距离的奇特技法，智慧超群者可借此预知对手行动，如同受仙人指点一般
column2: A peculiar finger-based technique used to calculate both distance and the opponent’s moves; those with exceptional intelligence can predict actions as if guided by immortals.

column1: 以虚招为主的七式枪法，每一枪皆是试探之招，如神龙探首，而身形则隐藏在云雾之中蓄势待发
column2: A probing spear technique consisting of seven forms focused on feints; each strike tests the opponent like a dragon peering from the mist, while the user remains concealed.

column1: 以钢刀不断劈砍水流修炼而成，起初水流只是略有阻滞，待功力深厚之时，则能将水面劈开数寸
column2: A training method developed by repeatedly striking flowing water with a steel blade; at first it only disturbs the flow, but at mastery it can cut the water surface open.

column1: 仿照蓝采和法宝以铁条编成，云游八方时能作容器，如遇拦路盗匪，也可遮挡利刃和暗器的袭击
column2: A method of forging a portable weapon container from iron rods, inspired by Lan Caihe’s magical implement, which can also serve as a shield against blades and projectiles.

column1: 佯装逃跑时借身体回转之力，给背后追击者致命一击的行伍枪术，因缺乏防御后手而需谨慎使用
column2: A military spear technique of feigning retreat then using the body's turning force to deliver a lethal strike to the pursuer — must be used with caution as it leaves no defensive follow-up

column1: 分为普门、部会、别尊三大架势的金刚杵法，其中蕴含颇多智慧变化法门，以用于应对不同敌人
column2: A vajra staff technique divided into three major stances—universal, assembly, and individual—each designed to adapt to different opponents and combat situations.

column1: 各式木架，箱桶排列有序，门派资源皆储藏其中，门派弟子也均分配少量空间以储存私人物品。
column2: A storage area for sect resources and personal belongings of disciples.

column1: 唐门秘传心法，以内息驱使五指手臂，使其灵巧倍增，发箭掷镖如疾风骤雨，堪比百手千指之功
column2: A Tang Sect secret heart method that uses inner breath to drive the five fingers and arms, multiplying their Agility; firing arrows and throwing darts becomes fast as storm wind — rivaling a hundred hands and a thousand fingers

column1: 大隐阁武功不善争强斗狠，只求与世无争之意，因此入门弟子皆需修习琴棋书画等修身养性之法
column2: A cultivation system from the Hidden Great Pavilion, which avoids aggression and emphasizes harmony with the world. Beginners must also study the four arts—zither, chess, calligraphy, and painting—to cultivate character.

column1: 头部安有铁嘴，内部装填火药的奇特鹞状火器，掷出并命中目标后，嘴中会喷出大量火焰和烟雾
column2: A peculiar fire device shaped like a crow with an iron beak, packed with gunpowder. When thrown and struck, it emits flames and smoke from its mouth upon detonation.

column1: 奇门对刺功法，其中一刺蛇形柔转灵动，一刺鹤形沉静耸立，双刺齐出令人左右难支，应接不暇
column2: An exotic paired-thrust method; one thrust flows like a snake, the other stands still like a crane — both together leave the enemy unable to cope

column1: 将气劲自剑尖迸射而出，化作一道长风破空而行，功力深厚者可以此击坠天边飞雁，足见其精妙
column2: A technique that releases sword qi from the blade’s tip, forming a wind-like strike capable of shooting down distant flying birds.

column1: 居于城镇中央，朝廷官员办公判案之所，气势恢宏，守卫森严，亦是一城之中最为重要之建筑。
column2: A central administrative building for governance and justice, heavily guarded and highly important.

column1: 带有螺旋形锋利棱角的铁钻，用铁锤击打射出，力道惊人，在中距离上可以贯穿甲胄，重伤敌人
column2: An iron drill with spiral cutting edges, fired by hammer strike; its force is tremendous — at medium range it can pierce armor and severely wound enemies

column1: 张国老所授克敌之法，以内劲击打鼓身时响声震天动地，气冲云霄，能吓退凶邪，震慑敌人心神
column2: A drum-striking technique taught by Zhang Guolao. Striking the drum with Inner Force produces thunderous sound that can shake the sky and intimidate enemies.

column1: 心意气三元混合之道家功法，修习者内息收放自如，可达心与意合，意与气合，气与力合之境界
column2: A Daoist art combining heart, intent, and qi; the practitioner commands inner breath freely, reaching the unity of heart and intent, intent and qi, qi and force

column1: 战国名医扁鹊所留之医书，其中妙药灵方无数，更兼锤炼经脉之神奇法门，可大大增加内息潜能
column2: A medical text left by the famed Warring States physician Bianque; it contains countless miraculous remedies and formulas, and also includes remarkable methods for tempering the meridians, greatly increasing inner breath potential

column1: 战国女子传于越王之古剑法，本用于上阵杀敌，后经高人改编更为轻灵翔动，于锋锐中另藏变化
column2: An ancient sword art transmitted from a woman of the Yue state to the King of Yue; originally for battlefield killing, later refined by a master to become more nimble and dynamic, concealing changes within its sharpness

column1: 所谓伸手不打笑脸人，长乐帮众对战时好以笑脸相迎，江湖中人碍于情面，往往也不忍痛下杀手
column2: As they say, one cannot strike a smiling face; Changle Gang members greet opponents with a smile in combat, and jianghu people often find it hard to land a killing blow out of social grace

column1: 招式凌厉，甫一出手，便有掌风裹挟着冰寒刺骨之内劲扑面而来，若以拳脚抵挡则难免冻伤肌肤
column2: A palm strike infused with icy Inner Force; even simple contact can freeze an opponent’s meridians and damage the skin.

column1: 有练功木人以及各式兵器陈列的宽阔广场，门派弟子会在此修习各式外门武学或相互切磋比试。
column2: A wide open field with wooden training dummies and weapons where disciples practice martial arts and spar with each other.

column1: 杖本刚硬，以纯阴内力灌注后竟生出几分韧性，由此使出如灵蛇般柔转迅敏，专攻心腹薄弱之处
column2: A staff is naturally hard; infused with pure yin inner force, it gains a degree of flexibility — the moves become as fluid and swift as a spirit snake, targeting the soft vulnerabilities of the torso

column1: 极速投掷金钱镖之手法，其登峰造极者，举手一掷间便可发出铜钱千枚，遮天蔽日令人难以躲避
column2: A technique for throwing coin darts at extreme speed; at peak mastery, a single throw releases a thousand copper coins that blot out the sky, nearly impossible to evade

column1: 枪头浸透火油，在对敌时点燃使出的枪法，招式开合挥舞，火光阵阵，能够有效逼退敌人的攻势
column2: A spear technique in which the spearhead is soaked in fire oil and ignited during combat. Its sweeping, open movements produce bursts of flame, effectively forcing back enemy offensives.

column1: 此剑招一经发动，便一剑接一剑接踵而至，顺势而来，虽威力稍小，但胜在不僵不滞，连绵不断
column2: A footwork system based on the I Ching, requiring calculation of time and direction to step according to hexagrams, predicting danger and avoiding attacks.

column1: 此戟法共分十六路，均以青龙为形制，或游走盘恒，或张牙舞爪，招式之间浑然有序，一气呵成
column2: A halberd art divided into sixteen roads, all modeled on the azure dragon — some circling and coiling, some with claws spread wide — the moves flow seamlessly from one to the next in a single breath

column1: 此手法如同蜘蛛缠丝一般，轻巧柔弱，层层叠叠，待到敌人发觉，已被其中内劲所制，再难反抗
column2: This technique wraps around the enemy like a spider spinning silk — light and yielding layer upon layer; by the time the enemy notices, they are already controlled by its inner force

column1: 气势浩大，劲道阳刚，一招一式间平稳持重，正气凛然，乃是不以投机取巧取胜的道门正宗掌法
column2: A righteous and imposing palm technique of the Taoist orthodox school. Its movements are steady and dignified, embodying pure righteousness, and it does not rely on trickery or deception.

column1: 浩浩乎如冯虚御风，而不知其所止，飘飘乎如遗世独立，羽化而登仙，清雅绝伦之间亦暗藏杀机
column2: Vast and boundless like riding the wind through the void, not knowing where it will stop; drifting like a solitary transcendent, transforming and ascending — amidst transcendent elegance lurks lethal danger

column1: 灭门惨案幸存者所创，每刀皆在生死边缘游走，所谓以血祭刀，以命搏命，刀势越凶，反噬越烈
column2: A blade technique created by a massacre survivor; each strike walks the line between life and death, where every cut is paid for with blood, and greater ferocity brings greater backlash.

column1: 玄门正宗以气御劲的上乘拳术，出招时将全身内力灌注双臂上击出，以雄厚内劲伤敌于无形之间
column2: A high-level orthodox inner force boxing method of the mystical sect. The practitioner channels Inner Force through both arms when striking, unleashing powerful Inner Force to injure the opponent invisibly.

column1: 纵跃能力超绝之轻功，手伸足蹬间，如攀爬阶梯直至云上，常人见之只道是仙人乘龙，无不称奇
column2: A supreme leaping Movement Art; hand-reach and foot-push carry the practitioner upward like climbing stairs to the clouds — onlookers think they are seeing an immortal riding a dragon

column1: 身形蹲伏如蛤蟆，随后发力弹跳之法，虽不甚雅观，但可一跃而出数丈距离，苗疆人士多有使用
column2: Crouching like a toad and then launching into a leap; not particularly graceful, yet the practitioner can spring forward several zhang in a single bound — widely used by people of the Miao borderlands

column1: 轻巧缥缈，虚幻空灵之轻功法门，修习者身形有如青烟萦绕，飞絮飘散，寻常招式难以触其分毫
column2: A Movement Art and ethereal movement technique. The practitioner becomes like drifting smoke or scattered feathers, making it extremely difficult for opponents to strike.

column1: 这套掌法行云流水，大开大合，掌风威力尤为惊人，常常一掌便能扫倒大片敌人，有如风卷残云
column2: This palm art flows like clouds and streams; its palm wind force is especially striking, often sweeping down large groups of enemies at once like wind scattering leaves

column1: 通过不断冲撞树木或砖墙修炼而成，横行霸道的勇猛步法，提刀出阵，冲杀敌军，如入无人之境
column2: A violent battlefield stepping method developed by repeatedly charging into trees or stone walls, producing an unstoppable forward momentum in combat.

column1: 长乐帮亲传弟子时常需要接洽官府中人乃至皇亲贵胄，此时以极度欢喜之情相迎，自然事半功倍
column2: Core Changle Gang disciples often deal with government officials and even imperial relatives; greeting them with extreme joy naturally makes every matter easier to handle

column1: 阳刚猛烈的内功心法，内力如同奔雷般向四肢流转，使得修习者行动速度与经脉流转亦大大加快
column2: A fierce yang inner art; inner force flows through the limbs like rushing thunder, greatly accelerating movement speed and meridian flow

column1: 陷阵之志，有死无生，乃猛将高顺所率精兵之口号，以此意志修习武功者，心神如铁，不可摧折
column2: Vanguard spirit — fight to the death with no surrender — the battle cry of fierce general Gao Shun's elite troops; those who train martial arts with this Willpower have a spirit like iron, unbreakable

column1: 一套与各种地趟动作结合而成的下盘刀法，招式之间跌扑滚摔，虽然不甚雅观，实则攻守兼备
column2: A low-stance blade art incorporating tumbling and rolling; ungainly in appearance but well-rounded in offense and defense

column1: 主修跳跃攀爬之法，以高楼或高塔为训练工具的轻功法门，练成者顷刻之间便能纵身而上数层
column2: A Movement Art that trains jumping and climbing using tall buildings or towers; the adept can scale several floors in an instant

column1: 乞丐沿街乞讨时，往往手拄一木棍或竹杆，既可助力行走，遇到地痞恶犬时也能稍作防身之用
column2: Beggars on the street often lean on a wooden staff or bamboo pole both to aid walking and to offer some defense against thugs and stray dogs

column1: 从四象八卦中演化而出的刀法，其中变化八八六十四式，纷繁复杂，连舞三天三夜亦不能穷尽
column2: A blade art derived from the four symbols and eight trigrams; its sixty-four variations are so intricate that three days and nights of continuous practice cannot exhaust them

column1: 以“两臂相通”的通臂劲而著称的一套拳法，力道由肩发出，通过手肘至拳上，以成通臂之势
column2: A fist art famous for its through-arm force; power originates at the shoulder, passes through the elbow, and arrives at the fist

column1: 以雷电破空之势急速劈砍，力道狂猛之刀法，兵刀相交之时火光四溅，真如雷公电母显灵一般
column2: A lightning-fast slashing blade technique that channels explosive force; when blades collide, sparks fly like thunder gods manifesting in battle.

column1: 体现武当以柔克刚思维的入门掌法，掌力绵长圆转且蕴含内劲，看似柔弱无骨，实为绵里藏针
column2: A supreme Movement Art where the body soars into the air, sometimes manifesting nine afterimages moving in unison, astonishing all who witness it.

column1: 双手持刀，将全身力道集中于刀刃，简单刚猛之招式，其一刀劈下，威势惊人，着者无不两断
column2: Two-handed blade technique concentrating the whole body's force onto the blade edge; a simple and fierce chop of devastating power — whatever it strikes is split in two

column1: 号称鞭鞭夺命的阴毒鞭法，招招攻向敌人的软肋和要害处，其凶残狠辣常常令正派人士所不齿
column2: A vicious and sinister whip art that claims a life with every stroke; every strike targets the enemy's weak points and vital areas — its brutality earns the contempt of righteous sects

column1: 大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆，此功法源于西北边塞，非身经百战，出生入死之士难以领略其精髓
column2: Lone smoke rises straight in the vast desert, the long river meets the setting sun — this art originates from the northwestern frontier; only those who have fought through life and death can grasp its essence

column1: 天山派女弟子入门所修，轻巧明快之掌法，出手之时，轻烟袅袅，云雾缭绕，颇有几分观赏性
column2: A palm technique practiced by female disciples, light and elegant, often producing mist-like visual effects when executed.

column1: 崆峒山地势奇绝，山道间只以铁索相连，因此崆峒派弟子入门第一课，便是练习攀爬这些铁索
column2: Mount Kongtong’s terrain is extremely rugged and strange. The mountain paths are connected only by iron chains, so the first lesson for Kongtong disciples is learning how to climb these chains.

column1: 应策腾空，承声半汉，入险摧敌，乘危济难，其先祖乃突厥名马，作为贡品随唐太宗征战多年
column2: It leaps skyward at a touch of the spurs, answers a command in mid-air, breaks through danger and carries its rider to safety; its ancestor was a famed Turkic horse that served Emperor Taizong for years as tribute.

column1: 据说是三国名将所传招式，枪势大开大合，威武沉稳，招法华丽又不失实用性，颇具王者气象
column2: Said to have been passed down by a famed Three Kingdoms general; the spear moves are wide and powerful, stately and imposing, practical yet magnificent — befitting a ruler

column1: 掀起漫天尘土，同时身形贴地快速滑行的奇特轻功，神出鬼没，难以捉摸，如同遁地仙术一般
column2: A peculiar Movement Art where the practitioner stirs up dust and slides close to the ground at high speed, elusive like an underground immortal.

column1: 模仿猿猴越过山涧的纵跳之法，练习者腿部发力与落脚地点稍有偏差便会落入水中，狼狈不堪
column2: A jumping technique inspired by monkeys crossing mountain ravines; slight miscalculation in foot placement results in falling into water, reflecting its difficulty.

column1: 此剑招需将阴寒之内力灌注剑身，使出时寒气逼人，周身霜花乱舞，剑身亦有冰凝，故而得名
column2: Channels cold yin inner force into the blade; frost flowers swirl around the user when the move is executed, and the blade itself may freeze — hence the name

column1: 此功法脱胎于卖艺把式，以脚掌发力，向后上方快速倒踢，腿脚之间结成环形，令人眼花缭乱
column2: Derived from acrobatic performance; delivers a rapid reverse kick upward and backward, with legs forming a loop that dazzles the eye

column1: 每修炼一层，心中杀意便会增加一分的邪道心法，功力尚浅或急功近利者很容易因此走火入魔
column2: An sinister heart method where each layer of cultivation adds another degree of killing intent to the mind; those with shallow cultivation or those who rush the training easily suffer qi deviation and go berserk

column1: 源于佛门，一种套路多变，以灵活见长的棍法，其中挑、点、戳的招式极多，可用于封人穴脉
column2: A Buddhist-origin staff art with varied sequences, known for agility; rich in flicking, pointing, and jabbing moves that can seal acupoints

column1: 源于佛门，一种套路简练，以力道见长的棍法，其中扫、劈、拨的招式极多，可压制整片敌人
column2: A Buddhist-origin staff art with concise sequences, known for power; rich in sweeping, chopping, and deflecting moves that can overwhelm entire groups

column1: 源于天竺的金刚宗杵形法器，象征所向无敌、无坚不摧的智慧与佛法，可斩断烦恼，祛除邪魔
column2: A ritualistic vajra-shaped implement originating from India. It symbolizes invincible wisdom and Buddhist truth, said to cut through delusion and dispel inner demons.

column1: 相传是如来佛祖为普度众生，授予俗世的一套掌法，其威力可敌天灾地祸，确实不似凡间所有
column2: A palm technique said to be bestowed by the Buddha for saving all beings; its power rivals natural disasters and feels beyond anything mortal.

column1: 精妙奇门笔法，笔尖上下翻飞，轻舞慢点，残影在空中生出纷繁绚烂各式花卉，可谓华丽非常
column2: A refined brush technique in which the brush tip moves rapidly in all directions. Its motions create residual images resembling blooming flowers, making it visually dazzling and highly ornamental.

column1: 能感知众生过去之宿业，知晓现时或未来之果报的密宗绝技，非修持禅定多年者难以得此神通
column2: An esoteric technique granting perception of beings’ past karma and present or future consequences. It requires long-term meditative training to attain.

column1: 脚踩转轮贴地滑行的神奇轻功，金刚宗弟子常借此快速下山，其中修为高深者甚至可凌空飞行
column2: A miraculous Movement Art in which the practitioner glides along the ground using rotating wheel-like footwork. Vajra Sect disciples use it to descend mountains quickly, and highly skilled practitioners are even said to be able to levitate.

column1: 臂如鹰展，指如钢钩，气提丹田，大力开合，周身关节亦咯咯作响，猎物一旦被擒便再难挣脱
column2: A claw technique with eagle-like arms and iron-hook fingers. Force is driven from the dantian; once captured, escape becomes nearly impossible.

column1: 自下向上的掌法招式，以稳固下盘为基，发全身之力向上迎敌，即便来势如泰山压顶亦能抵御
column2: An upward palm technique grounded in a stable base; it launches the full body's force upward to meet the enemy, capable of withstanding even a mountain-crushing blow

column1: 茅山派剑法根基，招式谨守中庸之道，不疾不徐，不温不火，攻守有度，亦有调复内息之功效
column2: The foundation of Maoshan sword arts; its moves adhere to the middle way — neither too fast nor too slow, neither too warm nor too cold — balanced in offense and defense, and also beneficial for restoring inner breath

column1: 西楚霸王项羽所传，极尽刚猛的内修心法，以澎湃内息催动周身劲道，发动巨力足以拔山举鼎
column2: A supreme internal cultivation method passed down from Xiang Yu, the Western Chu Overlord, using overwhelming Inner Force to unleash physically godlike strength capable of uprooting mountains.

column1: 讲求顶平肩平脚平枪平“四平”之枪法，平直穿插，去势如箭，尽管招式简单，却又难以招架
column2: A spear art emphasizing four alignments — top, shoulder, foot, and spear — with straight thrusting force like an arrow; simple yet hard to stop

column1: 通过掐指之法辅助占卜吉凶或推算干支的玄妙法门，智慧超群且通晓周易之理者方能完全掌握
column2: A divination technique using finger calculations to determine fate; only those deeply versed in the Yijing and high wisdom can master it.

column1: 道家修真之法，可激发人体及经脉之潜能，据说修炼此功法至巅峰，便能逼近凡人武学之极限
column2: A Daoist cultivation method that can unlock the potential of the body and meridians; said that reaching the peak of this art brings one close to the ultimate limit of mortal martial arts

column1: 长乐帮独门暗器，专攻人头脑心腹，其毒性一旦侵入心脉，中毒者便会大笑狂舞三天三夜而死
column2: A Changle Gang signature hidden weapon targeting the head, heart, and abdomen; once its poison enters the heart meridian, the victim laughs and dances wildly for three days and nights before dying

column1: 门派中人居住休憩之所，低级弟子往往几人合住一简朴厢房，位高者则有豪华厢房单独居住。
column2: Living quarters for disciples; juniors often share rooms while seniors may have private quarters.

column1: 韩湘子所作之洞箫曲，辞语空灵玄奥，摄人心神，可令听者如闻仙乐，心醉神迷之间不能自已
column2: A flute technique by Han Xiangzi. Its ethereal melodies are mentally entrancing, causing listeners to become lost in a state of blissful confusion.

column1: “封闭提掳拿拦还缠”八式乃一切枪术之基本，其生出的组合又变化万千，因此以八母闻名
column2: The eight foundational moves of all spear arts give rise to countless combinations; hence named the Eight Mothers

column1: 一处装饰精良，环境优美，售价也颇为不菲的私人住宅，可供人休息，储藏或是习武使用。
column2: A well-furnished home used for living and training.

column1: 一门刚柔并济，攻守兼备的掌法，其诀窍在于“摔”字，即借助手腕甩打之力增强搏击威力
column2: A palm art balancing hard and soft, offense and defense; the key lies in the word "smash" — using wrist-snap force to amplify striking power

column1: 一门攻守兼备的实用拳法，招式严谨，底盘扎实，其创始者曾以此拳法伏虎除恶，因而闻名
column2: A practical all-around fist art with disciplined techniques and a solid base; its creator once subdued tigers with it, earning it its fame

column1: 一门滞空飘行之身法，修习者可借由微风之力扶摇而上，常人视之，真如直奔月宫而去一般
column2: A hovering body technique; the practitioner can ride gentle winds to float upward — to ordinary eyes, it truly seems as if they are flying straight to the moon palace

column1: 专为劈砍重型甲盾所创，结合强悍力道与刀刃特性的精妙劈砍法门，可斩人无血，削铁如泥
column2: Created specifically for chopping through heavy armor and shields; a refined chopping method combining tremendous force and blade properties — able to cut without blood and slice iron like mud

column1: 专攻远距离的戟法，其出势如龙，长攻远击，可谓一寸长一寸强，但难以应付近身肉搏之敌
column2: A halberd art specializing in long-distance attacks; its strike surges forward like a dragon — long reach and far strike, the longer the stronger — but it struggles against enemies who close to close range

column1: 为江湖人士所禁忌的功法，需配合腐尸之毒修炼而成，对修炼者的毒功和意志均是一种考验
column2: A technique forbidden in the jianghu; requires training with corpse poison, testing both the practitioner's poison cultivation and willpower

column1: 从猛禽捕食动作中演化出的擒拿路数，着重抓锁猎物的脖颈或关节处，并伺机予以致命一击
column2: A grappling method derived from a raptor's hunting motion; targets the neck or joints, locks them down, and waits for the killing blow

column1: 以内劲扰乱敌方重心，使之跌倒的奇门咒术，茅山道士有时会用以戏弄功力低微的武林人士
column2: An exotic incantation that uses inner force to disrupt the enemy's center of gravity and cause them to fall; Maoshan Daoists sometimes use this to tease jianghu people of low cultivation

column1: 以极快速度挥舞转轮，使之化为万千幻影攻敌，若敌人不倒，其攻势亦无穷无尽，无止无休
column2: A high-speed spinning disc technique in which the weapon is rotated into countless afterimages. If the opponent does not fall, the assault continues endlessly without pause.

column1: 以脚沾水，在地面挥洒行书之步法，其所成文字矫健活泼，潇洒大气，颇有几分嬉戏之意趣
column2: A calligraphy-based footwork style performed with wet feet on the ground, forming elegant and lively characters, playful and free-spirited in nature.

column1: 以连续挥击而闻名，短时间内数十次挥出势大力沉之铁锤，即便身强体壮者有时也难以驾驭
column2: Famous for sustained strikes; dozens of heavy iron hammer blows in rapid succession, sometimes too much even for a powerful practitioner to sustain

column1: 以高速舞剑，使剑刃模糊不清难以辨认之法，对敌之人需要观察剑柄指向，方能判断其走势
column2: A method of swinging the sword at high speed until the blade becomes blurred and unrecognizable; opponents must observe the direction of the hilt to judge its trajectory

column1: 传说佛祖曾掷象于空中，三日后方才坠地，此法虽无如此神通，但仍可以怪力抛掷百斤巨石
column2: A legend describing the Buddha casting an elephant into the sky, which fell only after three days. Though this technique does not reach such divine power, it still allows the practitioner to hurl hundred-jin boulders with tremendous force.

column1: 共分为十三大剑势，快慢相兼，刚柔并济，讲求形神相合，意气贯通，乃武当正宗剑法之基
column2: A Hidden Pavilion secret technique where each heavy strike triggers a cycle of Inner Force within the body, culminating in a final explosive rebirth-like resurgence.

column1: 出手快速，击长攻远，霹雳堂低级弟子用此枪法逼退敌人，以保护后排使用火器的高级弟子
column2: A spear technique characterized by rapid thrusts and extended reach, used by junior Thunderclap Hall disciples to repel enemies and protect those handling fire-based weapons behind them.

column1: 劲势刚猛，以力道取胜的重剑剑法，传说越王勾践曾以此一招劈斩马车为两半，足见其威力
column2: A heavy sword art of fierce and powerful force that wins through strength; legend says the King of Yue Goujian once cleaved a war chariot in two with this single move — showing its tremendous power

column1: 双掌在周身游走翻飞，如车轮急转，虎虎生风，每次出手却是遵循九宫规制，颇为严谨细密
column2: A sword technique inspired by the Dunhuang flying apsaras murals, featuring aerial dives from above like a celestial waterfall crashing into the mortal world.

column1: 取关公过五关斩六将之意，横冲直撞，势不可挡，追求冲击力道而非闪避灵活的猛将之步法
column2: Drawing from the spirit of Guan Yu charging through five passes and slaying six generals; a fierce general's footwork that charges forward unstoppably, pursuing impact force rather than evasive agility

column1: 取出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖之掌意，是丐帮之中少有的以柔克刚，以弱胜强之精巧掌法
column2: Drawing from the spirit of the lotus that rises unstained from mud; one of the few Beggars Sect palm arts that overcomes the hard with the soft and defeats the strong with the weak

column1: 唐代幻真先生所传，一门将天地元气吞服到自身体内，转化利用以充盈内息的进阶内功心法
column2: An advanced inner art passed down by the Tang dynasty master Huanzhen Xiansheng; swallows the primordial qi of heaven and earth into the body, converting it to enrich one's own inner breath

column1: 唐门隐藏出手痕迹的暗杀之法，挥手之间绵软似无力，却能激射出致命暗器，令人无从防备
column2: The Tang Sect's assassination technique for concealing the act of striking; a wave of the hand seems soft and effortless, yet it launches lethal hidden weapons with no warning

column1: 如同卧虎之姿，看似闭眼假寐，实则为蓄力待敌之法，甫一起身，则如猛虎扑食，势不可挡
column2: Like a crouching tiger feigning sleep — in truth gathering force and waiting; the moment the practitioner rises, they strike like a tiger pouncing on prey

column1: 尾部连接锁链的特制铁爪，命中目标后，爪上倒钩会自动收紧并牢牢抓握，从而阻滞其行动
column2: A specially made iron claw with a chain attached; upon impact, the reverse hooks tighten and grip the target firmly, impeding their movement

column1: 当地捕快驻扎巡防之处，设有瞭望塔可俯瞰城内情况。一地治安皆依赖此处方能管理周全。
column2: A security station with lookout towers overseeing city safety and order.

column1: 所为子午，一阴一阳，一北一南，剑招蕴含天干地支，时辰方位之理，聪慧过人者方能参悟
column2: Named Ziwu — one yin, one yang, one north, one south; the moves embed the principles of the heavenly stems, earthly branches, hours, and directions — only those of exceptional intelligence can understand it

column1: 摩诃者大也，无量者不可计量也。修习此功法者内力如大海无量，且可随心所欲，掌控自如
column2: A cultivation method meaning “great and immeasurable,” granting Inner Force as vast as the sea, yet fully controllable at will.

column1: 正气凛然，以金刚大力正面迎击敌人胸腹部位的杵法，闪避不及者难免肋骨断折，脏腑震颤
column2: A righteous and powerful staff technique that directly strikes the chest and abdomen with Vajra-like force. Those who fail to evade may suffer broken ribs and internal injury.

column1: 此刀法力道惊人无比，可引动九州风雷于刀锋之上，一刀劈下，当真是魂飞魄散，鬼哭神嚎
column2: This blade art carries a force so tremendous it can summon the wind and thunder of all nine provinces onto the blade's edge; one chop truly scatters souls and makes ghosts cry and gods wail

column1: 武当功夫讲求刚柔并济，软硬兼施，此功法将腹部软功和周身硬功结合，劲道收放灵活自如
column2: The upper volume of the “Tai Xuan Scripture,” requiring absorption of midday solar essence over long periods to cultivate extreme yang Inner Force.

column1: 源于山间猿猴动作的棍法，使用者装如猿猴，左右横跳，棍招亦灵活多变，令敌人防不胜防
column2: A staff art derived from mountain apes; the user mimics an ape, leaping side to side, with agile and unpredictable staff moves

column1: 牛头乃阴间衙役，手持钢叉，力能排山。此招假其名号，由身强体壮者使出，确实威猛异常
column2: The Bull-Head is an underworld officer wielding a steel fork with mountain-moving strength; this technique borrows his name, and is truly ferocious when used by a powerful fighter

column1: 猛将所使步法，每一步皆重重落地，铮然有声，引得周遭地面微颤，其力道与气势均是不俗
column2: A heavy-step martial gait used by warriors of great stature, where each step lands like a thunderous impact, shaking the ground and emphasizing overwhelming presence.

column1: 由九节铁鞭铰接而成的奇门兵器，以内力灌注其中，则可刚可柔，如臂指使，招式多变异常
column2: A jointed iron whip linked in nine sections; infused with inner force, it can be hard or soft, responsive as a finger, with endlessly variable techniques

column1: 茅山秘传引雷之术，将内息所生之雷电引入地下，电击周遭敌人，其威力颇强，消耗也颇大
column2: A secret Maoshan lightning-drawing technique that channels inner breath-generated lightning into the ground, electrocuting surrounding enemies; its power is considerable and its consumption equally great

column1: 蓬莱派地处海边，因而有此在海水中修炼之法，功成者迎风破浪，泅水浮波，颇为轻松惬意
column2: A coastal Penglai Sect training method that uses seawater resistance for cultivation; practitioners become capable of moving through wind and waves with ease.

column1: 走马灯般绕敌旋转之步法，待到敌人眼花缭乱，心神烦躁之时，往往使用者自己也头晕目眩
column2: A footwork method that circles the enemy like a spinning lantern; by the time the enemy is dazzled and agitated, the user is often dizzy themselves

column1: 金刚宗弟子入门时，师傅需以水或醍醐灌洒其头顶，显示诸佛护持与慈悲，也能使神智清明
column2: A Vajra Sect initiation rite in which a master pours water or sacred nectar over the disciple’s head, symbolizing divine protection and clarity of mind.

column1: 铸剑山庄兵械绝技之首，练成后可同时使用四把武器，长短交接，软硬兼施，如同万刃齐发
column2: The foremost weapon supreme technique of Sword Forging Villa; once mastered, the practitioner can simultaneously wield four weapons — long and short alternating, hard and soft combined — like ten thousand blades releasing at once

column1: （杨思迟这家伙，估计是想要赖账不还了，只是不知该如何打发这个债主啊......）
column2: (Yang Sichi seems to be trying to dodge his debt. The only problem is, how do I get rid of this creditor...)

column1: 一名痴情高人所创，旨在伤人而非取人性命之手法，刀刀不伤人要害，却又刀刀避无可避
column2: Created by a lovelorn master who aimed to wound but not kill; every blade stroke avoids vital areas yet is impossible to dodge

column1: 一套注重力道运用的轻功法门，需要推动数百斤重的石球或铁球行走，奔跑，乃至上下坡
column2: A Movement Art method focusing on force application; requires pushing stone or iron balls of several hundred jin while walking, running, and climbing slopes

column1: 一门借力打力，以巧胜强的功夫，其对劲道的把握以及时机之掌控，非日夜苦练难得纯熟
column2: A skill of using an opponent's force against them, winning with cleverness over strength; mastery of force and timing requires day-and-night practice

column1: 丐帮高级内功心法，此功法内息刚猛，遒劲有力，左冲右突之时颇有几分混天动地之威势
column2: An advanced Beggars Sect inner art; its inner breath is fierce and powerful, surging left and right with the momentum of shaking heaven and earth

column1: 专供练习闪转腾挪的功法，又练习心眼和拳脚的灵敏度，是武林人士经常练习的一门绝技
column2: A skill for practicing evasion and redirection, also sharpening the sensitivity of mind and limbs; widely practiced in the jianghu

column1: 主攻关节部位的阴毒擒拿手法，招法灵活诡谲，敌人一旦着手，难免伤筋错骨，无力再战
column2: A vicious grappling method targeting joints; once the enemy is caught, sinews are torn and bones dislocated, leaving them unable to fight

column1: 举枪问天，霸气豪壮之枪法，其招式多自下而上，或刺或挑，据说源于军中应对骑兵之法
column2: A bold and domineering spear art with upward thrusting and lifting moves; said to originate from military techniques for fighting cavalry

column1: 以一双铁钩使出的奇门招法，左右开弓，龙飞凤舞，一旦武器或肢体被其钩住便再难挣脱
column2: A peculiar technique using twin iron hooks. They strike from both sides like a dragon in flight; once caught, neither weapons nor limbs can easily escape.

column1: 以内力驱动之指法，故每次出招前皆需蓄力，一指既出则飒飒作响，气能凌云，威势不俗
column2: A finger technique requiring stored energy before each strike; once released, it produces a sharp sound and striking force that reaches the skies.

column1: 以内劲灌注剑刃，使之高速颤动化为残影，配合此套剑招使出，令人眼花缭乱，难辨虚实
column2: Channels inner force into the blade, making it vibrate at high speed to create afterimages; combined with these sword moves, it dazzles the eye and makes it hard to distinguish real from false

column1: 以极热内力灌注扇面的法门，可在空中扇出温度极高的金色烈焰，触者转瞬便会化作焦炭
column2: A fan technique infused with extreme yang Inner Force, capable of releasing golden flames in the air that instantly reduce anything touched to ash.

column1: 传说此剑法本有十五式，但因后两式凶煞无比，杀业过重而被作者毁去，最终仅余十三式
column2: A Sword said to originally contain fifteen forms, but the last two were destroyed by its creator due to their extreme brutality and overwhelming killing intent, leaving only thirteen forms.

column1: 依天干地支之理，缩减行动距离，从而加快移速之步法，常人眨眼之间便能变换数个方位
column2: A footwork method based on the heavenly stems and earthly branches principles that shortens movement distance to increase speed; in the blink of an eye the practitioner can shift through several positions

column1: 修炼此功法需用三指拔出钉入木板的一百单八枚铁钉。练成者三指抓出，便似有千斤之力
column2: Requires pulling 108 iron nails from wooden boards with three fingers; the adept's grip carries enormous force

column1: 力道独特，招式精妙的挥戈之法，修习此功法登峰造极者，可用长戈雕琢玉器，分毫不差
column2: A ge technique of unique force and refined moves; at peak mastery, the practitioner can carve jade with a long ge without the slightest error

column1: 唐门暗器高手可在袖中暗藏数十种不同暗器，无论想使哪种，不需找寻，一挥袖便能发出
column2: A Tang Sect hidden weapon master can conceal dozens of different hidden weapons in their sleeves; whichever they wish to use, a single flick of the sleeve releases it without searching

column1: 唐门独特内家心法，以此内劲所发之暗器，可以空中转向九次，任你轻功再高也难以闪避
column2: The Tang Sect's unique inner art; hidden weapons fired with this inner force can change direction nine times in mid-air — no matter how high one's Movement Art, evasion is nearly impossible

column1: 在竹筒中装填火药和铁砂而成，点燃引线后子弹自开口处爆射而出，射程较长但威力一般
column2: A bamboo-tube firearm loaded with gunpowder and iron pellets. Once the fuse is lit, the shot explodes out of the opening. It has relatively long range, but only moderate destructive power.

column1: 天山派女弟子修习之柔美剑法，其挥招之时如素女立雪，羽衣蹁跹，鸾回凤舞，妙招频频
column2: A graceful sword style of female disciples, resembling a celestial maiden dancing in snow, elegant and flowing.

column1: 奇形飞轮，掷出后划圆弧飞行并回到手中，熟练者可反复次第掷出多枚，令敌人难以闪避
column2: An oddly shaped flying wheel; thrown, it curves through the air and returns to the hand — the skilled can throw multiple wheels in sequence, making them nearly impossible to evade

column1: 威力强悍的转轮功法，其凶狠招式可助人快速脱离苦海，往生极乐——无论对方是否愿意
column2: A powerful rotational martial art technique whose ruthless strikes are said to lead enemies toward “liberation,” regardless of their willingness.

column1: 将千张白纸钉为纸方，悬于墙上反复击打之功法。表面上是阳刚劲路，却也暗含阴柔之力
column2: A training method of nailing a thousand sheets of white paper into a block and repeatedly striking it; outwardly a hard-force path, yet concealing soft force within

column1: 描绘瑜伽修行十七重境界的金刚宗秘法，若能一一研习，可令修持者身体康健，心神清明
column2: A Vajra Sect secret method outlining seventeen progressive stages of yogic cultivation. Mastery of each stage improves physical health and mental clarity.

column1: 极为高深的佛门心法，其言甚简却涵摄诸多法门之精义，对于修行者心智神识均大有裨益
column2: A profoundly deep Buddhist heart method; its words are few yet encompass the essence of many disciplines, greatly benefiting the practitioner's spirit and mind

column1: 极细极长之银针，需要以灵巧手法催动内劲射出，一旦命中敌人穴道，便可使其内息紊乱
column2: Extremely fine and long silver needles requiring Agility hand techniques and inner force to fire; a hit to an acupoint throws the enemy's inner breath into chaos

column1: 樵夫出身的奇门高手所创，其招式层层叠叠，专攻下盘，真如老树盘根一般令人动弹不得
column2: Created by a woodcutter-turned-master; moves pile up like tangled roots, attacking only the lower body, making enemies truly unable to move

column1: 此功法专练手肘的顶凿屈转与抗击打能力，功成后手肘孔武有力，纵以利刃砍之亦不能损
column2: Trains the elbows for thrusting, bending, turning, and resisting impacts; the adept's elbows are formidably powerful, impervious even to sharp blades

column1: 此招重在回打二字，即利用鞭子坚韧，使每一鞭挥出均有回环往复之后招，令人防不胜防
column2: The key lies in the rebound strike — each whip stroke uses the weapon's elasticity to create a looping follow-up, making it nearly impossible to guard against

column1: 此掌法擅长久战，招式以守代攻，绵密无比，劲道如春蚕吐丝般缠绕敌人，令其疲敝不堪
column2: A palm art suited to prolonged combat; its techniques defend in place of attacking, dense and relentless, wrapping around the enemy like a spring silkworm spinning silk until they are exhausted

column1: 此步法擅长控制敌我之间距离，步法柔婉凄怆，缓缓别离，却又回身紧逼，令人无从捉摸
column2: A footwork method skilled at controlling distance; its steps are soft and melancholy, slowly parting then suddenly pressing in, leaving the enemy with nowhere to escape

column1: 此硬功修习者遍体黝黑刚毅，皮肤粗糙如砂砾一般，实乃风吹日晒，经年累月的苦修所致
column2: A hard-body training result in which the practitioner’s skin becomes dark, coarse, and stone-like due to years of exposure to wind, sun, and relentless conditioning.

column1: 每一招均以英雄命名，豪气干云，霸道纵横之刀法，若由臂力过人者使出，气度更是不凡
column2: A heroic-named blade system where each move is associated with legendary figures, emphasizing grandeur, dominance, and overwhelming physical presence.

column1: 每走一圈恰好经过八卦八个方位，故而得名。武当弟子习此步法，可为后续进修树立根基
column2: A sword style following the principle of yin-yang mutual generation and restraint. Each move alternates between offense and defense, unpredictable yet logically consistent.

column1: 源于佛门的苦修之法，常人需三年方能技成。练习精纯者一指到处，木石皆碎，胸腑洞撤
column2: A grueling Buddhist discipline that takes ordinary people three years to master; the adept's single finger can shatter wood and stone, penetrating the chest cavity

column1: 源自道家秘术，修炼者需引日月精华、五行灵气入体。功成后，举手投足皆可与天地同力
column2: A Daoist secret art that absorbs sun, moon, and elemental energies; once mastered, every movement aligns with the force of heaven and earth.

column1: 由行伍枪法演化而来的棍法，掩去枪法之锋芒，化为绵密之守势，使用长兵之人多有修习
column2: Evolved from a military spear art; its sharp edge is softened into dense defense, widely practiced by those who use Polearm

column1: 相传为古时名将总结大量实战经验，汇编而成的二十四招枪决，乃是行伍猛将必修之法门
column2: Said to have been compiled by ancient famous generals from extensive battlefield experience; twenty-four spear techniques are essential study for any fierce warrior

column1: 相传是无名乞丐长棍被恶徒砍断后，情急之下以两节断棍使出的棍法，颇有几分灵巧快速
column2: Said to have been improvised by an unknown beggar after a villain cut his long staff in two; the resulting two-section technique is notably nimble and fast

column1: 看似平平无奇的铁珠，实则内藏数个更小的铁珠，手法高超者掷出，能同时打击多个穴位
column2: Seemingly ordinary iron pellets, but each contains several smaller pellets inside; thrown by a skilled hand, they can strike multiple acupoints simultaneously

column1: 着重进攻的内家掌法，其内劲倾吐如同惊涛骇浪，内功薄弱者稍有不慎，便会被伤及五脏
column2: An inner offensive palm art; its inner force pours out like crashing waves — those with weak inner art risk having their organs injured if not careful

column1: 结合呼吸吐纳与排打锻炼，增强力道与体魄的功法。其修习过程艰苦漫长，常人难以忍受
column2: Combines breathing exercises with hard-body training to strengthen force and physique; the process is long and grueling, difficult for ordinary people to endure

column1: 融合百家拳法而成，招式似是而非，真假莫辨，旁人看来错漏百出，但实则招招出其不意
column2: A fusion of a hundred fist arts; moves seem both familiar and strange, true and false — to outsiders it appears full of flaws, but every move catches the enemy off guard

column1: 返璞归真之棍招，此当头一棒，颇含禅机，对敌之人稍有不慎，便被震慑心神，动弹不得
column2: A staff move that returns to fundamental simplicity; this direct strike to the head carries a Chan-like quality — careless enemies find their spirit shaken and their body frozen

column1: 这六招剑法皆是花哨虚招，取烟雨朦胧之意，挥舞时云山雾罩，故弄玄虚，自是难以捉摸
column2: Six flashy sword forms that are mostly feints, inspired by misty and cloudy scenery, deliberately deceptive and hard to read.

column1: 通过神游之法，在睡梦中研习经典，冥想开悟，从而凝练心神，增长智慧的神奇道家法门
column2: A wondrous Daoist method of studying classics and achieving insight through meditation in dreams; concentrates the spirit and increases wisdom

column1: 铸剑弟子在庖厨中修习之刀法，以牛刀宰杀活鸡，切分鸡肉，专练手部力道和掌腕控制力
