column2: A blade art practiced by Sword Forging disciples in the kitchen; using a kitchen knife to slaughter live chickens and carve chicken meat, specifically training hand force and palm-wrist control

column1: 长乐帮入门弟子时常与其他帮派中人争抢地盘与档口，此时以怒面示人，可以吓退竞争者
column2: Entry-level Changle Gang disciples often compete with rival gang members for territory and stalls; showing an enraged face at these times can intimidate and drive off competitors

column1: 阎罗殿强身健骨苦修之法，功成者全身劲力勇猛，更兼不惧刀砍斧劈，鬼怪见了也得发愁
column2: A Yama Hall body-strengthening and bone-toughening discipline; once mastered the whole body's force is formidable and impervious to blade and axe — even ghosts would be troubled by this

column1: 顶尖杀手所使步法，有如鬼魅，无踪无影，无声无息，待敌人发觉之时，往往已陷入死境
column2: A footwork method used by top assassins; ghost-like, with no trace, no shadow, no sound — by the time the enemy notices, they have usually already fallen into a fatal situation

column1: 一套使用铁扇的奇门武功，其招式进退有据，儒雅非凡，劲风绵绵不绝，可达数尺之远
column2: An exotic martial art using an iron fan; the moves are measured and refined, with a continuous wind force reaching several chi

column1: 丐帮高手醉酒后意外使出的独到拳法，拳路似醉非醉，似醒非醒，左倒右支，难以捉摸
column2: A unique fist art accidentally produced by a Beggars Sect master while drunk; the moves seem half-drunk, half-sober, swaying left and right — hard to read

column1: 专练头部硬功之绝技，初学时需以棉布包裹避免受伤，练成后则以头碎石劈砖亦无大碍
column2: A head-hardening technique requiring initial protection during training; once mastered, the practitioner can smash stones or bricks with their head.

column1: 东南刀客于海边练成的刀法，需挥刀反复劈斩海浪，至刀风可开分海浪数尺，方能功成
column2: A blade art mastered by a southeastern swordsman training at the sea's edge; the practitioner must chop at waves repeatedly until the blade wind can split the water by several chi

column1: 书法名家所创，或挥或洒，或点或按，走脉打穴之间颇现笔力，悟性不足者难得其神髓
column2: Created by a calligraphy master; the moves sweep, scatter, dot, and press — striking meridians and acupoints with brush-like force; those lacking insight cannot grasp its essence

column1: 产自天竺的圆轮形奇门兵刃，平时可作祭祀法器，战斗时可大力挥舞格挡，或投掷攻敌
column2: A circular disc-shaped weapon from India. It is used in rituals but can also be swung in combat for defense or thrown offensively.

column1: 以内家功夫分拨水面，初学者不过毫厘而已，而大成者可令水开数尺，足见其劲道浑厚
column2: Uses inner art to split water; beginners can barely manage a hairbreadth, but the adept can part water by several chi, demonstrating the depth of their force

column1: 以奇门遁甲中的生死八门之法计算飞刀射击的方位，可以缩小乃至封死敌人的躲避空档
column2: Uses the eight gate calculations of Qimen Dunjia to determine flying blade trajectories, narrowing or completely sealing off the enemy's evasion window

column1: 以蛮力取胜，速度较为缓慢的刀法，劈空砍地时能感到地面微微震颤，足见其势大力沉
column2: A slow but overwhelmingly powerful blade technique that relies on brute strength; when it cleaves through air or ground, the tremor of force can be felt beneath the earth, revealing its crushing weight.

column1: 借助踩踏之力，在水面漂行之轻功，初时需要借助木板训练，功成后可奔行数丈而不沉
column2: A Movement Art that skims along the water's surface using stepping force; beginners train with wooden boards — the adept can run dozens of zhang without sinking

column1: 假托蔡文姬之名所作琴曲，其音调如怨如慕，如泣如诉，闻者无不落泪伤心，难以自持
column2: A zither piece falsely attributed to Cai Wenji, with melodies full of sorrow and longing, like weeping and lamentation, causing listeners to break down emotionally.

column1: 刺客所用，以诡异多变，悄无声息的步法闻名，身形如幽冥鬼影，视之无形，听之无声
column2: An assassin's footwork; famous for its strange, unpredictable, and utterly silent movement — the body moves like an underworld shadow, invisible to the eye and inaudible to the ear

column1: 劲道阴柔细密之拳法，以缠丝之劲道限制敌方关节扭动，令其难以发力，从而以巧胜强
column2: A soft yet intricate fist technique using coiling force to restrict an opponent’s joints, preventing power from being exerted, thus overcoming strength with skill.

column1: 双腿摆动迅捷，更兼指掌攀援的奇特轻功，登山越险，见缝插针，上树游墙，如履平地
column2: A unique Movement Art of rapidly swinging the legs combined with hand and finger gripping; climbing mountains over dangerous terrain, slipping through gaps, scaling trees and walls — all as easy as flat ground

column1: 在悬挂绳索上修习，或跑动，或跳跃，或打坐，或小憩，可锻炼身形平衡和下盘之稳固
column2: Trained on suspended ropes — running, leaping, sitting in meditation, or resting — to develop balance and a stable foundation

column1: 将全身内劲灌注于腿脚，以极快之速度，瞬间闪身跃出数丈距离，可轻松躲避大多攻击
column2: Channels the whole body's inner force into the legs and feet, instantly flashing several zhang in distance at extreme speed — capable of easily dodging most attacks

column1: 将内息脱离体外建立循环的高超功法，修行者自觉物我两忘，天人合一之时，方为大成
column2: An advanced art that establishes a circulation of inner breath outside the body; the practitioner achieves great mastery when they feel the dissolution of self and unity with heaven and earth

column1: 峨眉派入门道家心法，修习者需在坐禅之时忘却己身，排除杂念，清心净性，真气自生
column2: An Emei sect beginner Taoist mental method requiring meditation and self-forgetting; only through purity of mind does Inner Force naturally emerge.

column1: 本是海边船夫以铁钩捕鱼之法，化为武学后招式奇特，别出心裁，非聪慧之人难以使用
column2: Originally a fisherman's iron hook technique; converted into martial arts, the moves are inventive and unusual, difficult for those lacking intelligence

column1: 模仿毒蛇进攻动作的拳法，施展时手臂可弯曲至超乎常理之角度，灵活婉转，柔中带刚
column2: A fist art imitating the attacking movements of venomous snakes; when deployed the arm can bend to angles beyond normal range — flexible and winding, soft yet hard

column1: 此剑法暗含修道之理，需平心静气方能发挥威力，修习者越是急于求成，越是难以精进
column2: This Sword contains Taoist principles. Only a calm and steady mind can bring out its full power; the more the practitioner rushes for quick success, the harder true progress becomes.

column1: 此步法灵动大气，潇洒自然，有欣喜豪爽之意，可谓春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花
column2: A lively and free-spirited footwork method, as carefree as galloping through Chang'an in spring — one day to see all the flowers

column1: 每项均分为总和值，基础值和潜力值。
column2: Each item is divided intoTotal Value，Base ValueAndPotential Points。

column1: 源于苗疆的双刀刀法，鸳刀主攻，鸯刀主守，双刀配合无间，上下翻飞，可谓滴水不漏
column2: A dual-blade art from the Miao borderlands; one blade attacks, the other defends — the two work seamlessly together, covering every angle

column1: 潮起潮落，月盈月亏，据说此功法有异曲同工之妙，在吐纳呼吸之间，积蓄澎湃之内力
column2: Tide rises and falls, the moon waxes and wanes; this art is said to work in the same way — accumulating vast inner force through the rhythm of breath

column1: 相传乃是一无名老道所传，以虚招为主，刀意空玄飘幻，令人如坠云里雾里，无从捉摸
column2: Said to have been passed down by an unnamed old Daoist; mainly feints, with a blade intent that is void and mysterious, leaving the enemy feeling lost in clouds and mist

column1: 着重锻炼头部和臂部抗击打能力的硬功绝技，运功之后，皮肤坚硬如铁，刀枪几不能入
column2: A hard qigong specialty focused on toughening the head and arms; once activated, the skin is as hard as iron, nearly impervious to blades and spears

column1: 立于闹市中心的木牌，其上张贴有各式通缉悬赏和委托告示，往来行人不时驻足端详。
column2: A public board displaying bounties, missions, and announcements.

column1: 精锐重铠军士所修之硬功，稳若泰山，人甲合一，能够最大化发挥所穿盔甲之防御效用
column2: A hard qigong practiced by elite heavy-armored soldiers; stable as Taishan, man and armor as one — maximizes the defensive effectiveness of the armor being worn

column1: 结合了暗器手法的奇特短刀，触动刀柄机关，刀刃便会弹射而出，出人意料，攻敌不备
column2: An unusual short blade combined with hidden weapon technique; trigger the handle mechanism and the blade shoots out — unexpected and impossible to guard against

column1: 罕有人练成的奇功，经脉运转之时，肤色呈现墨玉般的黑暗光泽，水火难侵，刀枪不入
column2: A rare technique where the practitioner’s meridians turn dark jade-like during circulation, making the body resistant to water, fire, blades, and spears.

column1: 脱胎于普贤心经的佛门内功，缘起非有无，非实亦非虚，可大大增加修习者的内功修为
column2: A Buddhist inner art derived from the Puxian Heart Sutra; neither existing nor non-existing, neither real nor void — greatly increases inner art cultivation

column1: 脱胎自道家典籍庄子之拳法，或水击千里，或扶摇直上，招式大开大合，内劲潇洒浑厚
column2: A fist art derived from the Daoist classic Zhuangzi; striking water for a thousand li, soaring straight upward — moves are wide and sweeping with a free and powerful inner force

column1: 蕴含八阵图义理的刀法，以生死八门配合五行生克，经过精确计算使出，方能发挥威力
column2: A blade art embodying the principles of the Eight Formation Diagram; only through precise calculation using the eight gates and five elements can it reach its full power

column1: 设置有杵臼甘埚以及各式丹炉药鼎之所，弟子在此炼制各式灵丹妙药，以供门派使用。
column2: A place for refining medicinal pills and elixirs using various alchemical tools and furnaces.

column1: 设置有熔炉铁砧以及各式木匠工具之所，弟子在此制作各式武器防具，以供门派使用。
column2: A workshop equipped with furnaces and tools for forging weapons and armor for sect use.

column1: 身披铁甲之人修习的硬功，通过肌肉运劲和姿势调整，令敌人的攻击落在甲胄较厚实处
column2: A hard qigong practiced by those wearing iron armor; through muscle force and posture adjustment, enemy attacks are directed onto the thicker sections of the armor

column1: 这门阴柔内功旨在维持修炼者心智之清净。心无杂念，灵台清明，气感自生，功法自成
column2: A soft yin inner art aimed at keeping the practitioner's mind pure; with no distractions, clarity arises naturally and the art develops of itself

column1: 速度迅捷，跳跃冲刺能力亦极为惊人的名马，传说其先祖曾背负刘备越过阔数丈的檀溪
column2: A famous horse of extraordinary speed and leaping ability; legend holds that its ancestor carried Liu Bei across the Tan Creek, a gap several zhang wide.

column1: 金刚宗修气瑜伽法，借助观想拙火疏通并洗涤自身经脉，可令内息滚沸，抵御藏地严寒
column2: A Vajra Sect yogic practice using visualization of inner fire to purify and open the meridians. It intensifies Inner Force and helps withstand the cold of high-altitude regions.

column1: 钟离权所传之扇法，招式开合有度，擅以凌厉劲风扰乱敌人，关键时刻也可做格挡之用
column2: An umbrella/hand-fan technique passed down by Zhongli Quan. Its openings and closures are precisely controlled; it can disrupt opponents with sharp gusts of force and also serve as a defensive shield when needed.

column1: 铸剑山庄秘传绝技，练成后可同时使用三把武器，切换迅捷，上下翻飞，如同百刃出击
column2: A secret supreme technique of Sword Forging Villa; once mastered, the practitioner can simultaneously wield three weapons, switching with lightning speed, flipping up and down — like a hundred blades striking at once

column1: 阎罗殿弟子常用之进阶刀法，讲求以战养战，威猛嗜杀，挥砍之间鬼神惊惧，气势不凡
column2: An Advanced Blade commonly used by Yama Hall disciples; emphasizes fighting to strengthen through combat, ferocious and bloodthirsty — each swing strikes fear into gods and demons, with formidable momentum

column1: 静为阴，动为符，此枪法动静结合，兵行诡道，专攻下三路，敌人稍有不慎便非残既伤
column2: Still is yin, motion is the talisman; this spear art combines stillness and motion, taking an unorthodox path targeting the lower three roads — careless enemies will find themselves crippled

column1: 高僧所创，可将天地阴阳二气化为悲智双运之力，最终达到无缘大慈，同体大悲之境界
column2: A technique created by high monks that transforms yin-yang energy into compassion and wisdom, ultimately reaching boundless benevolence and shared suffering.

column1: 黄皮黑嘴，身布连环旋毛，世人多以为丑，然而其矫健善走，蹄大快程，不可以貌取之
column2: Yellow-skinned with a black muzzle and a coat of swirling curls; many find it ugly, yet it is agile, fast-hoofed, and not to be judged by appearance.

column1: 一门阴柔内功心法，练成者浑身遍布绵柔坚韧之内劲，可自行吸附或化解来袭之攻势
column2: A soft yin inner art; the adept's body is filled with resilient gentle inner force that can absorb or dissolve incoming attacks on its own

column1: 为江湖人士所不齿之刀法，需将兵刀藏于袖中，待敌人近前，突然出手，以偷袭取胜
column2: A blade art scorned in the jianghu; the blade is hidden in the sleeve and drawn suddenly when the enemy closes in, winning through ambush

column1: 从西域传入的奇门鞭法，鞭势绵密飞舞，卷起沙尘高达数丈，可令周遭敌人目不能视
column2: An exotic whip art from the Western Regions; the whip dances in dense spirals, raising dust clouds several zhang high, blinding nearby enemies

column1: 从长兵偃月刀中演化而来的刀术，其招式气势雄伟，威武庄严，往往令敌人不战自危
column2: Evolved from the long-weapon crescent blade; its moves are majestic and imposing, often causing the enemy to lose the will to fight before contact

column1: 以巨型铡刀使出，顺劈竖砍，或格或架，因其形制独特，体积巨大，可以不变应万变
column2: Used with a giant chopping blade; vertical and diagonal cuts, parrying and blocking — its unusual size and volume allow it to meet any situation with one unchanging response

column1: 以连续追击而闻名之剑术，一剑比一剑更快，更险，敌人刚挡下一剑，往往数剑又至
column2: A sword art famous for relentless pursuit; each sword strike comes faster and more dangerously than the last — the enemy barely blocks one strike before several more arrive

column1: 供商贾旅人和武林人士打尖住店之所，一楼提供各式家常菜肴，二楼则为住宿客房。
column2: A lodging place for travelers and martial artists, offering food downstairs and Guest Room upstairs.

column1: 刀意潇洒豪爽，正气凛然，相传髯须刀客曾以此刀法扫荡贼寇，剪除恶徒，因而闻名
column2: Bold and heroic in spirit, radiating righteousness; said to have been used by a bearded swordsman to sweep out bandits and cut down villains — hence its fame

column1: 反复击打铁砂锤炼而成的刚猛掌法。功成者手掌比常人厚两倍有余，骨节也粗大异常
column2: A fierce palm art forged through repeated striking of iron sand; the adept's palms are more than twice as thick as normal, with unusually large knuckles

column1: 唐门特制暗器，上有机关，一旦命中便自动刺出倒钩，着者难免皮开肉绽，错骨伤筋
column2: A Tang Sect custom-made hidden weapon with a spring mechanism; once it strikes, reverse hooks automatically extend — the victim suffers torn skin and dislocated bones

column1: 四指并用陆续弹击，有如音乐家弹琵琶之指法，可令使用者的外功招式更加变幻莫测
column2: Strikes in sequence with four fingers like a musician plucking a pipa; makes the practitioner's external techniques far more unpredictable

column1: 如同一轮弯月的细长铁钩，一旦被其钩中便再难脱身，乃是苗疆抓捕恶徒之奇门兵刃
column2: A long and slender iron hook shaped like a crescent moon; once hooked, the target cannot escape — an Qimen weapon from the Miao borderlands for capturing criminals

column1: 威力强悍的刀法，其凶狠招式可助人快速脱离苦海，往生极乐——无论对方是否愿意
column2: A similarly powerful Blade imbued with sharp vajra wisdom, also described as delivering enemies into liberation irrespective of consent.

column1: 孔雀翎毛编织而成的羽扇，内藏毒针，发动之时，四射飞散，如孔雀开屏，斑斓炫目
column2: A feather fan woven from peacock feathers concealing poison needles within; when deployed, they scatter in all directions like a peacock spreading its tail — dazzling and deadly

column1: 将双手力道集中于刚猛一击之中，极简的招式蕴含着千钧之力，也因此缺乏防御后招
column2: Concentrates both hands' force into a single fierce strike; the simplest of moves contains a thousandfold force, but leaves no defensive follow-up

column1: 将金属锤头系于长绳一端，可旋转蓄力，如由力大者甩出，真如流行破空般势不可挡
column2: A metal hammerhead tied to one end of a long rope; spun to gather force, a throw from a strong arm is unstoppable as a shooting star

column1: 峨眉山养鸭道士所创，身体左摇右摆，前后晃动，古朴笨拙中隐藏着奇特的拳法技巧
column2: A strange Emei mountain “duck-herding Daoist” boxing style, characterized by swaying, rocking movements that conceal subtle martial intent.

column1: 招式刚猛的刀法，蕴含无比锐利且无坚不摧之金刚智慧，号称可消除罪孽，降魔息灾
column2: A similarly fierce Blade infused with vajra wisdom, capable of overwhelming opponents with decisive and purifying force.

column1: 招式刚猛的杵法，蕴含无比锐利且无坚不摧之金刚智慧，号称可消除罪孽，降魔息灾
column2: A ferocious vajra staff technique embodying indestructible wisdom, said to purify karma and suppress demons.

column1: 敷有剧毒之钢针，其断肠草之毒性令人痛不欲生，若命中心腹部位则会加快毒性发作
column2: A steel needle coated with virulent poison derived from heartbreak grass; the agony is unbearable, and if it strikes the chest or abdomen the poison spreads even faster

column1: 暗器高手所使铁牌，薄如蝉翼却颇具重量，专攻咽喉小腹等要害部位，见之如见阎王
column2: An iron tablet used by a hidden weapon master; thin as a cicada wing yet with considerable weight — targets the throat and lower abdomen, the vital points — those who see it may as well be seeing death

column1: 极细之玉针，带有的冰寒之气一旦刺入人体，便会在经脉中自行游走，阻滞内息运行
column2: An extremely fine jade needle carrying a cold yin energy; once it enters the body, it travels through the meridians on its own, blocking inner breath circulation

column1: 此杖法以招式严谨，防守致密见长，修习者需以水桶取水泼之而不能进，方见其功力
column2: A staff art known for disciplined techniques and tight defense; the practitioner must be able to splash water with the staff without letting a drop pass — that is mastery

column1: 此枪法擅长以游龙探海之势攻击下盘，一旦刺伤敌人腿脚，便能更好发挥长兵之优势
column2: This spear art excels at attacking the lower body with a roaming dragon probing the sea; once the enemy's legs are wounded, the advantage of a Polearm can be better exploited

column1: 此步法专走斜路，看似歪歪扭扭，不成体统，实则蕴含几分威猛冲劲，不可掉以轻心
column2: This footwork moves exclusively along diagonal paths; it appears crooked and disorderly, yet conceals a fierce charging force that should not be underestimated

column1: 看似朴实无华的剑招，直来直往之间却蕴含千钧重力，堪称剑法大巧若拙之至高境界
column2: A seemingly plain sword style that strikes directly yet carries immense hidden force, representing the ultimate simplicity within complexity.

column1: 经霹雳堂历代不断研发的火药制备之法，消耗更少的原料，其产量和威力皆有所提升
column2: A continuously improved gunpowder refinement method developed over generations in Thunderclap Hall, requiring fewer materials while increasing yield and explosive power.

column1: 给刀柄安装机关，使刀刃可以弯折旋转，因此可从各种诡异角度出刀，招式变化无穷
column2: A mechanism is installed on the blade handle allowing the blade to bend and rotate; this enables strikes from all manner of strange angles with endless variations

column1: 自天竺传入中原之指法，专攻敌人周身穴位，少林僧众常以此作为穴位辨识入门之法
column2: A finger technique originating from India, designed to target acupoints throughout the body. Shaolin monks use it as an introductory method for learning pressure point identification.

column1: 蓬莱派基础内丹法门，其炼气者，需冥心定息，元寂绵绵，直至气入丹田，丹火旺盛
column2: A foundational internal alchemy method of the Penglai Sect. Practitioners must quiet the mind and regulate breathing until consciousness becomes still and continuous; only then does qi enter the dantian and ignite a flourishing inner “dan fire.”

column1: 跪伏在地，头顶佛脚的敬礼姿势，每日坚持修习，可增长清净智慧，并锻炼下盘腰力
column2: A posture of kneeling and touching one’s head to the Buddha’s feet. Practiced daily, it is believed to cultivate wisdom and strengthen the lower body.

column1: 这套江湖人士常用刀法以攻击见长，刀势结合内劲长驱直入，如同青龙出海勇猛难当
column2: A strong offensive blade art; the blade force drives forward like an azure dragon emerging from the sea

column1: 道家法器，本作驱鬼辟邪之用，对敌时可格架攻击，或用摧耳铃音扰乱周边敌人心智
column2: A Daoist magical artifact used originally for exorcism; in combat it can block attacks or disrupt enemies with sound.

column1: 配合铁制盔甲训练的硬功，在合适时机以合适姿态迎击敌人，可令甲胄防御能力倍增
column2: A hard qigong trained in conjunction with iron armor; meeting the enemy's attack at the right moment and in the right posture can double the armor's defensive effectiveness

column1: 阴狠凶邪，专攻人体要害的刀法，传说此刀一出，必须见红夺命，否则便会反噬其主
column2: A sinister and vicious blade art targeting vital areas; legend says once this blade is drawn it must draw blood and take a life — otherwise it will turn on its own master

column1: 霸刀门基础硬功，以砂砾滚磨皮肤使周身老茧遍布，以岩石击打筋骨使肌体强韧非常
column2: A foundational hard-body training method of the Ba Dao Sect, where sand and gravel are used to grind the skin into calloused toughness, while stones strike the bones to forge extreme physical resilience.

column1: 鲜血铸就，惊鸿绝巘之枪法，三国名将赵子龙凭此出生入死，斩将七十余人未尝一败
column2: A spear art forged in blood, a breathtaking peak; the Three Kingdoms general Zhao Zilong used it to charge through life and death, slaying over seventy enemy generals without a single defeat

column1: 黢黑粗大之钢钉，边缘有增加穿透力的锋棱，以其劲道迅猛可以击碎头颅，故而闻名
column2: A thick black steel nail with sharp ridges along its edges to increase penetrating power; famous for being able to shatter a skull with its forceful impact

column1: 一张由铁索编成的大网，以内劲抛出，可罩住颇大一片范围，落网之人皆动弹不得
column2: A large net woven from iron chain links; thrown with inner force, it covers a wide area — all who fall under it are immobilized

column1: 以六种基本招式为根基的简练枪法，枪路刚猛直接，只需身强力壮者便能发挥威力
column2: A concise spear art built on six fundamental techniques; direct and forceful, anyone with a strong physique can wield it effectively

column1: 以棋盘对弈为形制，分析阵型地利之法，用兵作战，攻守纵横之妙，皆可蕴含其中
column2: A strategic system modeled after a chessboard formation, analyzing terrain and tactics for warfare, containing both offensive and defensive principles within its structure.

column1: 以琴弦引动音波，化为劲风飞射攻敌的奇特武功，其招式无影无形，因此难以躲避
column2: A peculiar martial art that uses sound waves from zither strings to launch invisible gusts of force at the enemy, making its attacks extremely difficult to evade.

column1: 借助轻功与内劲吸附，在墙面游行之轻功，精通此术者于广厦高墙上亦能如履平地
column2: A Movement Art that adheres to wall surfaces using Movement Art and inner force absorption; the adept can move across towering walls as if on flat ground

column1: 健体强身之苦修功法，相传修习者日啖牛肉数斤而不觉饱，持之日久可得熊虎之相
column2: A grueling body-strengthening discipline; practitioners reportedly consume several jin of beef daily without feeling full — sustained over time, it produces the bearing of a bear or tiger

column1: 军队所用，可连续发射箭矢的机关弩，经神机门改进，威力和精准度都有较大提升
column2: A military crossbow system enhanced by the Shenji Sect, capable of firing continuous bolts with improved power and accuracy.

column1: 刀出如雷霆震怒，万军辟易，破阵如碾碎蝼蚁一般，久经沙场者亦不敢挡其锋芒。
column2: A saber technique like thunder’s wrath—devastating enough to scatter armies; battle-hardened warriors dare not block its edge.

column1: 吐纳功之进阶功法，于吐纳之时引气归元，使内力达到循环往复，生生不息之功效
column2: An advanced breathing art; while exhaling and inhaling, qi is guided back to its origin, creating a self-sustaining cycle of inner force

column1: 在空气流通之清静室内，屏息凝神，盘腿打坐之法，有修身养性，锻炼心智之功效
column2: A sweeping, grand brush-style martial method. Amid extravagant feints lie decisive strikes targeting vital acupoints; once executed, no target is missed.

column1: 如同乌黑树叶一般的飞镖，颇有几分重量，在夜间或树林中射出，常人人难以察觉
column2: Heavy dark-leaf-shaped darts that are nearly invisible when thrown at night or through trees

column1: 如雪花纷飞洒出银屑攻敌之法，其功效与石灰粉相似，着之者目不能视，泪流不止
column2: Scatters silver powder like flying snowflakes to attack the enemy; its effect is similar to lime powder — contact causes blindness and uncontrollable tears

column1: 将全身力道绷紧，用以抵抗乃至反弹来袭的攻势，因蓄力时身形弯曲如龟壳而闻名
column2: Tenses the whole body's force to resist and deflect incoming attacks; named for the turtle-shell posture assumed while gathering Strength

column1: 将内息灌注周身经脉，用以抵挡攻击的防御法门，需有深厚内力根基方能发挥功效
column2: Channels inner breath through all the body's meridians to resist attacks; requires a deep inner force foundation to be effective

column1: 情势危急之时使出，足以力挽狂澜的挥戈之术，传说鲁阳公曾以此法逼退空中烈日
column2: A ge technique deployed in desperate moments, capable of turning the tide; legend says that Lord Luyang once used it to force the blazing sun to retreat across the sky

column1: 攻守兼备之刀招，一经使用，四面八方皆为刀光所笼罩，需要相当高超的用刀技巧
column2: A well-rounded blade technique; once deployed, blade-light covers all eight directions, requiring considerable skill to wield

column1: 效仿百兽形意之刀法，其招式威猛霸道，颇具熊虎之姿，对修习者的体魄大有裨益
column2: A blade art imitating the spirit-forms of a hundred beasts; its moves are fierce and domineering with the bearing of bears and tigers, greatly benefiting the practitioner's physique

column1: 本是行伍中短钢鞭路数，被化用在长鞭之上，每一鞭挥出皆是孔武有力，威力不俗
column2: Originally a short steel whip method from the military; adapted for the long whip, every stroke carries formidable power

column1: 本用于惩罚犯戒僧众的佛门鞭式，也可做苦修之法，对使用者的内力修为要求较高
column2: Originally a Buddhist whip method used to punish monks who broke precepts; also used as a harsh training method, requiring a relatively high inner force foundation

column1: 此功法修炼者腰身与四肢极为柔韧，遇敌起舞，如迎风摆柳，或攻或守，灵活异常
column2: The practitioner's waist and limbs are extremely supple; when facing enemies, they move like willows in the wind, shifting between offense and defense with fluid agility

column1: 此杵法招式精深，攻守兼备，进能降服恶魔，故称大威，退能护佑良善，故称大德
column2: A vajra staff technique of profound depth, balancing offense and defense. When attacking, it subdues demons; when withdrawing, it protects the righteous—hence its dual names of “Great Might” and “Great Virtue.”

column1: 此棍法以攻代守，全力狂舞之时，棍影遮天蔽日，旨在以舍身之势压倒敌人的战意
column2: This staff art attacks in place of defending; when fully unleashed, the staff shadow blots out the sky, aiming to overwhelm the enemy's fighting spirit through sheer commitment

column1: 此棍法取大圣闹天宫之意，挥洒自若，汹涌滂湃，棍扫过处，纵十万天兵亦不能当
column2: This staff art draws from the spirit of the Great Sage rampaging through the Heavenly Palace; free and surging — where the staff sweeps, not even ten thousand heavenly soldiers can stand

column1: 此棍法注重灵活迅速，因此以短棍为优，棍势如同蟠龙环游周身，使敌人莫能近前
column2: A staff art emphasizing agility and speed, best with a short staff; the staff force circles the body like a coiling dragon, keeping enemies at bay

column1: 此蛊虫状如小蛇，阴寒至极，能够钻入目标体内顺血脉而行，阻塞内息，啮咬内脏
column2: This gu creature resembles a small snake and is extremely yin and cold; it can burrow into the target's body and travel through the blood vessels, blocking inner breath and gnawing at the internal organs

column1: 此针灸之法专门医治心脉重疾，对于气血亏虚之人大有裨益，亦有安定心神之功效
